notes.title: v1.95 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We just released a new version of DemonCrawl! v1.95 focuses on balance changes and stability.

Perhaps the most significant change is a buff to all Mastery Dolls. With a pricetag of 30 coins, we found that most Dolls were not paying off as quickly as we would have liked. Now, these items will activate at the start of every stage, and their effects scale based on [b]your current number of mastery charges[/b] as opposed to [b]your max charge count[/b].

This should create some interesting opportunities where you have to decide between keeping your charges for empowered Doll effects, or spending them on a clutch ultimate ability.

Additionally, v1.95 allows us to start and end holiday events without needing to push a client update. This change was motivated by [url=https://i.ibb.co/bJNqgtR/image.png]a recent hardware failure[/url] that caused the Easter event to last a lot longer than intended.

Here is the new schedule for DemonCrawl holidays going forward:

[list]
[*][b]Easter:[/b] In real life, this holiday can take place anywhere between March to May, depending on the year. The in-game event will take place on either the first two or last two weeks of the month of Easter.
[*][b]Summer:[/b] July 1st - July 14th
[*][b]Halloween:[/b] October 15th - October 31st
[*][b]Birthday:[/b] November 1st - November 7th
[*][b]Christmas:[/b] December 15th - December 31st
[/list]

Finally, we rewrote the borderless windowed implemention using native GameMaker functions, which should fix an issue with the taskbar appearing in front of the game on some operating systems.

Full patch notes are below. Mac and Linux builds are expected to follow in 24 hours. Enjoy!

---

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list][*]New passive item: [b]Varnish[/b] - [i]"Favor all armor items. Whenever you equip armor, fortify it by 3."[/i]
[*]New passive item: [b]Whittling Knife[/b] - [i]"Favor all Doll items. Whenever you gain a Doll, gain a mastery charge."[/i]
[*]New passive item: [b]Birthright[/b] - [i]"Gain a random favored item at the start of each stage. You are even more likely to find favored items."[/i] [/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

[list][*]Added dictionary definition for "evasion"
[*]Replaced hacky Borderless Windowed method in favor of native GameMaker functions
[*]Special Events can now be applied without requiring a client patch
[*]Updated GameMaker runtime to the latest version[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list][*]Mastery Dolls buffed: all Mastery Dolls now activate at the start of each stage, in addition to whenever you activate your mastery
[*]Related to the above change, Dolls now consider your current number of mastery charges instead of max mastery charges
[*]Altar of Blood buffed: [i]"Automatically discharges whenever you take less damage than the max stage power. The max stage power becomes the amount of damage taken."[/i]
[*]Apple Bonsai buffed: status duration reduced from 40 turns to 10 turns
[*]Grappling Hook buffed: [i]"Reveal the corner cells."[/i]
[*]Mud buffed: [i]"For the next 100 turns, gain a Minion whenever you use a magic item."[/i]
[*]Divine Mud reworked: [i]"For the next 500 turns, gain a Minion whenever you use a magic item. The next time this activates, get an additional Minion."[/i]
[*]Scrap Hopper buffed: [i]"Destroy target chest. The next time you open a chest, gain souls equal to your number of Scrap Hopper status effects."[/i]
[*]Horoscope price reduced from 10 to 7 coins
[*]The Gambler now has a several-turn "buffer" when he spawns to prevent him from immediately losing coins
[*]Guild cost of Scientist increased slightly
[*]Negative evasion now gives monsters a chance to strike repeatedly[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list][*]Fixed an issue with the "Confine Mouse Cursor" option
[*]Fixed an issue with the "Auto" aspect ratio button
[*]Fixed an issue with Sundrop and Lumberjack Doll that would allow them to affect cells without monsters if all monsters were already revealed
[*]Fixed a minor visual issue with the HUD's XP bar
[*]Fixed several avatars that were incorrectly sized
[*]Fixed Lead Balloon duplicate toast alert
[*]Fixed a couple visual issues with particles being removed prematurely
[*]Fixed a crash related to the Item Tree[/list]

notes.title: Springtime Scramble Mini-Expansion & Holiday Event! (v1.94 Patch Notes)
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We have just released [b]Springtime Scramble[/b], a brand new mini-expansion for DemonCrawl!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/2950667b57772113a106cce689d116784d11094a.png[/img]

This update includes the following content:

[list]
[*]A whopping [b]40 new items[/b]
[*]New special stage: the [b]Item Tree[/b]
[*]New stranger: the [b]Scientist[/b]
[*]A new mechanic that allows you to [b]enchant cells[/b]
[*]The [b]Evasion stat[/b] which gives you a chance to dodge monsters as well as "on reveal" effects
[*]5 new [b]stage mods[/b]
[*]2 new [b]Mythic Emblems[/b]
[*]A handful of [b]reworked items[/b]
[*]New [b]original music[/b]
[/list]

Best of all, it's free of charge. 😎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/291f4529acd158a9b3c0b8b3cf117e67369e05d2.png[/img]

Additionally, Springtime Scramble marks the beginning of [b]DemonCrawl's annual Easter event[/b] [i](fashionably late, I know...)[/i] which will run through the remainder of April.

We have added [b]10 new holiday avatars[/b] for you to collect! If you manage to complete all the standard holiday missions, you will unlock a final "extra" mission that will challenge your puzzle-solving abilities. (Similar to last year's Halloween event.)

Full patch notes are available below.

Have fun! 🐰

---

[h2]Easter Event[/h2]

[list][*]10 new holiday avatars
[*]New final holiday mission: [b]Scrambled Egghead[/b]
[*]New holiday mythic emblem: [b]Shell Shocked[/b]
[*]Last year's Easter avatars are now available in prizeboxes
[*]New secret boss music
[*]New seasonal options menu music[/list]

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list][*]New special stage: [b]Item Tree[/b] - [i]"Pluck ripe items before they fall."[/i]
[*]New stranger: [b]Scientist[/b] - [i]"Perform science experiments on nearby objects and teleport colliding projectiles."[/i]
[*]New mechanic: [b]Enchanted Cells[/b] - [i]"Targeted item effects that persist on specific cells."[/i]
[*]New mechanic: [b]Evasion[/b] - [i]"A stat that gives you a chance to dodge monster damage and negate reveal effects."[/i]
[*]New stage mod: [b]Glacial[/b] - [i]"Stage contains a quadrant of frozen cells. After you open half of all empty cells, remove all auras."[/i]
[*]New stage mod: [b]Chummy[/b] - [i]"Whenever a monster is revealed, spawn a monster."[/i]
[*]New stage mod: F[b]orgotten[/b] - [i]"Whenever you chord or directly open a cell, obscure it."[/i]
[*]New stage mod: [b]Horizontal[/b] - [i]"Stage is twice as wide."[/i]
[*]New stage mod: [b]Vertical[/b] - [i]"Stage is twice as tall."[/i]
[*]New Library research subject: "Enchant"
[*]New Hero Trial mod: [b]Enchanted[/b] - [i]"Whenever you enchant a cell..."[/i]
[*]New mythic emblem: ???
[*]2 new divine items (via new mythic emblems)
[*]1 new legendary item
[*]11 new passive items
[*]16 new magic items
[*]8 new consumable items
[*]4 new omens[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

[list][*]Improved performance of explosion effects
[*]Optimized performance of omen negation checks
[*]Updated GameMaker runtime to the latest version
[*]Updated Google Play extensions
[*]Added toast alert for Frothy life loss
[*]Added toast alerts when trying to use Fiber items outside of a stage[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list][*]Directly spawning monsters with effects such as Pentagram will no longer trigger "on reveal" effects
[*]Drill reworked into an enchantment item: [i]"Enchant target visible cell: each turn, increase this cell's value by 1. If it's 10 or greater, upgrade the loot in this cell or spawn a coin here, then reset the cell value."[/i]
[*]Clay Figurine reworked into a magic item: [i]"[100 Mana] While charged, all chests contain Soft Clay."[/i]
[*]Ritual Chalk has been converted into an enchantment item
[*]Millstone price reduced from 32 to 19 coins
[*]Silver Bullet price reduced from 24 to 21 coins
[*]Tithing Plate price reduced from 15 to 13 coins
[*]Clusterbang price reduced from 19 to 14 coins
[*]Parting Gift price reduced from 9 to 7 coins
[*]Pillow price reduced from 14 to 10 coins
[*]Shoulder Angel price reduced from 25 to 20 coins
[*]Shoulder Devil price reduced from 25 to 20 coins
[*]Dove price reduced from 31 to 15 coins
[*]Travelog price increased from 10 to 12 coins
[*]Urn price increased from 14 to 17 coins
[*]Brooding stage mod difficulty rating increased from 1 to 2
[*]Parrot Token Shop price reduced from 20 Tokens to 10 Tokens[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list][*]Fixed "stranger enhancing" items such as Bindle ignoring passive negation effects
[*]Fixed visual issue with explosion effects
[*]Fixed an issue related to status turn adjustment and realtime status effects
[*]Resolved many non-critical compiler warnings[/list]

[i]** Mac and Linux builds expected to follow in 24h, after any necessary hotfixes. **[/i]

notes.title: v1.93 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We just released an update for DemonCrawl!

v1.93 is a small-but-important stability patch that implements a new version of the GameMaker Steamworks extension, which was released just a few hours ago. [url=https://forum.gamemaker.io/index.php?threads/game-often-does-not-launch-on-steam-after-steamworks-integration.99625]It purportedly resolves issues with games not launching on Steam.[/url]

Please note that the GameMaker updates have required us to refactor our UI code, so if you run into any strange issues with the interface, we ask that you file a bug report.

Full patch notes are below. Enjoy!

---

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

[list][*]Added "Pass" to the dictionary
[*]Updated GameMaker runtime to the latest version
[*]Refactored code related to UI, may improve performance slightly
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list][*]Reworked the drop conditions for the following mythic emblems: Dread Harvest, Original Sin, The Boneyard
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list][*]Updated Steamworks extension which purpotedly resolves issues with games not launching on Steam
[*]Having a full inventory no longer prevents Nomads from trading or spawning chests
[*]Fixed Overwhelming stage mod difficulty rating
[*]Fixed an issue related to Prism of Chaos and some other aura-related items like Fireplace
[*]Fixed a few issues related to the Stable mod and monster reveal effects
[*]Sleeping Powder should now stack correctly[/list]

notes.title: v1.92 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

The first DemonCrawl patch of 2023 is now live!

This update includes 10 new items, a new stage mod, several balance changes, and substantially expanded monster drop tables.

Among the new items are [b]3 unique types of minions[/b]. In addition to Minions and Magic Minions, you can now acquire [b]Big Minions, Rabid Minions and Shiny Minions[/b]. Each one corresponds to a different item category and has its own strengths and weaknesses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/61982d70d9ad7a01241a6abe8e2c8f5acd0a3a5b.png[/img]

Many of the remaining items are also minion-oriented. For example, Pact of Nature is a powerful lategame item that rewards you for having a variety of different minion types.

We hope these additions will breathe fresh air into Hunter comps, which haven't received many exciting tools in a while. Actually, Big Minion was planned for inclusion in DemonCrawl's original release, but we hadn't figured out the right niche for him until now.

Speaking of things that haven't changed in a while, there's finally a new stage mod! It's called [b]Stable[/b] and it's fairly straightforward: [b]any effect that would modify a cell has a 50% chance to fizzle.[/b] That means gleans, reveals, solves, conceals, explosions, and auras may or may not succeed. There are certainly ways this could work in your favor, which is how we like to design negative effects in DemonCrawl.

Finally, the list of monster item drops is quite lengthy now. In fact, we went through the game's 900+ items and tried to assign anything that made sense flavor-wise. It may be a while before some of the rarest drops are discovered by the community, so if you find anything cool or unexpected, we encourage you to share it on our Discord server!

The full patch notes for v1.92 are below. Enjoy!

---

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list][*]New stage mod: [b]Stable[/b] - [i]"50% chance to negate effects that would modify a cell."[/i]
[*]New legendary item: [b]Shiny Minion[/b] - [i]"Each turn you must guess, this will solve a random cell. This Minion will sacrifice itself to deflect fatal damage."[/i]
[*]New magic item: [b]Pact of Nature[/b] - [i]"[100 Mana] Solve a random cell for each of your Minions. If you don't have any, gain a Minion instead. Different minion types will cause different effects."[/i]
[*]New passive item: [b]Big Minion[/b] - [i]"Whenever you discover a 5 or greater, reveal a random nearby 3x3 area and kill any monsters within. If you're about to take damage, this Minion will sacrifice itself to deflect 10 damage."[/i]
[*]New passive item: [b]Chew Toy[/b] - [i]"Every 60 turns, transform a Minion into a Big Minion or gain a Minion if you don't have any."[/i]
[*]New passive item: [b]Book of Husbandry[/b] - [i]"Pick up hearts at full life to gain a Minion."[/i]
[*]New consumable item: [b]Dog Food[/b] - [i]"Upgrade your Minions, or gain a Minion if you don't have any."[/i]
[*]New consumable item: [b]Knuckle Wraps[/b] - [i]"Your next chord becomes a powerchord."[/i]
[*]New omen: [b]Rabid Minion[/b] - [i]"When you gain this as well as every 10 turns, reveal and kill a random monster. If you're about to take damage, this Minion will sacrifice itself to increase the damage by 1."[/i]
[*]New omen: [b]Bagman Medal[/b] - [i]"Stages have an additional Bagman."[/i]
[*]New omen: [b]Harbinger Medal[/b] - [i]"Stages have an additional Harbinger."[/i]
[*]Added some terms to the monster name generator
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list][*]Massively expanded monster drop tables
[*]A few items that generate Minions can now choose from special minion types
[*]Effects that depend on your number of Minions, such as Dog Tag, now account for all minion types
[*]Dove and Raven status duration lowered from 200 to 100 cells
[*]Bust rework: [i]"Spawners are more common. Strangers are no longer killed when a Spawner breaks."[/i]
[*]Leather Vest change: [i]"[3 Armor] Fortify by 2 whenever a Minion dies."[/i]
[*]Doomcall change: [i]"When you open half of all empty cells, spawn a Harbinger. Harbingers activate an additional time."[/i]
[*]Fake stage mod nerf: a notification will appear above the cells with fake values
[*]Lofty stage mod nerf: [i]"When you open half of all empty cells, increase the value of all cells by 1 except those with a value of 0."[/i]
[*]Haunted stage mod difficulty increased from 1 to 2
[*]Educational stage mod difficulty increased from 2 to 3
[*]Flawless stage mod difficulty increased from 2 to 3
[*]Overwhelming stage mod difficulty increased from 2 to 3
[*]Unchained stage mod difficulty increased from 3 to 4[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list][*]Updated to latest GameMaker runtime
[*]Fixed missing drop tables for several monsters
[*]Fixed issue with powerchording[/list]

---

[b]NOTE:[/b] GameMaker's current runtime unfortunately has several bugs preventing us from deploying this version of DemonCrawl to Linux and mobile platforms. We filed a bug report to YoYo Games about the matter on January 2nd but have not heard back. It is likely that they are at least aware of the issue and, with any luck, will have it resolved in time for their next runtime update. We apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: v1.90 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We just released a new update for DemonCrawl!

v1.90 is a stability patch that introduces a new system for catching errors, which should help with preventing crashes in the face of non-critical problems.

We also added a cool new avatar designed by community member rotten_toto:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/4f1bf6775b5f2783a0803efc669b4a22070ddc6d.png[/img]

Don't forget that you can submit your own artwork in [url=https://discord.gg/wqkWcc5]our Discord server[/url] - we love seeing what you guys come up with!

Finally, we are working to resolve ongoing issues with DemonCrawl on Android and iOS. Google and Apple have updated their deployment pipelines in recent months, which have made it difficult for us to publish new mobile versions of the game. To our mobile players: we are very sorry for the inconvenience and hope to resolve the situation sooner rather than later.

Full patch notes are below. Mac and Linux builds will follow within 24 hours.

---

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list][*]New community avatar: TOTO DRAGON by rotten_toto
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list][*]Implemented foundation of new error-catching system which should help the game continue when faced with non-critical errors instead of outright crashing
[*]Notably, the above feature now applies to "item use" effects (by far the most common source of crashes)
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed Barrel explosions
[*]Fixed Demolitionist II still applying its old effect
[*]Updated "error while loading profile" message for clarity
[*]Fixed incorrect sprite shown on Boom Bow toast
[*]Fixed pluralization on Secret Decoder sign messages
[*]Fixed Spooky Key incorrectly activating when received via item transformation, i.e. from opening a Present
[*]Speculative fix for a crash related to centering the camera when the cell object no longer exists
[*]Speculative fix for rare crash related to Canker Harbingers and Divine Doomcall
[/list]

notes.title: v1.88 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We just deployed a new version of DemonCrawl! This update includes the 2022 Halloween event, a ton mastery balance changes, several new items and more.

Full patch notes are available below. Enjoy!

[h2]Halloween Event[/h2]

[list][*]Expanded holiday questline with new avatar rewards - 11 missions in total
[*]Questline avatars from previous Halloween events have been moved to prizeboxes
[*]2 additional avatars have been added to Halloween prizeboxes
[*]When you donate the maximum amount of candy to a stranger, you will receive 10 Tokens instead of 1 for the final donation
[*]New consumable item: [b]Big Candy[/b] - [i]"50% chance to spawn a heart during the next 100 turns."[/i]
[*]New magic item: [b][TOP SECRET][/b]
[*]New holiday paint: [b][CLASSIFIED][/b]
[*]New mythic emblem: [b][REDACTED][/b]
[*]Replaced Options screen music[/list]

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list][*]New legendary item: [b]Mana Signet[/b] - [i]"Stages have additional Ethereal cells equal to the minimum power. When you complete a stage, gain 50 mana for each visible Ethereal cell."[/i] (Designed by Mythic Patron Emberflame ❤️)
[*]New consumable item: [b]Instant Familiar[/b] - [i]"Spawn a familiar on target empty cell and pass a turn."[/i]
[*]New consumable item: [b]Evil Container[/b] - [i]"Lose all of your omens. Get them back at the start of the next stage."[/i]
[*]Added blueprints for Caliper and Liquid Gold
[*]Updated GameMaker runtime to the latest version
[*]Added some easter eggs that most players will never notice :)[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list][*]Commander III rework: [i]"Convert your familiars into Instant Familiars."[/i]
[*]Undertaker II rework: [i]"When using Bones, you can target any visible cell without an aura."[/i]
[*]Firefly I rework: [i]"Burning cells do not hurt you. Each stage has burning cells equal to the minimum power."[/i]
[*]Firefly II rework: [i]"Whenever you fully and correctly chord a 2 or greater, burn and reveal a random nearby cell."[/i]
[*]Ghost I nerf: [i]"Whenever you die, activate Ectodrop."[/i]
[*]Ghost II rework: [i]"Whenever you complete a stage in ghost form, revive with 1 life."[/i]
[*]Ghost III rework: [i]"Activate Ectoplasm and increase the amount of life you revive with."[/i]
[*]Demolitionist II rework: [i]"Increase the radius of all explosion effects."[/i]
[*]Barbarian II buff: [i]"Whenever a stranger dies, activate Rotting Head. Whenever a Rotting Head expires, kill all visible monsters."[/i]
[*]Barbarian III rework: [i]"Activate Rotting Heads equal to the number of strangers you have killed."[/i]
[*]Survivor II buff: [i]"At the end of each stage, gain max life equal to the minimum power if you are injured."[/i]
[*]Knight III buff: [i]"Fortify all of your armor by 5."[/i]
[*]Mutant III buff: Charge cost reduced from 3 to 2
[*]Poisoner III buff: [i]"Consume all of your Poisons, activate an equal number of Spider Fangs, then gain Poison."[/i]
[*]Detective III buff: [i]"Remove all visible monsters from the board and gain coins equal to their cell values."[/i]
[*]Prophet I buff: [i]"Increase your XP gain by 35%."[/i]
[*]Bookworm I nerf: Book of Love research subject changed from "heart" to "life"
[*]Bookworm III nerf: [i]"Gain an item related to your research subject."[/i][/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list][*]Undertaker III and Commander III can no longer activate before monsters have spawned
[*]Fixed Sphere of Influence not affecting targeted consumable items
[*]Fixed Plum not affecting targeted consumable items
[*]Fixed Ectodrop status effect lingering after reviving
[*]Re-coded Mortar and Divine Mortar to avoid crashes with large chains of explosions
[*]Mrs. Claus Spawners can no longer appear out of season
[*]Fixed an issue with old special event progress interfering with new special events[/list]

notes.content:
Hi folks,

A new update is now available for DemonCrawl! This one includes our [b]Summer Sunset event[/b], the [b]Auramancer mastery[/b], [b]7 new items[/b], an optional [b]minimap setting[/b], and [b]doggo-themed cosmetics for our Patreon supporters[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/151e9f0529da2602c1399bce507b69dfb90ff4c5.png[/img]

[h2]Summer Sunset Event[/h2]

[list][*]Expanded holiday questline - 10 missions in total
[*]New substage: Getaway - [i]"This hot spot is full of summer activities, but it's REALLY HOT! You're bound to get burned unless you come prepared."[/i]
[*]Lightning bugs are out and about

[*]New summer affliction (omen): Ripped Pants - [i]"Whenever you make a mistake, all visible strangers and familiars flee."[/i]
[*]5 new summer avatars available in Prizeboxes
[*]New holiday paint: Sundown[/list]

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list][*]New patreon rewards: [b]Pugchamp[/b]
[*]New mastery: [b]Auramancer[/b] - [i]"Become a master of the elements and bend the earthly realm to your will."[/i]
[*]New magic item: [b]Bank Roll[/b] - [i]"[200 Mana] Automatically discharges when you spend coins. Gain the amount of coins spent."[/i]
[*]New passive item: [b]Caliper[/b] - [i]"You can see information about locked stages."[/i]

[*]Mobile: updated a number of extensions related to Google Services and refactored code accordingly[/list]

[list][*]Mobile: Updated cloud loading message for clarity[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list][*]Removed old code that may have caused issues with auras in some cases
[*]Fixed Detective III requiring 101 visible monsters to unlock instead of 100[/list]

notes.title: Investigating launch issues for non-Windows platforms
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We are currently looking into issues affecting DemonCrawl on a few platforms - most notably, there appears to be a bug in the latest version of the Steamworks extension for GameMaker that prevents our game from launching on Ubuntu.

We filed a bug report with GameMaker on Monday but have not yet received a response.

While Linux represents a small fraction of DemonCrawl's playerbase, we are nonetheless troubled by the serious nature of this issue. Having depended on GameMaker for many years, we have learned *not* to update our runtimes and extensions right away. We have seen serious bugs crop up even on GameMaker's stable branch. In this case, however, we had an obligation to update our pipeline in order to [url=https://developer.apple.com/news/?id=2t1chhp3]satisfy new requirements from Apple.[/url]

Given that we compile DemonCrawl to 5 different platforms using the same codebase, this puts us between a rock and a hard place. We don't have a simple way to make use of different GameMaker runtimes per OS. [b]Therefore, we have decided the best course of action is to rollback DemonCrawl on Linux to a build from April 14th[/b] - this is something we haven't had to do before, but it is working correctly in our test environment. One upshot is that Linux players will get to enjoy/suffer an extended Easter event... 🐰

On a better note, the latest version of GameMaker appears to have fixed launch issues on macOS. We are now able to run the game through Steam on Monterey v12.3.1. [b]If DemonCrawl is still giving you trouble on Mac, please make sure your operating system is up to date and leave a reply here with your system specs so we can investigate further.[/b]

One last thing: GameMaker has also replaced a number of important Android features with new extensions (namely AdMob, Google Play Cloud and Achievements). We are in the process of updating our code in accordance with GameMaker's documentation, but we have already identified an issue related to AdMob on iOS that will require GameMaker's attention.

---

I realize this was kind of a bummer post, but game dev ain't always sunshine and rainbows, folks. It's important to be transparent about these kinds of problems.

If you want to follow the situation as it unfolds, consider joining us on [url=https://discord.gg/wqkWcc5]Discord[/url] where we'll post updates as we have them.

We apologize for the inconvenience. Thank you for your continued patience and support. ❤️

- Eric from Therefore Games

- we have already identified an issue related to AdMob on iOS that will require GameMaker's attention.

notes.title: v1.84 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

A new update for DemonCrawl is now available! Kept you waiting long enough, huh?

This patch introduces the [b]Bookworm mastery[/b], [b]22 new items[/b], [b]a new boss[/b], and many other goodies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/32039fbfaab07c3aa68ec49cf1e5100760a4f13b.png[/img]

As the Bookworm, you will generate a steady supply of reading materials by visiting special stages. You can stack book effects together for powerful synergies and study them to influence the items you'll find throughout your quest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/1251a1842430591a5f8114b529d7bcaa4dc0658a.png[/img]

Introducing Hellwether - this new boss can summon monsters in his quadrant and has the ability to jump around the board whenever you make a mistake. Keep your distance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/75ef5895fab51673e4154b34290e6106396b97c1.png[/img]

Among the new items in v1.84 are a collection of passives called "Medals." These simple yet tremendously useful items allow you to encounter certain strangers in every stage. There's a Medal for each basic stranger type, and you can obtain them as early as the first stage. They're very good for setting up specific strategies.

---

[h3]Any other news?[/h3]

Yes! For the last several months, we have been working hard on not just v1.84, but [b]TWO[/b] additional updates for DemonCrawl. We plan to release the next patch quite soon - it is our annual Easter update and it contains a bunch of new holiday content to explore.

As for the third update? Well, it's too early to talk about that, but I can guarantee it's easily the most exciting. :-)

As an aside, if we haven't posted news about DemonCrawl in a while, it's not that we've abandoned the game--on the contrary, we're knee-deep in development!

Turns out, indie development is a bit of a double-edged thing. We can create content at our own pace, free of the financial and legal obligations that often hinder AAA titles. (Love it!) However, limited money and manpower means that allocating resources toward development directly takes away from our community engagement and marketing efforts. (Don't love it!)

All of these things are important, and we try to strike a good balance. At the end of the day, though, substantial content updates are what gamers care about most. That's our top priority with DemonCrawl. Certainly, some developers focus more on marketing or social media presence, but it's not really our style.

Most gamers already understand this stuff - you guys are super patient with us when it comes to communication turnaround times and we really appreciate it. You're an awesome bunch, truly.

Nevertheless, the reason we're explaining this is because we have embarked on something bigger than the bi-weekly content updates you may have come to expect from DemonCrawl. [b]TL;DR[/b] Don't be alarmed if there's a bit of radio silence from us in the near future.

Okay, enough rambling - full patch notes are available below. Enjoy!

---

[list][*]New Patreon rewards: Treefolk
[*]New mastery: Bookworm - [i]"Collect and study books to influence the items you will encounter throughout your quest."[/i]

[*]New daily mission: Chord Progression - [i]"Powerchord 100 times."[/i]
[*]New holograph: Explosions

[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

[list][*]Powerchording can now be given as a player stat, similar to pathfinding
[*]Updated to a newer GameMaker runtime
[*]Various backend changes (nothing to see here - we're definitely not working on a massive expansion behind the scenes or anything)
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list][*]Pendulum rework: [i]"[150 Mana] Solve 3 cells. Recharge this item whenever an orb is destroyed."[/i]
[*]Blissful Ring buffed: [i]"20% chance to spawn a heart whenever you pick up a coin."[/i]
[*]Blissful Amulet buffed: [i]"40% chance to spawn a heart whenever you pick up a coin."[/i]
[*]Dark Amulet buffed: collecting a Dark Heart will restore 3 lives instead of 1

[/list]

notes.title: v1.83 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

The first DemonCrawl update of 2022 has arrived!

We spent the last few weeks designing a new mastery called [b]Ninja[/b], a new set of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1141220/view/3108046679309017385]demonic Patreon rewards[/url], and [b]20 new holographic effects[/b]. Yes, you read that right! We have overhauled our holograph workflow and can now produce these kinds of effects in a matter of hours. 😎

We also think they look much nicer than many of the original holographs, but you can judge for yourself:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/9406e93936b4141bb07b045bcbc49aa37914c712.gif[/img]

Pretty cool, right?

Next up is the new Ninja mastery, which possesses a unique form of damage mitigation based on exposed cells. It also completely bypasses monster reveal and death effects as if you were permanently wearing [url=https://demoncrawl.com/wiki/index.php/Shinobi_Sandals]Shinobi Sandals[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/fe7faf15f02a1a3a0417e3696a586df872af1ae8.png[/img]

In our testing, it's a decently consistent mastery that doesn't require too much micromanagement. Not too tough to unlock either!

The full patch notes for v1.83 are available below. Enjoy!

---

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list]
[*]New patreon rewards: Rise of Demons
[*]New mastery: Ninja - Move with stealth and ignore monster effects
[*]New magic item: Kunai - [i]"[100 Mana] Kill target visible monster and reveal any monsters nearby."[/i]
[*]New passive item: Ninja Doll - [i]"When you activate your mastery ability, gain Shuriken equal to the number of times your ability has been activated."[/i]
[*]Updated the holograph effect engine
[*]New holograph: Waterfall

[*]New holograph: Sauna

[*]New holograph: Sonar (Prizebox Exclusive)
[*]New holograph: Vignette (Prizebox Exclusive)
[*]New holograph: Triangle Blast (Prizebox Exclusive)
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

[list]
[*]The Immutable stage mod alert now includes the name of the stage

[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Effects that trigger when a monster "spawns" are now distinct from "monster reveal" effects (e.g. Occultic Pendant)

notes.title: v1.82 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We just deployed a major update for DemonCrawl!

This patch contains a number of exciting changes, including:

[olist]
[*] [b]Proper gamepad support.[/b] Enable "Controller Mode" in the settings and you will be able to navigate through the game and various menus using directional keys. Even if you don't have a gamepad, it's pretty fun to try out "Controller Mode" on a keyboard - though maybe not as practical as a mouse! We have plans to continue improving this feature over time.

[*] [b]Extra keybindings, better keybinding support.[/b] Players who rely on their keyboard to open/flag cells no longer have to swap to the mouse to perform inputs in other menus.

[*] [b]Massive performance improvements.[/b] We have overhauled many parts of the DemonCrawl engine to great effect. These improvements will be most noticeable in large stages, or on old computers. Depending on your GPU, you might see up to 3-4x increase in FPS while idling in a large stage. Hopefully, we didn't break too many things in the process. 😊

[*] [b]New holiday content.[/b] There are 15 Christmas missions this year, a new secret stage called Igloo, and more! Check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1141220/view/5973460047031702999]our companion post[/url] for all the details.

[*] [b]Spawner rework.[/b] Sealing an inventory slot to spawn a stranger never felt very fun. Now, you can spawn the stranger for free. However, if you use a spawner too much, it will eventually break, killing all visible strangers of its type.
[/olist]

Full patch notes for v1.82 are available below. Enjoy!

---

[h2]Christmas Event[/h2]

[list][*]Santa's back! Don't get on his bad side
[*]Every quest now has a special Igloo - home to Mrs. Claus
[*]Complete new holiday missions to earn 4 new avatars and a new inventory skin
[*]Expanded holiday questline, 15 in total: you can now complete missions from previous years to earn the original rewards, or tokens if you completed them before
[*]Some of the older holiday missions have been tweaked and rearranged for better flow
[*]Added 3 new avatars to Christmas Prizeboxes
[/list]

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list][*]Added gamepad support
[*]Menus now support the "Open Cell" keybind in place of left click
[*]Menus now support the "Flag Cell" keybind in place of right click
[*]Added setting: Camera Speed - [i]"The speed at which the camera moves from certain effects. Default: 10"[/i]
[*]Added setting: Gamepad Camera Boundary - [i]"The distance in cells from your gamepad cursor to the edge of the screen before the camera follows."[/i]
[*]Added setting: Gamepad Rapidfire Delay - [i]"The amount of time in steps you must hold a direction on your gamepad before the input will auto-repeat. Default: 30"[/i]
[*]Added setting: Gamepad Rapidfire Rate - [i]"The interval in steps between the input auto-repeat. Default: 10"[/i]
[*]Added setting: Gamepad Menu Toggle - [i]"Swaps the gamepad cursor between the stage board and HUD elements."[/i]
[*]Added setting: Zoom In Keybind
[*]Added setting: Zoom Out Keybind
[*]Added alternative keybinds for panning controls
[*]Added setting: Escape Menu Keybind
[*]New consumable item: Milk - [i]"Gain 1 defense. For the next 300 turns, you can powerchord Sanctified cells."[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

[list][*]Effects that pan the board, e.g. Novice III, will do so in a smoother fashion
[*]Added active state for "play quest" button as requested by the speedrun community
[*]Added blue version of the selector sprite to indicate that it's piloted by the AI (for the Arena or Tutorial)
[*]Optimized script that checks if an object is outside of view - it now applies to nearly all kinds of board objects
[*]Improved cell performance
[*]Improved performance of UI group engine
[*]Improved monster count UI performances
[*]Minor optimizations for UI scrollbar elements
[*]Improved performance of player HUD
[*]Optimized stage creation script
[*]Improved panning performance
[*]Improved cell performance
[*]Improved orb performance
[*]Minor improvements to numeric abbreviation script
[*]Minor optimizations for the script that handles holographic effects
[*]Added error sound effect to certain notifications
[*]Added simple gamepad button images in the Options screen
[*]Updated credits
[*]Minor adjustment to the appearance of text input elements
[*]Updated GameMaker runtime to the latest version[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list][*]Spawner rework: [i]"Spawn [stranger type]. Has a chance to break instead, killing all visible strangers of this type."[/i]
[*]Bubble Solution buff: [i]"Trap all visible objects on numbered cells in bubbles, then restore 1 life for each object trapped this way."[/i]
[*]Pufferfish buff: reduced mana cost from 200 to 160
[*]Binoculars buff: increased the rate of spawning Minions by 25%
[*]Regift nerf: increased the price from 10 to 12 coins[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list][*]Fixed a rare crash related to dying in a Misty stage
[*]Fixed an issue with hybrid stage skins that was causing the empty cell sprite to load on a much larger surface than necessary
[*]Fixed an issue related to a change in "is_real" behavior in new GameMaker runtime[/list]

notes.title: v1.81 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We just deployed a new content patch for DemonCrawl! This update includes 5 new items, 3 new daily missions, some performance improvements and a [b]secret[/b] stage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/73ca0145a1e6e98d4b36af92b738bed151b01a7d.png[/img]

The Friendly Mimic is an awesome new passive designed by Mythic Patron [b]CaineSenpai[/b]. It transforms your chests into strong familiars that help you complete stages!

While designing this item, CaineSenpai made an important note:

[i]"If you lost the ability to open the chests [and] got the item early game it wouldn't be very fun locking you from any new items"[/i]

We agreed on that, and decided to give the Friendly Mimic a bit of special functionality: even though it converts your chests to familiars, you can still open them as if they were regular chests! It's a lot of fun.

Full patch notes are available below. Enjoy!

---

[*]New passive item: War Hawk - [i]"Whenever a familiar dies or kills a monster, gain a soul. Spawn two familiars at the start of each stage."[/i]

[*]New daily mission: Hallowed Ground - [i]"Apply Sanctified or Cursed to 20 cells."[/i]
[*]Added a secret stage...
[*]Updated GameMaker runtime to the latest version
[/list]

[h2]Arena[/h2]

[list][*]Detour screen transitions have been streamlined a bit for comfort[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

[list][*]Improved performance on shop screens
[*]Familiar sprites will persist between stage loads[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list][*]Priest's upper price limit has been lowered from 40 to 30 coins
[*]Instead of sanctifying cells, the Priest will now get rid of any negative morality you may have
[*]Drill rework: [i]"[90 Mana] For a number of turns equal to the value of target numbered cell, spawn loot in that cell each turn and conceal surrounding 5x5 area."[/i]
[*]Pickaxe price increased from 14 to 15
[/list]

[list][*]Fixed crash related to Ectoplasm

[/list]

notes.title: v1.79 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We just deployed a large content patch for DemonCrawl!

This update includes over 20 new items, a monster drop table overhaul, a rework for the Wizard mastery, and various balance changes.

Among these new items are two sets of armor - [b]Lightstone[/b] and [b]Police[/b] armor. Check out the Lightstone set below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/6f4009a234e8ba3516a03427fb5fde5124b8b3b8.png[/img]

We are also hard at work on an even larger patch, which is why we haven't been very active on social media lately. We can't say much about it yet, but we think it will be 100% worth the wait!

Full patch notes for v1.79 are available below. Enjoy!

---

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list]
[*]New patreon rewards: Strange Denizens II
[*]Every monster now has an expanded item drop table
[*]New legendary item: Badge of Infamy - [i]"Whenever a monster dies or flees, reduce the monster count of all other stages."[/i]
[*]New legendary item: Giga Mana Potion - [i]"When you gain this item, fully charge and duplicast your magic items. When you lose this item, deplete your mana."[/i]
[*]New magic item: Flashlight - [i]"[120 Mana] Reveal target cell and cause its monster to flee, then remove Dark mod from the current stage."[/i]
[*]New magic item: Magic Minion - [i]"[100 Mana] Use Minion. If you're about to take damage, this item will automatically discharge to deflect 1 damage."[/i]
[*]New magic item: Stopwatch - [i]"[150 Mana] Pass a number of turns equal to the number of counters on your most recent status effect."[/i]
[*]New magic item: Library Card - [i]"[300 Mana] Visit a Library from the overworld. Libraries will have an additional research subject."[/i]
[*]New passive item: Beacon - [i]"Whenever a monster is revealed by an effect, it has a 50% chance to flee."[/i]
[*]New passive item: Handcuffs - [i]"When you leave a stage, bubble your familiars. When a monster tries to flee, it becomes your familiar instead."[/i]
[*]New passive item: Wolf Pelt - [i]"Whenever you gain an item, a random visible monster flees."[/i]
[*]New passive item: Scorpion Tail - [i]"Kill all visible living objects at the end of each stage, applying Toxic to their cells."[/i]
[*]New passive item: Deciphering Rune - [i]"Whenever you target a visible cell with an item, solve a number of random cells equal to the value of the target."[/i]
[*]New passive item: Dog Tag - [i]"When you enter a stage, gain souls equal to your number of Minions. If you don't have any, gain a Minion instead."[/i]
[*]New consumable item: Golden Rose - [i]"Take 1 damage and gain 10 coins."[/i]
[*]New consumable item: Monster Spray - [i]"For 100 turns, monsters have a chance to flee instead of attacking. The chance is equal to the number of turns left on this effect."[/i]
[*]New armor: Lightstone Helmet - [i]"When equipped, reveal target column. Fortify whenever a monster is revealed by an effect."[/i]
[*]New armor: Lightstone Chestplate - [i]"Fortify by 2 whenever a monster is revealed by an effect."[/i]
[*]New armor: Lightstone Boots - [i]"Every 10 turns, reveal all cells around the cell you open."[/i]
[*]New armor: Police Hat - [i]"Fortify whenever a monster flees. When equipped, all visible monsters flee."[/i]
[*]New armor: Police Vest - [i]"Fortify by 2 whenever a monster flees. After taking monster damage, all nearby visible monsters flee."[/i]
[*]New armor: Police Boots - [i]"Visible monsters near the cells you open will flee."[/i]
[*]New omen: Grease - [i]"Every 20 turns, all visible monsters that are not in the quadrant of the cell you open will flee. Whenever a monster flees, add it to the next stage."[/i]
[*]New sigil impulse: Just - [i]"When a monster dies or flees..."[/i]
[*]New sigil impulse: Focus - [i]"When you target a cell with a value of x or greater..."[/i]
[*]New sigil reflex: Run - [i]"...x random visible monsters flee."[/i]
[*]New sigil reflex: Cleanse - [i]"...remove auras from x random cells."[/i]
[*]Added "flee" as a library research subject
[*]Updated GameMaker runtime to latest version
[*]Updated BktGlitch shader to latest version
[*]Updated default leaderboard version to 1.79
[*]Added a couple hidden easter eggs
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

[list][*]Refactored monster drop code for better performance
[*]Gambler uses emotes now
[*]Improved visual clarity of Ancient Coin effect
[*]Added dictionary entry for "flee"[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list][*]Wizard II rework: [i]"Whenever you cast a magic item, gain a soul."[/i]
[*]Wizard III rework: [i]"Transform your cheapest magic item into one that's worth more, up to twice the item's original value."[/i]
[*]Banker I buff: [i]"Begin the quest with 15 extra coins."[/i]
[*]Barbarian III buff: charge cost reduced from 4 to 3
[*]Demolitionist III buff: charge cost reduced from 4 to 3
[*]Mantis buff: [i]"When you enter a stage, gain 2 souls for every stage mod."[/i]
[*]Trust Buster price decreased from 41 to 37 coins
[*]Elixir price decreased from 22 to 20 coins
[*]Fairy price decreased from 18 to 12
[*]War Paint price increased from 12 to 13 coins
[*]Iron Sceptre price increased from 13 to 16 coins
[*]Giga Health Potion Token Shop price decreased from 1000 to 800 Tokens
[*]Renamed Voucher to Gift Card and gave it the "card" tag
[*]Chisel can now upgrade a ground item to its magic equivalent[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list][*]Fixed an issue affecting stage shaders
[*]Fixed an issue with stranger item drops not saving to disk
[*]Fixed an issue with Eternal Jelly not randomizing its results properly
[*]Fixed a visual glitch related to the particle manager[/list]

notes.title: v1.78 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We just released a new patch for DemonCrawl that contains a number of improvements for the Arena gamemode!

These improvements include 3 new homelands, 3 arena mods, new emotes/sign parts and various balance changes. Also, we are in the process of fine-tuning the autosweeper code to help it deal with certain boards more intelligently (e.g. it will try to avoid clicking burning cells when possible.) You can expect a follow-up patch sometime next week!

The full changelog for v1.78 is available below.

---

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list][*]New Patreon rewards: Alien Lifeforms
[*]Updated GameMaker runtime to the latest version[/list]

[h2]Arena[/h2]

[list][*]New homeland: Tribe - [i]"Whenever the owner casts a magic item, it is cast here as well."[/i]
[*]New homeland: Sewer - [i]"Whenever you lose an item, send it in a bubble to the owner."[/i]
[*]New homeland: Prefecture - [i]"All heart drops are converted to Dark Hearts. Whenever a Dark Heart is collected, permanently increase the max stage power."[/i]
[*]Island homeland buff: [i]"Any coins lost in this stage are sent to the owner at the end of the round."[/i]
[*]Shrine homeland buff: [i]"At the end of the round, the owner gains souls equal to the amount of damage taken in the homeland."[/i]
[*]Graveyard homeland nerf: [i]"Whenever a player dies, add the minimum power of their homeland to your homeland."[/i]
[*]Brink homeland nerf: [i]"Whenever this stage gains a tier 1 mod, it gains the same mod again."[/i]
[*]New T1 arena mod: Peddler - [i]"Stage contains an additional stranger. Whenever a stranger spawns, attempt to activate it."[/i]
[*]New T2 arena mod: Malice - [i]"Stage contains 3 additional Dark Hearts times the homeland tier."[/i]
[*]New T3 arena mod: Downgrade - [i]"At the end of the stage, reduce your homeland tier by 1."[/i]
[*]Reboot mod tier lowered from 3 to 2
[*]Updated sprite for Mill mod
[*]Lowered the re-roll price from 3 to 2 coins
[*]12 new emotes
[*]32 new sign parts[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

[list][*]Redesigned sprites for Duster and Moon[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list][*]Nightmare mod difficulty rating increased from 3 to 4
[*]Lofty mod difficulty rating increased from 3 to 4
[*]Snowglobe buff: duration increased from 3 to 5 turns
[*]Capitalism buff: [i]"If you spend at least 25 coins in an Item Shop, it remains open."[/i]
[*]Unstable Compound and its divine variant have an additional effect: [i]"Whenever an aura is removed, the cell explodes in a 3x3 area."[/i]
[*]Troll Cross price reduced from 29 to 23
[*]Troll Cross mana cost increased from 100 to 150
[*]Lowered Doctor's debt cost by a few coins[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list][*]Fixed an issue related to Human III mastery activation check
[*]Fixed an issue related to the Arena AI and the Ominous mod[/list]

notes.title: v1.77 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We just released a new content patch for DemonCrawl!

This update includes [b]6 new items[/b], an engine improvement that allows us to create [b]consumable items with targeted effects[/b], several [b]redesigned sprites[/b] and [b]balance changes[/b].

Also, you can now create parties in Arena by inviting people from your Steam friends list! This feature is still a work in progress, so you may need to be a bit gentle with it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/5dd997dbf9f20b6c509f58f022a2238c6f631bab.png[/img]

Full patch notes are below. Enjoy!

P.S. The Summer Event has drawn to a close. Thank you to all those who participated and provided feedback on the holiday mechanics!

---

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list][*]The engine now supports using consumable items on target cells
[*]New legendary item: Giga Health Potion - [i]"When you gain this item, restore your life to max and gain 10 souls. When you lose this item, cut your max lives in half."[/i]
[*]New consumable item: Fire Bomb - [i]"Apply Burning to a 3x3 area around target cell."[/i]
[*]New consumable item: Thunder Bomb - [i]"Apply Electric to a 3x3 area around target cell."[/i]
[*]New consumable item: Stick - [i]"Reveal target cell. If it has a monster, kill it."[/i]
[*]New consumable item: Flashbang - [i]"Reveal quadrant around target cell."[/i]
[*]New omen: Caustic Wand - [i]"Whenever you target a cell with an item, take damage equal to the value of the cell."[/i]
[*]Added option to change a few pronouns in toasts and other gameplay messages to female equivalent[/list]

[h2]Arena[/h2]

[list][*]Implemented party system (work in progress)[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

[list][*]Redesigned sprites for Rewards Card, Parasol, Gravedigger, Rainbow Dust, Nanobot and Drone[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list][*]Demon Seed buff: [i]"Add a random stage mod to the selected stage. Then, gain souls equal to your number of omens."[/i]
[*]Bomb rework: [i]"Explode target numbered cell in a 3x3 area."[/i]
[*]Ice Bomb rework: [i]"Apply Frozen to a 3x3 area around target cell."[/i]
[*]Most fish items are now targetable
[*]Removed the word "magic" from the descriptions of items that adjust targetable item radius, as they can affect consumable items too
[*]The status effect limit has been increased from 48 to 100
[*]Increased difficulty rating of Double mod from 1 to 2
[*]Excalibur Token Shop price reduced from 1000 to 600
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list][*]Improved performance of Super Mana Potion[/list]

notes.title: DemonCrawl Arena Launches on July 1st!
notes.content:
Hi folks,

Great news! After several months of development, DemonCrawl Arena will finally enter its Open Beta phase next week on [b]July 1st[/b].

[h3]What is DemonCrawl Arena?[/h3]

DemonCrawl Arena is a new gamemode where you compete against 7 other players in an online Battle Royale!

It will launch with two divisions, [b]Autosweeper[/b] and [b]Manual[/b] division. The former features an "AI autosolver" that will handle the minesweeping for you. This will allow you to concentrate on item management  and other strategies. It's our take on the autobattler genre.

Manual division is more competitive, giving you full control over your game boards.

Watch the gameplay video below for a closer look:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ky0uDQT8p0Y

[h3]Who can join the Open Beta?[/h3]

Anyone with a Steam copy of DemonCrawl will be able to participate in the Open Beta. This is effectively a "soft launch" of the new gamemode for all desktop platforms (Windows, Mac, and Linux). Mobile players will have to wait a bit longer. [b]There is no signup required.[/b]

[h3]Are there any rewards for playing Arena?[/h3]

Yes! You can unlock new avatars after reaching a certain number of wins and rating (ELO) in either gamemode. We plan to rotate these rewards out on a seasonal basis.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d616002b04a519b7577eb8bec528573d35daa679.png[/img]

You will also earn AP (Arena Points) at the end of every match. AP is automatically redeemed for Prizeboxes containing cosmetic items, similar to Beyond Mode.

[h3]Will you wipe online progress between the Open Beta and Full Release?[/h3]

Unlikely, but possible.

We have no plans to wipe player progress or ratings, and would only do so in the event of a major technical issue that forces our hand.

[h3]Can I play Arena for free?[/h3]

[b]Yes, anyone who owns DemonCrawl will be able to play Arena without any additional charges![/b] We have no plans to introduce subscription fees at this time.

That said, we do need to cover our server costs. You will have the option of purchasing an [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1548200/DemonCrawl__Arena_Plus/?beta=0]Arena Plus package on Steam[/url] that grants additional perks [b]in multiplayer only[/b] - this DLC will not affect your singleplayer experience. These perks will include a custom sign editor, expressive emotes, extra homeland/mastery slots to pick from, and additional AP per game.

[b]Those of you who have generously supported us on Patreon will be receiving free copies of the Arena Plus DLC.[/b] Keep an eye on your Patreon inbox next week for your Steam key. <3

[h3]Can I play Arena with my friends?[/h3]

Yes, we're working on the party system as we speak and hope to have it ready on day one!

---

That's all for now! We will have another big announcement post for you very soon... Arena's not the only thing we've been working on. ;)

DemonCrawl is available for 50% off during the Steam Summer sale. Get your copy today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1141220/DemonCrawl/

Hi folks,

We just released an update for DemonCrawl that includes 6 new items, a save file repair system, and performance improvements related to GameMaker (the engine that DemonCrawl is made with.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/2a7ff4c5ad317b67c32bd5b22a3617606cb9fe8e.png[/img]

The save repair system can analyze your save files--including backups--to recover your progress in the event of data corruption. Such problems are rare but can occur for a variety of reasons, including hardware failure, app crashes, and hiccups in the cloud service. Until now, we have done our best to manually repair save files that players have sent to our support desk, but as our playerbase increases, so does our email load - we are at the point now where an automated solution is necessary. 

We believe this new system will be able to handle the majority of save issues, but even when it can't, it will generate a log file with diagnostic information called "_repairs.txt" inside of your %localappdata% folder. If you're having issues with your save, you should consult this file for clues about the underlying cause.

On another note, we are making great progress toward the multiplayer Arena gamemode - we expect to have it ready in a matter of weeks. Until then, we will include any Arena changes in the stable patch notes so you can get a better sense of our development.

Enjoy!

---

[*]New omen: Broken Pocket - [i]"You cannot use items that you have more than one of."[/i]
[*]Added experimental save repair system
[*]Default leaderboard version updated to v1.74
[/list]

[*]Added a few item crafting recipes that utilize holiday artifacts
[/list]

notes.content:
Hi folks,

A new update for DemonCrawl is now available! This update includes a Cullstone rework and a new omen called Rust. iOS players should see better temperatures with this patch.

We have also been making a number of changes to the online Arena gamemode. Although Arena is still in beta, we are including it in the patch notes below to give you a better sense of how its development is coming along.

notes.title: v1.70 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We just released a big update for DemonCrawl that includes a new mastery called [b]Hypnotist[/b], the fierce [b]Scrapper[/b] boss, and [b]15[/b] new items!

[i](After a lengthy conversion process, DemonCrawl is now running on GameMaker v2.3. This is a requirement for getting our iOS port approved on the App Store - you can [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1141220/announcements/detail/3022450291321325520]read more about the situation here[/url]. We plan to re-submit DemonCrawl to Apple's review team in the next couple days.)[/i]

Let's take a look at some of the new content in v1.70!

---

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/483737f661cb1ea2ce30eeca853c3cf63e2172d5.png[/img]

When making a mistake as the Hypnotist, you won't receive damage right away - instead, you'll get a 3-turn status counter, giving you time to either mitigate the attack or brace for impact.

Hypnotist also has the ability to lengthen status effect counters. This pairs well with the delayed damage mechanic, but also has great combo potential with status-based items like [url=https://demoncrawl.com/wiki/index.php/Candy]Candy[/url] or [url=https://demoncrawl.com/wiki/index.php/Truthsayer_Quill]Truthsayer Quill[/url].

---

Now, help us give a warm welcome to the newest member of DemonCrawl's boss lineup:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/7a574760b257aceac20fd1da49a6748b53d795e2.png[/img]

[b]Scrapper[/b] will load up your inventory with "Junk," a new omen that itself produces more Junk. Things can quickly spiral out of control, putting you in danger of taking 1 damage every turn if you can't free up some space!

---

Finally, we have added [b]15 new items to DemonCrawl[/b], many of which were directly inspired by suggestions we received on [url=https://discord.gg/wqkWcc5]Discord[/url]! 

Among these items are two complete sets of armor, Bubble and Vampiric Armor. Here's a closer look at the former:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/b01c06bf5dd9bc92bbe2405b2fbc716727d7866f.png[/img]

As you can imagine, Waterboy is pretty stoked about this...

Full patch notes below. Enjoy!

---

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list][*]Upgraded GameMaker runtime to v2.3
[*]Upgraded tweening library to latest version
[*]New mastery: Hypnotist - [i]"Use the power of hypnosis to delay monster damage and manipulate your status effects!"[/i]
[*]New boss: Scrapper - [i]"Drowns you in Junk!"[/i]
[*]New magic item: Apple Bonsai - [i]"[50 Mana] After 40 turns, gain an Apple."[/i] (Suggested by community - attribution pending)
[*]New passive item: Hypnowatch - [i]"Delay monster damage by 1 turn."[/i] (Suggested by community - attribution pending)
[*]New passive item: Wishing Coin - [i]"Guarantees 3 Wishpools per stage. You may right-click to throw this item into a Wishpool, increasing its charges by 5."[/i]
[*]New passive item: Baseball Bat - [i]"You may click a projectile to rotate its direction of travel, clockwise."[/i] (Suggested by player LL99)
[*]New passive item: Dentures - [i]"Elders are more common. You may right click an Elder to charge your mastery instead."[/i] (Suggested by player elmarhoppieland)
[*]New consumable item: Starfruit - [i]"Apply Ethereal to the visible cell or cells with the highest value."[/i] (Suggested by community - attribution pending)
[*]New consumable item: Butter - [i]"Drop all of your items on the ground."[/i]
[*]New armor: Vampiric Helmet - [i]"Fortify by 2 whenever you lose life."[/i]
[*]New armor: Vampiric Chestplate - [i]"Whenever you lose life, fortify by triple the amount lost."
[*]New armor: Vampiric Boots - "Every 40 cells opened, lose life equal to the value of the cell you just clicked, then fortify by twice the amount."[/i]
[*]New armor: Bubble Helmet - [i]"Fortify whenever you pop a bubble. If this armor survives damage, bubble it."[/i]
[*]New armor: Bubble Chestplate - [i]"Fortify whenever you pop a bubble."[/i]
[*]New armor: Bubble Boots - [i]"Every 50 cells opened, bubble all of your armor if you just clicked on a 3 or greater."[/i]
[*]New omen: Junk - [i]"Every 100 turns, gain Junk."[/i]
[*]New omen: Mildew - [i]"Bubble the first 3 items in your inventory. When you pop a bubble, destroy its contents."[/i]
[*]New stage mod: Galvanized - [i]"Whenever you gain or lose a stat, increase the amount gained or lost by the number of stage mods."[/i]
[*]New boss mod: Necromantic - [i]"50% chance to spawn a monster whenever a monster is killed."[/i]
[*]New paint: Whiteout
[*]New paint: Blueberry Buzz
[*]Improved flexibility of "PRE_DMG" trigger
[*]Improved flexibility of stranger activation script; items like Sledgehammer will now synergize with items like Merchant Amulet[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

[list]
[*]Prophet III will state your new token count in the activation toast
[*]Added toast notifications for petting your Pet Rock
[*]Status effects will now display held values next to their tooltip
[*]Status effects will be more resilient to future updates[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

notes.title: v1.69 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

DemonCrawl's new update is finally here! v1.69 introduces new items, avatars, balance changes, and more. Full patch notes available below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/338a786438c1f83ef4523a46f1f821078f54809a.png[/img]

---

[h2]Special Avatar[/h2]

We have worked with the excellent [url=youtube.com/user/wanderbots]Wanderbot[/url] to create a new avatar for DemonCrawl:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/a81c9ec564a893103bbaf6bfd840e3af71978cbb.png[/img]

Wanderbot showcases a wide variety of games, including your favorite little minesweeper RPG. His commentary is always on point, and he's really good at delivering constructive feedback for game devs.

Many players have personally reached out to us and let us know that they discovered DemonCrawl through Wanderbot's channel, for which we are tremendously grateful. We hope we can show our appreciation with this custom avatar! (Note - Wanderbot will provide the unlock code through his channels. We may eventually include it in this post, with his permission. We let content creators decide how they would like to distribute their avatars.)

[i]Check out [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/wanderbots]Wanderbot on YouTube[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/wanderbot]Twitch[/url] today![/i]

---

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list][*]New Patreon rewards [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1141220/view/3022450291323782056]Den of Dragons[/url]
[*]New passive item: Book of Gold - [i]"Pick up hearts at full life to gain 10 coins."[/i]
[*]New passive item: Book of Maps - [i]"Pick up hearts at full life to gain 1% pathfinding."[/i]
[*]New consumable item: Perfume - [i]"Every 20 turns, spawn a heart."[/i]
[*]Added "Book" as a Library research subject
[*]Added "Pathfinding" as a Library research subject
[*]Added "Morality" as a Library research subject
[*]Overhauled a number of backend systems in preparation for Arena mode
[*]New streamer avatar: "Wanderbot" (https://twitch.tv/wanderbot)
[*]New avatar: "Archbishop" by Sam Caron
[*]New community avatar: "Worm" by TEAM WORM
[*]New community avatar: "The Goat" by Vospi and Cubear
[*]Mobile: Redesigned the "Full Game Unlock" screen
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list][*]Book of Combat rework: [i]"Pick up hearts at full life to kill a random monster, revealing it if necessary."[/i]
[*]Book of Necromancy rework: [i]"Pick up hearts at full life to gain Bones."[/i]
[*]The old Book of Necromancy effect has been moved to another item called Zombie Charm: [i]"When you bury Bones, spawn a familiar in the same cell." [/i]
[*]Book of Truth cost reduced from 18 to 14
[*]Snake Skin can now drop items into hidden cells
[*]Toxic mod aura density reduced from 15% to 10%
[*]Illusory mod difficulty tier increased from 1 to 2
[*]The autosolver now takes obscured cell values into account
[*]The autosolver now takes Frozen cells into account
[*]The autosolver will somewhat take gleaned cells into account
[*]Mobile: significantly reduced prices of token microtransactions
[*]Mobile: you can now purchase an instant respawn after your first Game Over in a quest (only available in Normal difficulty)[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list][*]Fixed Appetizer toast showing up even when you spend less than 5 coins
[*]Improved logic for horizontal scroll UI
[*]Bosses can no longer spawn over immutable landmarks like stairwells
[*]Fixed Third Eye destroying objects on 0-value cells
[*]Fixed an issue where a low amount of pathfinding could prevent end-of-stage autoflagging
[*]Using the open cell keybind on an empty burning cell will no longer burn you twice
[*]Sacrificing an object with cursed aura no longer cancels attempt to collect loot from a burning cell
[*]Implemented workaround for rare crash related to orb mutations
[*]Fixed a rare crash related to Nemes
[*]Entering a Mystic Statue will now correctly activate "stage leave effects" such as Doctor payment
[*]Divine Blood Magic no longer activates Warlock II when there are no visible monsters
[*]Fixed a crash related to using Snowglobe on a boss
[*]Added failsafe for familiar movement to prevent rare crash
[*]Mutant can no longer apply mutations to more than 3 Cankers at the start of the quest, for example through a Hero Trial
[*]Mobile: fixed return button on virtual keyboard not working for certain devices
[*]Fixed activation issue with Burnt Marshmallow
[*]Fixed memory leak related to Rainbow Rope
[*]Fixed possible memory leaks related to Makeshift Weapon, Rainbow Trout, Chaos Portal, Dark Ink, Quest for Sin, Anvil, Mirror, and Global Warming emblem
[*]Speculative fix for a rare crash related to the Pure boss mod
[*]Fixed a rare crash related to spawning certain strangers in bubbles and passing a turn in the same step[/list]

[b]Hotfix #1 @ 6:00 PM EST - [/b] Fixed a crash related to the "ETC" tab of the Codex. Linux build now available, Mac to follow.

---

[h1]iOS Delay Pt. 2[/h1]

Despite our best efforts to have the iOS port ready, we ran into a major setback in Apple's approval process. Unfortunately, we have no choice but to postpone the iOS release once again. We don't make this decision lightly.

While we won't announce another release date at this time, we feel that we owe our players an apology as well as a full explanation for the delay.

The following is a technical recap of the situation. Please keep in mind that we are not trying to shift the blame here - we take full responsibility for failing to meet our deadline. That said, we feel it is important to keep our players in the loop when things don't go as planned.

DemonCrawl's iOS port was finished well before the original launch date. The game ran great on our test devices, and we felt confident that we would be able to pass Apple's review for quality control.

To the contrary, Apple declined our submission on the grounds that microtransactions were not working properly. It turned out that DemonCrawl could not retrieve a list of MTX products from Apple's servers. We assumed that we must have made a mistake in our implementation somewhere and spent the next several days reviewing our code.

Our investigation turned up short.

After several more days of going back and forth with Apple's support team, the microtransactions suddenly began working. This was great news, but it cost us a lot of time and we still aren't sure what exactly fixed the problem - our best guess is that there is some undocumented verification process for new iOS microtransactions.

After thoroughly testing our MTX, we re-submitted our iOS build to Apple and announced the one-week delay. We figured this would give Apple enough time to conduct their second review (this usually takes around 24 hours) and give us enough time to address any other problems that came up.

DemonCrawl was declined again. The review team stated that our microtransactions were causing a crash, which we could not reproduce.

We eventually discovered a probable cause - the GameMaker IAP (in-app purchase) extension was known to be buggy on very particular setups. An update for the extension was released a few months ago, but we cannot install it because it is only available for the cutting-edge GameMaker v2.3, which would require complete DemonCrawl project conversion. This is no small task.

[b]TL;DR[/b] We are in a tricky situation because we just learned that [b]it is probably impossible to publish an iOS app made with a version of GameMaker older than v2.3[/b]. DemonCrawl is made with v2.2. Upgrading to v2.3 requires a significant overhaul of DemonCrawl's codebase. 

Curiously, [url=https://help.yoyogames.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002237257-iOS-and-tvOS-Using-The-IAP-Extension]GameMaker's iOS documentation does not mention the v2.3 requirement,[/url] so it caught us off guard at the very last minute. Still, we hold ourselves responsible for the delay as we should not have announced the iOS launch date as early as we did.

---

[h1]What's next?[/h1]

We are now beginning the process of upgrading DemonCrawl to GameMaker v2.3. Thousands of lines of code need to be rewritten, but we are making good progress. We hope to have it ready for beta testing by the start of next week.

Once our beta testers have had some time with it, we will prepare another submission for Apple and keep you apprised of any developments. We will not announce a new iOS launch date until we are 100% sure there will be no further obstacles in the review process. Thank you for understanding.

notes.title: v1.68 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We just released a big DemonCrawl patch that features 2 new bosses, 5 new boss mods, new items and more! [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1141220/announcements/detail/2913231583210966578]Please check out this companion post for a complete overview.[/url]

Enjoy!

---

[h2]Robot Uprising II[/h2]

[list][*]New boss: UNIT-8055 - [i]"Copies the effects of other bosses and empowers itself with Electric cells."[/i]
[*]New boss: Automaton - [i]"Spawns with 3 boss mods and acquires more as you make mistakes."[/i]
[*](Patreon) 6 new Robot avatars
[*](Patreon) New inventory: Metal Fingers
[*]Original Robot Uprising avatars are available again for a limited time
[*]Bonus avatar: Metal Face[/list]

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list][*]New passive item: Third Eye - [i]"When you open half of all empty cells, unobscure any values and destroy all objects on numbered cells."[/i]
[*]New consumable item: Green Dye - [i]"You will only find consumable items until you gain a consumable item."[/i] (This and other Dye items created by raisins77 - we just changed the names)
[*]New consumable item: Blue Dye - [i]"You will only find magic items until you gain a magic item."[/i]
[*]New consumable item: Yellow Dye - [i]"You will only find legendary items until you gain a legendary item."[/i]
[*]New consumable item: Gray Dye - [i]"You will only find passive items until you gain a passive item."[/i]
[*]New omen: Red Dye - [i]"You will only find omens. Lose this item when you gain an omen."[/i]
[*]New boss mod: Blooming - [i]"When you open half of all empty cells, collect 3 Dark Hearts."[/i]
[*]New boss mod: Pure - [i]"Removes auras as it travels."[/i]
[*]New boss mod: Corrupt - [i]"Spawn 2 Dark Hearts each turn."[/i]
[*]New boss mod: Roundabout - [i]"Lose 1% pathfinding whenever you discover a 4 or greater."[/i]
[*]New boss mod: Landlord - [i]"Lose a random stat whenever you make a turn in the same quadrant as the boss."[/i]
[*]New Lv3 emblem: Reality Check[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

[list]
[*]Updated Pathfinding toast to include the Pathfinding sprite
[*]Added a toast for failing a Mythic Emblem roll
[*]Using a duplicate item will now consume the one you clicked on, rather than the first copy in your inventory - this is an experimental change that may require further testing
[*]Updated the description of the Timeless mod for clarity
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Added UNIT-8055 as the likely boss of a few existing emblems
[*]Negative pathfinding now gives you a chance to finish the stage without marking it as complete
[*]Excalibur buff: [i]"You can kill monsters and bosses if your morality is 30 or greater. Lose this item if you are immoral."[/i]
[*]Paragon Rod price increased from 80 to 100 coins
[*]Blood Magic nerf: [i]"Gain 50 mana and lose 1 life."[/i]
[*]Blood Magic price reduced from 20 to 15 coins[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fixed a rare issue that could cause mastery unlock conditions to go missing from the Token Shop
[*]Fixed a typo in the Saga sigil
[*]Fixed an issue with magic bow items not triggering certain "on magic" effects
[*]Fixed likely sigil drops for Holiday emblems
[*]Fixed "Chomp" Sigil not interpreting inventory slots correctly
[*]Fixed a possible issue in the quest cleanup routine[/list]

[list]

[*]Fixed a crash related to Blind Justice

[*]Fixed a chording issue related to an update to the autosolver
[/list]

notes.title: Robot Uprising II & More
notes.content:
Hi folks,

2021 is finally here, and we're kicking it off with several big DemonCrawl announcements! This will be a long post, so grab yourself a coffee and strap in.

We have just released DemonCrawl v1.68 - dubbed [b]Robot Uprising II[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/7efa29b086b8b5c0ab400df080542d7cdcec46db.png[/img]

[i]The machine overlords have returned in the form of [b]TWO[/b] new bosses![/i]

The twin pinnacles of Dark Science, UNIT-8055 and Automaton are equipped with sophisticated AI protocols that allow them to perfectly emulate their life-and-blood counterparts...

[list]
[*] [b]UNIT-8055[/b] will echo the effects of another boss whenever it collects a Dark Heart. By supercharging itself with Electric cells, it seeks to surpass its own creators and become the ultimate lifeform.
[*] [b]Automaton[/b] is the result of a terrifying project to mass produce artificial boss mods. It possesses rapid self-learning abilities and must be dealt with before it's too late.
[/list]

---

[h2]January Patreon Rewards[/h2]

For our Patrons, we have designed [b]6 exclusive avatars and a new inventory skin[/b]! The original Robot Uprising content is back as well, making this our largest set of Patreon rewards to date.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/db26226e6a0979d3fec05341baa2e0ed801d7aa1.png[/img]

These rewards will cycle out of rotation in a couple months, so don't miss this opportunity to score some awesome robo gear and support the continued development of DemonCrawl!

[i]v1.68 also features 6 new items, 5 new boss mods, a new emblem, and several quality of life improvements. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1141220/announcements/detail/2913231583211128122]Please see this post for the full patch notes[/url].[/i]

---

[h2]iOS Port[/h2]

[url=https://twitter.com/ThereforeGames/status/1342249195508535298]We have been working to bring DemonCrawl to iOS[/url] for quite some time, and we're finally on the home stretch!

We are pleased to announce that [b]DemonCrawl will launch on the App Store on February 24th,[/b] pending any delays in the approval process.

With the addition of iOS, DemonCrawl will be available on all major desktop and mobile platforms, which means we can finally turn our attention to a [i][certain game console][/i] people have been asking about... ;-)

---

[h2]Secret Announcement...[/h2]

Last year, our main focus was the development of ports and expansions. We managed to complete 2 of each - we are really proud of that, and we couldn't have done it without your support!

Now we are shifting gears a bit. [b]In 2021, we want to focus our efforts on additional gamemodes.[/b]

We have [b]three[/b] ambitious gamemodes planned, one of which is already well underway. We expect it to enter beta sometime in February, around the same time as the iOS launch.

We will unveil more details about this mysterious gamemode in the coming weeks, but for now let's just say it's a real game-changer and may well surprise you.

---

[h2]Bonus Avatar[/h2]

Yesterday, we were deeply saddened to learn of the passing of MF DOOM, an incredible artist [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SiYDJ432b0U]whose music[/url] and witty lyricism served as a great source of inspiration to so many - myself included. His work has had a profound impact on me both creatively and personally, and it's hard to see him go.

We are honoring his memory with the following DemonCrawl avatar:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/b46cf2bf30399a941590f625500de2c4c20b7022.png[/img]

You can obtain the Metal Mask avatar by entering code "ALLCAPS" into the Token Shop. The avatar will be available indefinitely.


Best,
Eric at Therefore Games
