notes.title: v1.66 Patch Notes - Christmas 2020
notes.content:
Hi folks,

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1141220/announcements/detail/2912105124640581716]DemonCrawl's Christmas Event is finally here[/url], and with it comes a major game update!

Today, we are releasing 2 new masteries (Warlock and Human), 25 new items, a morality system, new Hero Trial mechanics and more™. Read on for the full patch notes!

A heartfelt thank-you to all of our Patrons and players who make it possible for us to continue developing free DemonCrawl updates. We hope you look forward to the exciting content we have planned for 2021!

---

[h2]Christmas Event[/h2]
[list][*]Complete the holiday questline to earn 4 new avatars and a new inventory skin
[*]21 additional holiday avatars are available in prizeboxes
[*]Item Shops sell Giftwrap for 20 coins
[*]Earn tokens by donating Presents to strangers
[*]It's so cold that some strangers got trapped in ice
[*]Added mysterious Soft Snow item...
[*]Added Christmas Special Chest
[*]Added last year's Christmas avatars to prizeboxes
[*]Added last year's Christmas inventory to Token Shop
[*]Added a new [i]~secret stage~[/i]
[*]2 new Divine items
[*]New holiday paint: White Christmas
[*]Minor visual improvements to some of last year's Christmas avatars
[/list]

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list][*]New mastery: Human - [i]"Use your morality to call upon the forces of good or evil."[/i]
[*]New mastery: Warlock - [i]"Sacrifice life to create Cursed cells and harness the power of magic." [/i](Heavily inspired by ideas from community members Emberflame and Egg)
[*]Added Morality mechanic: many common actions will either increase or decrease your morality
[*]3 new legendary items
[*]4 new magic items
[*]5 new passive items
[*]10 new consumable items
[*]3 new omens
[*]New special chest: Radioactive Chest - [i]"This cell gains Toxic. Spread Toxic when Poison activates. Reveal Toxic cells and kill any living objects within when you open this chest. This chest contains Poison."[/i]
[*]New stage mod: Righteous - [i]"Lose 5 morality when you enter the stage. If your morality is negative at the end of the stage, lose all legendary items and gain an omen. If positive, lose all omens and gain a legendary."[/i]
[*]Added "Use Classic Flag Icon" to Gameplay Settings
[*]Added "Don't Scare Me" to Gameplay Settings (removes blood and spooky cutscenes)
[*]Desktop only: added keybind for toggling in-game audio (default "M")
[*]Hold Shift while pressing the audio toggle key to only affect the music track
[*]New award: Heartless - Gain points for leaving hearts behind while injured
[*]New daily mission: HEART STOPPER - [i]"Earn 100 points from Heartless awards."[/i]
[*]Added new sigils related to morality
[*]Hero Trials now have a 1-in-3 chance to feature an alternate scoring system
[*]Greatly expanded the Hero Trial effect pool[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

[list][*]Holiday items are now given a hidden tag, allowing you to search for them in the Codex by holiday name
[*]Added simple animation for changes to properties like morality
[*]The window scale setting will now update in real time to prevent players from accidentally setting it too high
[*]The help menu scrollbar now advances by only 1 row per tick
[*]Minor tweaks to Pufferfish sprite
[*]Added tooltip for Masteries and Special Chests to indicate how many you have unlocked
[*]Updated Sigil icon in the loadout editor
[*]Updated True Ending dialogue
[*]Darkened background during credits sequence of the True Ending for legibility
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list][*]Library can no longer generate items that cost less than 1
[*]Mystic Statue rewards are now provided at level completion rather than when you exit the completed level
[*]You can no longer apply an aura to a cell that already has the same aura
[*]Cursed aura now deflects all forms of life loss instead of just damage
[*]Shadow Siphon effect modified: [i]"Gain souls equal to the value of target visible occupied cell, then destroy its contents without triggering kill effects."[/i]
[*]Shadow Siphon price increased from 50 to 80 coins
[*]Stocking rework: [i]"[150 Mana] If your morality is positive, gain a Present. Otherwise, gain Coal."[/i]
[*]Wrecking Ball no longer reports as a completed effect if it could not find an object to destroy
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list][*]Fixed an issue with the item loss trigger when activated via item transformation
[*]Fixed a crash related to updating keybinds
[*]Fixed a rare crash related to the "conceal stats" variable
[*]Fixed a potential memory leak related to Quest for Piety
[*]Fixed an issue with Breadcrumbs solving more cells than intended
[*]Minor performance improvement for items that drop at random (e.g. Minions from Binoculars)
[*]Seismic mod no longer attempts to move immutable objects
[*]Fixed an issue with blowing up frozen visible monsters
[*]Fixed invalid target text for Bomb
[*]Fixed typo in Protagonist unlock strings
[*]Fixed persistent magic sparkles when restarting a quest
[*]Fixed an issue with Hero Trial inbox rewards
[*]Cursed aura no longer attempts to destroy immutable objects
[*]Standardized "USE_MAGIC" trigger to fix a few inconsistent edge cases
[*]Standardized "CLICK_MONSTER" and "CLICK_BOSS" triggers
[*]Wand of Retribution no longer gives souls for monsters that survive its effect
[/list]

[b]Hotfix #1 @ 3:30 PM EST - [/b]Fixed an issue that prevented Human mastery from unlocking.

notes.title: v1.65 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We just deployed a DemonCrawl update that includes [b]10 new items, a flexible item tag system, a new special chest, and more![/b] Check out the full patch notes below for more details.

We now plan to shift gears and begin working on one last special event for 2020 - we want it to be as big (or bigger) than our recent Halloween event, so we definitely have our work cut out for us! Also, we expect to release one more port this year. More news on that front soon.

Enjoy the patch!

---

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list]
[*]Added flexible item tagging system
[*]You can now search for items in the codex by tags
[*]Added "Weapon" as a tag
[*]Added Nomad that sells weapons
[*]New passive item: Sage - [i]"Stages grant an additional mastery charge."[/i]
[*]New passive item: Wisdom Tooth - [i]"Gain a mastery charge whenever you consume an item that isn't a consumable item. Automatically consume this item when you enter the final stage."[/i]
[*]New passive item: Crucifix - [i]"Whenever damage reduces your life to 1, gain a revive."[/i]
[*]New passive item: Battering Ram - [i]"At the start of each stage, reveal all cells near visible cells and kill any monsters within."[/i] (Inspired by an idea from raisins77)
[*]New passive item: Whetstone - [i]"Favor all weapon items. Whenever you gain a weapon, you can powerchord any cell for 5 turns."[/i]
[*]New magic item: Essence of Motion - [i]"Gain pathfinding equal to one-tenth the sum of target visible 3x3 area, rounded down."[/i]
[*]New magic item: Makeshift Weapon - [i]"[200 Mana] Reveal and kill any monsters in target area, then lose a random weapon. The radius of this item is equal to your number of weapons."[/i]
[*]New magic item: Pufferfish - [i]"[200 Mana] Automatically discharges when damage reduces your life to 1. Kill 20 random monsters."[/i]
[*]New magic item: Dumpster - [i]"[100 Mana] Lose all items with a position in your inventory greater than sum of target 3x3 visible area."[/i] (Inspired by an idea from elmarhoppieland)
[*]New consumable item: Breadcrumbs - [i]"Gain 3% pathfinding. Solve all visible cells with a value equal to one-tenth of your pathfinding or less."[/i]
[*]New special chest: Munition Chest - [i]"Reveal a random monster then kill all visible monsters when you open this chest. It contains a weapon item."[/i]
[*]New boss mod: Killer - [i]"Take 5 damage at the end of the stage."[/i]
[*]New Hero Trial effect: [i]"[...] equal to your pathfinding"[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

[list]
[*]The Beyond recipe scrollbar will maintain its position between ingredient selections
[*]Rare loot modifiers are now listed on the avatar tooltip
[*]Mystic Statue depth is now listed on the stage icon tooltip
[*]Updated the particle effect on Wilds
[*]Added term definition for "favor"
[*]Added new color palettes for a few stage mods
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Firefly I buff: the extra burning cells produced by stage mods will always be numbered
[*]Firefly II nerf: [i]"Whenever you fully and correctly chord a burning cell, shoot a flare in a random direction."[/i]
[*]Firefly III buff: reduced the charge cost from 4 to 3
[*]Flying Carpet nerf: price increased from 37 to 44 coins
[*]Battery nerf: price increased from 11 to 16 coins
[*]Electro Pulse nerf: price increased from 12 to 14 coins
[*]Doctor buff: reduced upfront fee
[*]Chorder's Password now caps at value 5 instead of 6
[*]Chaos Font can now contain legendary items
[*]Chaos Font can no longer contain items that cost less than 1
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fixed a visual issue with the Minion activation animation
[*]Fixed a crash related to activating multiple Dreamcatchers
[*]Fixed a crash related to Muscle and Divine Whip
[*]Fixed a crash related to selecting the Oct 8th stage as part of a composite Classic skin
[*]Fixed Blacksmith progress not saving to disk properly
[*]Fixed a couple missing Detective toasts
[*]Fixed a crash related to Trash Bin trashing itself
[*]Fixed an incompatibility between Dreamborne and the Dumb stage mod
[*]Fixed Cankers losing their speed value if they were created and pacified on the same step
[/list]

notes.title: v1.64 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

DemonCrawl's Halloween Event has officially ended! We hope you enjoyed the spooky festivities and managed to avoid the sharp end of Maniac's cleaver.

Now that things are returning to normal [i](Maniac was prosecuted for his crimes and hauled off to a federal supermax prison somewhere)[/i] we have released a new content patch that includes [b]5 exciting stage mods, 6 new items, and a big rework for Demolitionist II.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/c5bfced868c01617934ca4ce88ea2fe3ed80099d.png[/img]

We have also updated the stage completion logic such that you no longer have to open burning cells to achieve victory. This is an important change for specific stage mod combinations such as Nightmare + Burning.

In other news:

Celebrate [b]Day of the Dead[/b] with a new community-created avatar! Everyone will receive the [b]Mrs. Calavera[/b] avatar for free over the next couple hours - no promo code necessary. Thank you so much to [b]Cubear[/b] for creating this awesome cosmetic and for allowing us to distribute it to the entire community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/cd375189067b461c8dd12f49ccabc907f7398966.png[/img]


Full patch notes are below. Enjoy!

---

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list]
[*]Halloween event is over (farewell Maniac)
[*]New stage mod: Dumb - [i]"Lose your mastery at the start of the stage. Gain your mastery at the end of the stage."[/i]
[*]New stage mod: Lawless - [i]"Kill a visible object whenever the sum of your chain is 20 or greater. At the end of the stage, visible objects attack you for 1 damage each."[/i]
[*]New stage mod: Seismic - [i]"When you open half of all empty cells, relocate and unflag everything."[/i]
[*]New stage mod: Psychotic - [i]"Negate mistake damage. Visible monsters have a 3% chance to attack you each turn."[/i]
[*]New positive stage mod: Feeble - [i]"Monsters have a 50% chance to flee instead of attacking you."[/i]
[*]New passive item: Snake Skin - [i]"At the start of each stage, drop half of your inventory on the ground."[/i]
[*]New passive item: Blissful Gut - [i]"Right-click to consume the first item in your inventory and restore 1 life."[/i]
[*]New magic item: Magnet - [i]"Relocate the closest visible object to target visible cell."[/i]
[*]New consumable item: Plum - [i]"Expand the radius of your next targetable magic item by 1."[/i]
[*]New omen: Rocking Chair - [i]"Whenever your mastery's ultimate ability is activated, lose your mastery."[/i]
[*]New omen: Glass Knuckles - [i]"You cannot powerchord. Whenever you chord a 1, lose 1 life."[/i] (Created by Egg)
[*]Added Nomad that sells Dolls
[*]Added Hero Trial effect related to monster density
[*]Added Mrs. Calavera avatar by Cubear [i](Day of the Dead reward!)[/i]
[*]Added Emerald Knight avatar by Cubear
[*]Added Emberflame avatar, adapted by Cubear
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

[list]
[*]Burning cells no longer have to be opened in order to complete a stage
[*]Tweaked the appearance of a few stage mod sprites
[*]Added board zoom support for several particle effects
[*]The item pool is now re-filtered whenever your mastery changes, e.g. when you gain a tier 3 mastery from Academy
[*]Updated Guardian II description for clarity
[*]Android only: the mastery ultimate ability is now activated with longtap
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Demolitionist II rework: [i]"Whenever you complete a stage with 10% monster density or less, the next stage gains the Feeble mod."[/i]
[*]Viral stage mod rework: [i]"If you're injured at the start of the stage, duplicate your omens. If you're injured at the end of the stage, the next stage gains Viral."[/i]
[*]Guild Bond nerf: duration lowered from 100 seconds to 25 seconds
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fixed Rainbow Trout not always counting Frozen aura toward soul reward
[*]Fixed an indexing issue related to Gnarled Branch
[*]Fixed a crash that could result from abandoning a stage the same turn as dying
[*]Fixed Barbecue toast
[*]Fixed Map Marker activating twice for every cell of value 6 or greater
[*]Fixed an issue with Lighthouse stage power option
[*]Fixed a rare crash related to Radioactive Canker activating an item that involves inventory transformation like Present
[*]Fixed Counter Chest deflecting damage even while locked
[*]Fixed Hellstone Chestplate fortifying by 2 instead of 3
[*]Fixed a crash related to activating Gumshoes status effect without opening a cell
[*]Fixed Survivor I providing a soul instead of max life
[*]Fixed a bug related to Infinite Journey unlock conditions
[*]Fixed Dimensional Portal not resetting pathfinding correctly
[*]Fixed a crash related to Cauldron and Divine Shadowbind
[*]Fixed Dreamcatcher not capturing the guaranteed Detective stranger
[*]Pathfinding cap is now evaluated when your mastery changes
[*]Rainbow Dust can no longer be activated before monsters have spawned
[*]Windy mod can no longer generate Mementos
[*]Fixed a crash related to Divine Doomcall and Harbinger omen removal
[*]Fixed cleanup issue related to Exorcist
[*]Fixed cleanup issue related to Liberated mod
[*]Fixed a few typoz
[*]Speculative fix for a rare crash involving Human Cannonball
[*]Speculative fix for a rare crash related to selling a sigil
[/list]

notes.content:
Hi folks,

notes.title: v1.63 Patch Notes - Halloween Pt. 2
notes.content:
Hi folks,

To kick off the second week of our Halloween event, we have just released a big DemonCrawl update that includes [b]36 new items, 2 special chests, a new special stage, and an item archetype called Mastery Dolls![/b] Ohh yeah!

Additionally, we have made the Maniac boss a bit less maniacal, giving you more counterplay even in bad openings. Some players have asked if the Maniac is a permanent boss - we can confirm that Maniac is [b]not[/b] a standard member of the boss pool and will be disabled outside of the yearly Halloween event.

Read on to find out more:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d8af0166cf6c0dad82d81bf498684f5d262fd8c0.png[/img]


Full patch notes are below. Enjoy!

---

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list][*]Added Mastery Dolls (special passive items that enhance your ultimate mastery ability)
[*]36 new items
[*]New special stage: Workshop - [i]"Consume mastery charges to create mastery dolls"[/i]
[*]New special chest: Elemental - [i]"Apply random elemental auras to all cells in this column and row when you open this chest. It contains an 'aura' item."[/i]
[*]New special chest: Mastery - "[i]Gain 1 mastery charge when you open this chest. It contains a 'mastery' item."[/i]
[*]New glint: Geo - [i]"Gain 5% pathfinding at the start of the quest."[/i]
[*]New glint: Doll - [i]"Gain your mastery doll at the start of the quest."[/i]
[*]Added pathfinding Wishpool
[*]Added Hero Trial effect based on the number of times your mastery ability has been activated
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

[list][*]You can now search for favored items in the Codex using the European spelling ("favour")
[*]Updated toast for Immutable Meteorite
[*]Updated toast for Surgical Saw with Guardian
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list][*]We can now filter out items from the start of the quest based on profile conditions (e.g. Battery and Doll items will not drop if you don't have a tier 3 mastery selected)
[*]Maniac nerf: Dark Hearts will no longer spawn alongside the Maniac in your opening move
[*]Maniac nerf: [i]"Whenever the last visible stranger is killed, you die."[/i]
[*]Pacifier price reduced from 40 to 36 coins
[*]Golem prices increased from 30 to 35 coins
[*]Hungry Plant's coin reward is now based on its item requirements rather than the stage power
[*]Replaced Bones with Magic Bones in the Mage's droptable
[*]Added various Dolls to stranger droptables
[*]Updated Fishing Pole droptable
[*]Loosened requirements for Halloween Chest[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list][*]Improved performance of item search script
[*]Tweaked wall collision for enlarged orbs
[*]Fixed Regal Chest conditions for blessing projectile
[*]Fixed Punching Bag Simulator achievement requiring 4 consecutive attacks instead of 3
[*]Fixed Babyface canker mutation
[*]Fixed Stake's description which stated cells opened rather than turns
[*]Fixed memory leak related to Deck of Cards
[*]Added sanity check for writing to log file in case it was already closed[/list]

---

[h2]Community Shoutouts[/h2]

[i]We implemented several of your ideas this patch![/i]

[list]
[*]Added [b]Grim Pump[/b] omen created by [b]juh9870[/b]
[*]Added [b]Electric Eel[/b] omen inspired by [b]NotAJumbleOfNumbers[/b]
[*]Added [b]Wildcard[/b] item inspired by [b]OneIsTheLoneliestNumber[/b]
[*]Added toast ideas by [b]Samario[/b] and [b]Zapo[/b]
[/list]

---

[b]Note[/b] - Due to the size of this update, we're going to delay its launch on non-Windows platforms by a few hours in case there are any urgent issues that need addressing. Thank you for understanding!

notes.title: DemonCrawl's Halloween Expansion Is Now Available! v1.60 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

[b]Today's the day - DemonCrawl's second expansion, Halloween, is finally upon us![/b]

It's [b]COMPLETELY FREE[/b] and automatically packaged with the base game.

A ton of spooky new content awaits you, including the Maniac boss, 20+ time-limited rewards, new masteries, game-changing Special Chests and sooo much more.

To celebrate the launch, we are running a [b]33% discount on DemonCrawl[/b] for the next 7 days!

We will publish a couple follow-up posts very soon with more information about the seasonal Halloween Event [i](expected to run through Oct. 31st)[/i] as well as the [b]standalone Halloween soundtrack[/b], which you may [url=https://thereforegames.bandcamp.com/album/demoncrawl-halloween]purchase now at Bandcamp for $3.99[/url], or receive a complementary copy by [url=https://www.patreon.com/thereforegames]supporting us on Patreon![/url]

For now, we'll just let the Patch Notes do the talking for us... [i]Happy Halloween![/i]

---

[h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/65ddc0bfe2d80a326e6b54d90abf1f9f1ad140d5.png[/img] Halloween Event[/h2]

[list][*]Added Halloween flair
[*]Collect Pumpkin artifacts and use them create a spooky new Beyond quest
[*]Earn two limited-time divine items: Divine Jack-o-Lantern and Divine Bone Baton
[*]DemonCrawl has been infested with Spookers, don't worry they're harmless
[*]Complete the Halloween questline to earn 4 new avatars and a new inventory
[*]Recurring mission: earn 1 Token every time you donate Candy to a stranger
[*]12 additional Halloween avatars are available in prizeboxes
[*]New seasonal boss: Maniac - there's a madman on the loose, and he's going after the trick-or-treaters
[*]New seasonal paint: Candycorn
[*]New ultra-rare seasonal holograph: Autumn Leaves (only available in prizeboxes)
[*]Added 6 original Halloween music tracks - soundtrack available for purchase now[/list]

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list][*]You can now find Special Chests throughout your quests - you must also find a mysterious Treasure Key to open them!
[*]If your quest contains a special chest, you will come across a sign somewhere that indicates which stage holds the Treasure Key
[*]Once you unlock a special chest, you can always find it in future runs by making it part of your loadout
[*]Your selected special chest has a 10% chance to replace regular chests
[*]There are 30 unique special chests to collect
[*]Dark Chests have been removed
[*]New keyword: Pathfinding - "Allows you to complete the stage with a percentage of cells still unsolved. Caps at 50%."
[*]New mastery: Mutant - [i]"Cultivate your Cankers, then sacrifice them at the right time for huge rewards!"[/i]
[*]New mastery: Scout - [i]"Pathfinder extraordinaire!"[/i]
[*]New mastery: Detective - [i]"Butter up some strangers to learn about monster locations!"[/i] (Based on an idea by community member Egg)
[*]4 new passive items
[*]5 new consumable items
[*]10 new magic items
[*]21 new omens
[*]2 new legendary items
[*]Hook Hand rework: [i]"Your guaranteed chests will be special chests. Activate special chest effects twice."[/i]
[*]Toad rework: [i]"Mages are more common. For 20 coins, you may right-click a Mage to gain his magic item. He will learn a different item."[/i]
[*]New Daily Mission: Road Less Taken - [i]"Gain 20% pathfinding."[/i]
[*]New Daily Mission: Stimulus Package - [i]"Spend 30 Tokens."[/i]
[*]You may now abandon Daily Missions
[*]New glint: Special Glint - [i]"Quadruple your chance to find special chests."[/i]
[*]New glint: Duplication Glint - [i]"Your quest will contain an additional copy of the first stage."[/i]
[*]New stage mod: Astral - [i]"Rare loot everywhere!"[/i]
[*]Customize the look of your chests with holographs, paint and special chest sprites
[*]New avatar: Spawn of Heck by Deluxeloy
[*]New paint: Palette One by Cubear
[*]You can now search for items in the Codex by creator name
[*]You can now search for "patreon" in the Codex to see all Mythic Patron creations
[*]Added a few Hero Trial effects related to pathfinding
[*]Added a few sigils related to pathfinding
[*]Added localization support for a number of UI-related strings
[*]Default leaderboard version updated to v1.60[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

[list][*]Added Divine-colored border around Mythic Emblems you have completed
[*]Improved appearance of category sprites for Loadout and Options menus
[*]Added log entry for armor damage mitigation
[*]Added Twitter button to main menu
[*]Guaranteed Harbingers that spawn from Apocalyptic mod will show an icon on reveal
[*]Added Blood Oil toast[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list][*]Lumberjack I buff: [i]"Begin the quest with a Sawblade. You can toggle Sawblade phasing." [/i](Phasing will disable orb functionality.)
[*]Lumberjack II buff: Broken Sawblade requirement reduced from 100 cells to 50 cells
[*]Protagonist I buff: [i]"All legendary items are favored. Gain a random legendary item when you enter the final stage."[/i]
[*]Protagonist II rework: [i]"Whenever you gain a legendary item, gain a mastery charge. Whenever you replace a legendary item, increase the number of legendary items you can hold."[/i]
[*]Firefly I buff: [i]"Burning cells do not hurt you. Each stage has a numbered burning cell, plus a burning cell for each stage mod."[/i]
[*]Guardian II rework: [i]"You are immune to life loss outside of monster damage."[/i]
[*]Undertaker III buff: [i]"Reveal all cells near sanctified cells and apply sanctified to any monsters in those cells."[/i]
[*]Barbarian III buff: Charges reduced from 5 to 4
[*]Lowered Demolitionist II unlock requirement from 400 cells to 300 cells
[*]Lowered Demolitionist III unlock requirement from 1000 cells to 800 cells
[*]Overhauled stranger drop tables
[*]Increased the droprate of prizebox-only avatars
[*]Slightly increased the droprate of divines in prizeboxes
[*]Spawners now benefit from the Electric aura
[*]Reduced the Token Shop prices of Trump Card and Archmage Sceptre by 100 tokens each
[*]Chisel can upgrade chests into special chests
[*]Slightly reduced the droprates of most sigil crafting materials
[*]Dreamcatcher price increased from 5 to 10 coins
[*]Priest buff: reduced the upper bound of his price from 50 to 40 coins[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list][*]Fixed boss signs showing up in all Normal difficulty quests
[*]Improved collision detection of orbs bouncing off walls
[*]Fixed an issue related to entering windowed mode using the alt+enter command
[*]Fixed an issue with Bubbler's Memento not preserving bubbles
[*]Fixed a hardlock related to Fraudulent mod attempting to replace positive mods
[*]Fixed an issue related to Beyond Ego not spawning under some conditions
[*]Fixed Hydra Tail toast
[*]Fixed Obelisks not advancing from cell reveal effects
[*]Fixed "This Is Aurable" achievement unlocking on Steam but not in game
[*]Fixed an issue between Paper Golem and Gold Digger
[*]Fixed a few issues related to particle depth and cleanup routines
[*]Fixed Guild Bond not activating on use of Mercenary
[*]Fixed missing list icon on Mythic Emblem "guaranteed boss" text
[*]Clarified wording on Punching Bag description for consistency
[*]Cleaned up various project files, removed old assets
[*]Removed remnants of Worldclay from the game (goodnight, sweet prince)[/list]

[b]NOTE:[/b] Android release will be available by the end of the day, after any necessary hotfixes are implemented on the desktop version.

---

[b]Hotfix #1 @ 2:52 PM EST:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Detective mastery unlock requirements
[*]Fixed an issue with the Special Chest UI
[*]Fixed a crash related to Bagman
[*]Fixed missing Halloween stage description
[*]Fixed missing Sky Net toast
[*]Speculative fix for crash related to Bubbles - more testing needed here
[/list]

[b]Hotfix #2 @ 3:14 PM EST:[/b] Fixed missing Steam achievements related to the new masteries, no client update required. Currently investigating crash related to bubbles.

[b]Hotfix #3 @ 4:00 PM EST:[/b] Likely fixed the crash related to bubbles. Please restart your Steam client to get the latest version.

[b]Hotfix #4 @ 6:40 PM EST:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Fixed special chests always unlocking in the same order instead of random
[*]Maniac boss can no longer spawn in Casual Mode
[*]Fixed Spookers spawning while "create a profile" screen is open
[*]Fixed a crash related to Wrecking Ball and bosses
[*]Fixed Quest for Sin toast
[*]Fixed leftover progress from Christmas 2019 event interfering with Halloween questline
[*]Fixed a crash related to Blighted Totem and the Immutable stage mod
[/list]

notes.title: DemonCrawl Mythic Patron Spotlight: Fireplace & Elemental Fuel
notes.content:
Hi folks,

The wait is almost over - DemonCrawl's Halloween expansion finally launches TOMORROW!

We wanted to take a moment and spotlight two of the 40+ new items that will be included in tomorrow's update. These are no ordinary items... they were designed and developed in collaboration with DemonCrawl's first-ever [url=https://patreon.com/thereforegames]Mythic Patron supporters[/url]!

Let's dive right in:

---

First up is a new legendary item called [b]Fireplace[/b], designed by Mythic Patron [b]Emberflame[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/f584cc3db500124a311ddf3dcf09c38a98676bf1.png[/img]

With a fitting name like that, you might have already guessed Emberflame wanted to create a powerful option for the Firefly's legendary slot, and we were totally on board!

As it turns out, there's very little elemental support in the legendary item pool - it was clear right away that this idea was a winner.

Fireplace is an interesting concept because it's much more than a mere Burning enabler. It dips into both [b]status effect[/b] and [b]gleaning mechanics[/b], offering great synergy with other items and even other masteries. Have you ever wanted to play as a BURNING SPY? Because now you can.

---

Next is a new magic item called [b]Elemental Fuel[/b], designed by Mythic Patron [b]Tom25w[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/f617395c23e3b3bceb7ef08da6aa6883a52717ed.png[/img]

Tom brought a few different ideas to the table and let us choose the one that appealed to us most. As soon as we saw Elemental Fuel (originally called Magic Fuel), our mind was made up.

It's such an elegant design. Some of our favorite items are those with unique effects that can be summed up in a single punchy sentence. [i]"Spread all auras to nearby cells."[/i] 6 words, no room for confusion, and it fits perfectly into many different builds.

We think Tom's numbers were exactly right too - at just 13 coins and 90 mana per use, Elemental Fuel is something you can pick up without a great deal of buyer's remorse, even if auras never come into play during your run.

At its worst, Elemental Fuel is an affordable safety net. At its best? Probably something nuts involving Ethereal aura and infinite mana.

---

[h3]Other Shoutouts[/h3]

The Halloween expansion features more ideas from the community than any other DemonCrawl patch to date. [b][i]Thank you all so much for helping us enrich our game![/i][/b]

We can't wait to see what you guys come up with when we finally add proper modding support... [img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/671516383284166746.gif?v=1[/img]

In the meantime, we want to give a few quick shoutouts to some of the other ideas that made it into v1.60:

[list]
[*] Detective mastery is based heavily on an idea from community member Egg.
[*] There's a set of "Marshmallow" items inspired by ideas from raisins77. Yummm
[*] Egg strikes again with an idea for a positive stage mod called "Astral" - rare loot everywhere!
[*] Community moderator Team Worm gave us a great quality-of-life suggestion for adding Divine-colored borders around completed Mythic Emblems.
[/list]

There's truly a lot more, but we don't want to give away too much before the expansion launches!

See you tomorrow!

notes.title: v1.59 - More Survivor Changes & Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We just deployed a new stability patch for DemonCrawl!

This update includes a new consumable item, additional balance changes for Survivor, and over 30 bug fixes. (Some much-needed housekeeping!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/88a29e0bc852e9103caa2e793eb522469b33cebe.png[/img]

Last week, we implemented significant changes to 6 masteries, most of which were well received. However, some players expressed dissatisfaction with the Survivor updates - we want to take a moment to address this and explain our solution in v1.59.

The Survivor mastery has always been about manipulating a state of injury to your advantage. We like that it creates interesting situations where you have to decide between healing to survive an imminent blow, or remaining in harm's way so that you can continue to reap the mastery's benefits.

Prior to v1.58, Survivor II provided a way to scale your build through Soul drops. While this fit the Survivor's M.O., it was a bit too unreliable - this is a class that most players unlock early on, so we think it should offer a decent amount of predictability. It and Guardian (formerly Knight) were originally conceived as "starter masteries" with somewhat boring but reliable designs.

Additionally, we were not a fan of intentionally taking damage in the first stage to activate Survivor II as early as possible, which was often the ideal strategy. It wasn't too powerful or anything, but it felt like an inconvenient and unintuitive mechanic. Plus, if you forgot to do it, your run was immediately at a disadvantage.

So, we decided to try scaling Survivor with the "Untouchable" award instead. This created a nice parallel with the Guardian mastery, but many players were quick to point out that rewarding Survivors for [i]not[/i] taking damage was at odds with its core identity.

After some thought, we have come to agree. Here's our new solution:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/c14f2a642d8526eab50e66e7c77dcc2b35307723.png[/img]

In v1.59, the Survivor is once again rewarded for his injuries, but in a more reliable fashion. We also applied a quality-of-life "nerf" to Survivor I so that it provides max life instead of life - putting you in a state of injury from the start.

Survivor III is unchanged, meaning you still have the opportunity to restore all of your lives every few stages. 

Let us know what you think, and we hope you enjoy the patch! Full patch notes are below.

[i][b]P.S.[/b] Due to relatively long compilation times for Mac and Linux, we have decided to release updates for Windows first, with the other platforms to follow in 3-4 hours. This way we can prepare and deploy any crucial hotfixes without having to re-compile for all 3 systems. Expect to see this approach for all updates going forward.[/i]

---

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list][*]New consumable item: Pacifier - [i]"Replace the stage mods on the selected stage with less difficult stage mods."[/i][/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

[*]You may now begin a stage by clicking twice on the small thumbnail in stage select
[*]Replaced Customize screen pagination with a scrollbar

[*]Updated the description of Maul for clarity

[*]Added current number of total status effects in the tooltip for the help menu category
[*]Made adjustments to the following sprites: Electromancy, Venomancy, Overgrowth, Barrels of Fun
[*]Desktop only: you may now close the escape menu by pressing escape again
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list][*]Survivor I rework: [i]"Begin the quest with 1 extra max life."[/i]
[*]Survivor II rework: [i]"At the end of each stage, gain 1 max life if you are injured."[/i]
[*]Increased the droprate of Mythic Emblems by about 25%
[*]Reduced the density of Sanctified cells in Valhallan stages from 8% to 5%
[*]Starponds are now a bit more likely to offer items for coins instead of tokens
[*]Starpond coin price is no longer capped at 999
[*]Increased the price of Purify from 40 to 50[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list][*]Status effects are now saved to disk using the item name, which should make them more resilient to game updates
[*]Fixed a crash related to Classic Mode and the Metagate skin
[*]Fixed Mythic Emblem stage mod placement
[*]Transmogrify now randomizes itself

[*]Fixed an issue that caused the completion of a classic stage to reset your current quest stage
[*]Fixed crafting tooltips incorrectly showing up next to some sigil materials
[*]Fixed a monster count issue related to blowing up flagged monsters

[*]Fixed a rare issue with the autosolver related to its understanding of the monster count
[*]Fixed a couple minor issues with the stage select UI

[*]Fixed a crash related to activating Bubbler III without any orbs
[*]Fixed Disturbing stage mod influencing the direction of some projectiles
[*]Fixed Voucher not providing an item if used with a full inventory
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause the Disturbing mod toast to show an incorrect sprite
[*]Fixed Quest for Necrosis not respecting Heavy Burden's reduction to total inventory size
[*]Fixed the log entry for "coins spent" not respecting Blinding stage mod
[*]Fixed Fraudulent stage mod bypassing Immutable stage mod
[*]Fixed a few issues related to Edict of the Old Gods not buffing Tablets
[*]Fixed a rare crash related to electric Dark Chests
[*]Fixed a crash related to Smog activating on the first turn of a stage
[*]Fixed resolution scale not saving to disk when using alt+enter fullscreen toggle
[*]Fixed Minion Wishpool not receiving buff from Electric aura
[*]Holograph tooltips can no longer produce a term definition panel
[*]Patreon leaderboards no longer observe the default version filter
[*]The monster density cap will do a better job of making sure there's enough space for your first move
[*]Added validation for external strings to prevent possible crashes

notes.title: v1.58 Patch Notes - Various Mastery Buffs!
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We just deployed an update for DemonCrawl that includes buffs to 6 lesser-used masteries, a new stage mod, 3 community-designed inventories and more!

There is also a larger patch in the works for a major seasonal event - can you guess which one? 🤔

Full patch notes are below.

---

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list][*]New stage mod: Fraudulent - [i]"When you enter this stage, replace all stage mods with more difficult stage mods."[/i]
[*]All Mythic Emblems now enforce specific sets of stage mods
[*]Mythic Emblem bosses are now guaranteed rather than likely
[*]Updated default leaderboard version to v1.58
[*]Added 5 new Patreon avatars and a new Patreon inventory
[*]Added "Gilded Mahogany" inventory designed by community member Cynic
[*]Added "Calculator" inventory designed by community member Celestial

[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list][*]Commander I buff: Familiar summoning cost reduced from 5 to 3 coins
[*]Survivor II rework: [i]"Whenever you earn the Untouchable award, gain 1 max life."[/i]
[*]Survivor III buff: [i]"Solve a number of cells equal to your missing life, then heal to full."[/i]
[*]Bubbler II buff: [i]"Whenever you pop a bubble, reveal a number of random nearby cells equal to the value of the cell it was popped in."[/i]
[*]Scholar II buff: [i]"Whenever a status effect is completed, restore 1 life and solve a cell."[/i]

[/list]

[list][*]Fixed a typo on Essence of Death

[*]Fixed an issue related to Chamberlain Hero Trial not saving its effect to the disk
[*]Fixed Blood Oil not writing its effect to the disk
[*]Fixed an issue related to Druid Staff and the new excess item rules

[/list]

notes.title: v1.57 Patch Notes - Mac Launch & New Items!
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We have a big DemonCrawl update for you today. :-)

First off, [b]our Mac build has entered the stable branch![/b] We're happy to say that the porting process was relatively painless, and that we should be able to utilize the same Apple dev tools to begin building for iOS soon. 

As for the patch itself, v1.57 introduces [b]5 powerful new items[/b] and a [b]new stage mod[/b]. The mod is quite unique and will almost certainly make an impact on any stage that has it... we hope it poses an interesting challenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/ce2647224f10d566af74deba51280823ba12a1f1.png[/img]

Additionally, we created a [b]new type of Nomad[/b] that will trade one of your items for another item. He's like a Bazaar, but in Nomad form. There are a few other mechanic changes you can read about in the patch notes below.

Finally, we added [b]3 community-made cosmetics[/b], the first of their kind. [i]A big thank you to [b]Cubear[/b] and [b]Celestial[/b] for these awesome contributions![/i]

We hope to add more community cosmetics in the near future. If you would like to submit your own work for consideration, please do so at [url=https://discord.gg/wqkWcc5]DemonCrawl's official Discord server[/url]. We can't wait to see what you come up with. :-)

Enjoy!

---

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list][*][b]DemonCrawl is now available on macOS[/b]
[*]Added a couple more stages as unlockable Classic Skins
[*]Added Trader Nomad - he will exchange one of your items for another item
[*]New stage mod: Disturbing - [i]"Living objects move toward your cursor. If you hover a living object, you take 1 damage."[/i]
[*]New consumable item: Ladybug - [i]"For a number of turns equal to your total mana plus 1, you cannot take damage from failed guesses."[/i]
[*]New passive item: Feather - [i]"Monster damage is capped to your number of items."[/i]
[*]New magic item: Mana Tank - [i]"[100 Mana] Gain 200 Mana."[/i] (Inspired by an idea from our Patron Blattdorf!)
[*]New magic item: Demon Snare - [i]"Flag all hidden monsters in target 7x7 area. Kill all visible monsters in this area. Remove a boss mod from each boss in this area."[/i]
[*]New legendary item: Trump Card - [i]"If you fail a guess, activate your mastery's ultimate ability before taking damage." [/i]
[*]Added a new Mythic Emblem

[*]Added a gameplay setting to always highlight chains
[*]Added Great Grandfather Rock avatar by Celestial
[*]Added Photocopy paint by Cubear
[*]Added Moonlight Rave paint by Cubear
[*]Added localization support for various strings[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list][*]You can now use your "open cell" keybind to dismiss most popups
[*]The names of most classic skins will be revealed if you have access to Hard Mode
[*]Updated the description of Frozen aura to let players know that it can reduce the monster count
[*]Added toast notifications for the following items: Divine Halo, Spirit Robe, Hellstone Chestplate[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list][*]Any excess items gained during a stage will drop on the ground, not just items from chests

[*]The cell open requirements for Obelisks have been lowered from [20 to 30] to [15 to 30]
[*]Gambler loses coins a bit less often

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list][*]Classic Mode skin unlock descriptions updated for clarity
[*]Optimized code for the bullet points that appear in tooltips
[*]Fixed negative defense counting toward "Just a Flesh Wound" Daily Mission

[*]The alert logs no longer show monster damage rolls on Blinding stages

[*]Fixed a clickthrough issue related to the heirloom window
[*]Fixed toast notification for Gnarled Branch

[*]Fixed Mud activating each turn if you have Brain in a Vat
[*]Fixed hover region for items in the Token Shop
[*]Fixes for Knight's Memento and Scholar's Memento
[*]Fixed an issue with Elementalist Hero Trial effect
[*]Fixed line height calculation issue in vertically scrolling UI elements
[*]Speculative fix for particle issue related to Sawblades
[*]Speculative fix for rare crash related to opening a monster on a Diverse stage
[*]Speculative fix for leaderboards "my score" button
[*]Android only: fixed banner advertisement covering up classic menu and patch notes windows

notes.title: Celebrating our Linux launch with a 25% discount!
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We are very excited to announce that [b]DemonCrawl has officially made its way onto the Linux operating system![/b]

We have decided to celebrate by running a [b]25% discount[/b] on DemonCrawl for the entire week, starting [b]right now[/b]!

If you're on Ubuntu version 16 or later, you can launch DemonCrawl from the Steam client and everything should "just work." That said, some players have informed us that the game also works great in other distros with a bit of elbow grease.

[i](Note - Ubuntu is the only flavor of Linux we officially support at this time, but you can always reach out to us at support@therefore.games for help getting the game to work in a different environment.)[/i]

[h2]Other news[/h2]

Not a Linux player? Don't worry - we are working hard to bring DemonCrawl to all major platforms. We can confirm at this time that the [b]Mac and iOS ports[/b] are up next. :-)

We are also in the process of externalizing all game strings for ease of translation. DemonCrawl has somewhere around 8000 unique lines of text, all of which need to be moved to external JSON files so our translation team can do their thing. About half of the work has been completed - item names, descriptions, stage mods, and much more are already loading through external JSON. We hope to have the rest of it done in the next month or so.

Finally, we're cooking up a pretty large content update that should be ready by the end of the week (slated to enter Beta by Thursday or so)... we may post some spoilers about it in [url=https://discord.gg/wqkWcc5]the Discord[/url] over the next couple days. ;-)

Hope your week is off to a great start, and we'll talk again soon!

notes.title: v1.53 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

Hope your weekend is going well!

We just deployed an update for DemonCrawl that includes official Linux support, 5 brand new items, a prompt that lets you choose which legendary item to keep, various legendary tweaks, and several UI enhancements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/736307376a69fbe78f4882acbd89f0e2cf12308d.png[/img]

This patch also includes a lot of foundational work for localization support. We are very eager to begin translating DemonCrawl to other languages! If you think you can help with this, feel free to [url=https://demoncrawl.com/wiki/index.php/Localization]take a look at our documentation[/url] and shoot us an email at support@therefore.games with some details about your professional background.

We hope you enjoy! Full patch notes are below.

---

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list]
[*]Added Linux support
[*]New Patreon reward set: [b]Robot Uprising[/b] - 5 new avatars and 1 new inventory
[*]New passive item: Primordial Bangle - [i]"At the start of each stage, gain a random magic item if you have less than 200 mana."[/i]
[*]New consumable item: Magic Munchies - [i]"Gain a soul, plus 1 soul for every 200 mana you have."[/i]
[*]New consumable item: Zeal of Love - [i]"Spawn a heart. If you have to guess, convert all visible hearts to souls."[/i]
[*]New consumable item: Zeal of Hate - [i]"Spawn a monster. If you have to guess, convert all visible monsters to Minions."[/i]
[*]New omen: Mystery Meat - [i]"Your consumable item effects are randomized."[/i]
[*]Implemented toggle mute buttons in the audio settings
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*]You may now decline legendary items from chests if they would replace an existing legendary item
[*]If there's not enough space for a chest item to drop on the ground, the item will drop to a different cell instead
[*]Arcane Barrier rework: [i]"Whenever a monster is revealed, activate a random targeted magic item at its cell before taking damage."[/i]
[*]Kingmaker rework: [i]"Every 20 cells opened without making a mistake, spawn a familiar then solve all cells near your familiars."[/i]
[*]Hypertrap buff: [i]"Flag 25% of all monsters when you begin a stage."[/i]
[*]Resolute Horn buff: [i]"When you leave a stage, gain 2 souls for each heart you leave behind."[/i]
[*]Resolute Horn price increased from 10 to 15
[*]Sphere of Influence price reduced from 40 to 30
[*]Blind Justice price reduced from 15 to 9
[*]Ointment price reduced from 17 to 14
[*]Badge of Honor price increased from 14 to 18
[*]Fake Moustache price reduced from 50 to 45
[*]Silver Bullet buff: doubled the base chance of converting a projectile to a Blessing
[*]Paper Golem can spawn Quest for Mythos more often, though it is still quite rare
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

[list]
[*]Starpond will now tell you how many of each item you currently have
[*]Stage mods can now stack in the UI
[*]Improved appearance of burning cell particles
[*]Thought Bubble orbs can no longer spawn right next to the edges of the screen
[*]The vast majority of item notifications now support loading via external JSON
[*]Quest names and description strings now support external JSON
[*]Stage names are description strings now support external JSON
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue related to the autosolver's understanding of the monster count
[*]Fixed Blinding mod not concealing damage taken in the help menu
[*]Fixed another issue related to immutable objects getting destroyed
[*]Bugle can no longer activate before monsters have spawned
[*]Divine Blood Magic can no longer activate before monsters have spawned
[*]You can no longer pay the Gambler if he has no valid cells to move to
[*]Added notification that you cannot switch codex profiles during a quest
[*]Fixed minor memory leak with Bag of Tricks
[*]Fixed Molotov incorrectly stating that you must be in the overworld to use
[*]Fixed a typo in the monster name generator
[/list]

[b]Hotfix #1 @ 3:35 PM EST - [/b] Fixed a crash related to stage name localization.
[b]Hotfix #2 @ 7:27 PM EST - [/b] Fixed several issues with notification strings, fixed a rare hardlock related to the "LEARN" sigil, fixed a crash related to Boom Bow trying to blow up a monster that was bubbled.
[b]Hotfix #3 @ 11:55 PM EST[/b] - Fixed string handling for Marksman I, Pillow, Merchant Ring, Dark Ink, Drone, and Candelabra. Also fixed Chamberlain Hero Trial effect. Added a required Linux dependency.


There are a few known issues related to missing string notifications - we're working through these and should have another small patch ready in the morning. Feel free to file a bug report if you run into any wonky/missing strings. We appreciate it!

notes.title: DemonCrawl for Linux Is Now in Beta!
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We have recently published a native Linux build of DemonCrawl through the Steam Beta program!

You can play DemonCrawl on Linux [b]right now[/b] by [url=https://www.patreon.com/thereforegames]supporting us on Patreon[/url].

We hope to get it ready for worldwide release within the next several weeks. :-)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/68d4bb6e6f65ee72ab27049f7704eb8687b6af64.png[/img]

A couple important notes about DemonCrawl on Linux:

1. We have heard that DemonCrawl has always worked pretty well in Wine/Proton, but certain network features like the leaderboards crash the client, and there are significant slowdowns when hovering some items. [b]We are happy to confirm that these issues are NOT present in the native Linux build.[/b]

2. Officially, we only support the latest stable build of Ubuntu. Unofficially, however, you might be able to get this thing running in other distros with a little elbow grease. Please reach out to us if you need any help doing so.

Thank you for reading! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/63eabf19bdba097f7ebd5e163e87352f5c446c5c.png[/img]

notes.title: New Masteries! v1.50 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We just released an update for DemonCrawl that introduces [b]two[/b] exciting new masteries:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/08364dbe45fc025090127638c6251aef951c50d5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/afd81b30f7654af0e66259bc89e41c1c3dd7b2c9.png[/img]

Additionally, we have overhauled the Spellbinder boss, reworked Obelisks, fixed a ton of bugs and more. Full patch are below!

---

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list][*] New mastery: [b]Novice[/b] - [i]Offers powerful learning tools at the expense of score[/i]
[*]New mastery: [b]Demolitionist[/b] - [i]Bring on the Barrels[/i]
[*]New memento: [b]Demolitionist's Memento[/b] - [i]"Whenever you blow up an object in the Metagate, spawn a Guide."[/i]
[*]You can now manually detonate barrels at the cost of 1 damage
[*]The autosolver can now utilize monster count to determine if progress can be made
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

[list][*] Added a sign to the tutorial that explains chording
[*] Items with a cost of 0 are now included in the Codex
[*] Improved targeting descriptions of the following magic items: Trash Bin, Handbell, Watering Can, Surgical Saw, Drill, Pendulum, Magic Dark Ink, Mortal Root, Loudhailer, Troll Cross, Ritual Chalk, Lotus, Mjolnir, and Powder Keg
[*] Added simple animation to inventory button when you gain a new item
[*] You can now paste text into input fields
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list][*] Obelisks have been reworked:
[list]
[*] You must now choose to activate the obelisk
[*] All obelisks require you to open x cells within 10 seconds
[*] The random penalty for failure is listed upfront
[*] You will gain a Tablet on success
[*] Tablet of Pyxe buff: [i]"Gain 100 XP at the end of each stage, and 1000 XP at the end of the quest."[/i]
[*] Tablet of Ne'kot buff: [i]"Gain a Token at the end of each stage, and 50 Tokens at the end of the quest."[/i]
[*] Tablet of Drocer has been replaced with Tablet of Lairetam: [i]"Gain a random artifact at the end of each stage, and 10 random artifacts at the end of the quest."[/i]
[*] Obelisk sprite updated
[/list]
[*] Spellbinder boss overhaul
[list]
[*] Take 2 damage whenever a Dark Heart is collected.
[*] Whenever you make a mistake, manalock your magic items for 30 turns.
[*] Whenever you use a magic item, destroy a random Dark Heart.
[/list]
[*] Snowflake I and Commander I now operate on left-clicking flagged cells
[*] Defense can now fall below 0 (makes monsters stronger)
[*] Reduced the coin cost of Starpond items by one third
[*] Reduced the base durability of Chainmail from 3 to 1
[*] The Library can no longer give omens
[*] Reduced the price of Godmonger from 28 to 23 coins
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list][*] Fixed lag when gaining a massive amount of XP at once
[*] Fixed crash related to "Airtight" Sigil
[*] Fixed Sentry Gnome failing to activate under some conditions
[*] Fixed Tablet items that were dropped from Obelisks not writing to disk properly
[*] Fixed a typo in the "Death" Hero Trial description
[*] Fixed a rare issue related to visible monsters that would make the autosolver incorrectly believe you did not have to guess
[*] Fixed several instances of lingering tooltips
[*] Fixed Key of Undoing not updating the "stage completed" label after use
[*] Fixed explosion effects bypassing the "Demonlord" Hero Trial
[*] Fixed Arcane Staff ignoring manalock
[*] Fixed a hardlock related to the Scholar ability completing Smog and Fruit of Labor at the same time
[*] Fixed First Aid bypassing the Active stage mod
[*] Fixed a hardlock related to Wishlist, Gravedigger and Gluttony
[*] Fixed a typo in the Wishpool tooltip
[*] Fixed Mirror manalocking itself for 30 turns instead of 40
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when a Harbinger was spawned from a Friendly Glint
[*] Spring can no longer be consumed before monsters have spawned
[*] Fixed a crash related to Soft Clay transforming a legendary item
[*] Fixed a rare crash related to Cleansing Bell
[*] Fixed "new item" notification layering issue in the codex
[*] Fixed "new item" notification not showing up in the first row of codex items
[*] Fixed boss selection not updating between dimensions in Endless Multiverse
[*] Fixed strange behavior regarding Bullet Time effect stacking
[*] Fixed a rare crash related to using items during the Mega Token animation
[*] Fixed Key of Undoing crash
[*] Fixed an issue with Drill not spawning loot
[*] Fixed a crash related to a stage that has both Judging and Diverse mods
[*] Fixed Novice II consuming a revive in addition to its own revive effect
[*] Fixed leaderboard entries without masteries showing as different mastery
[*] Fixed profile data corruption related to visiting the Patreon leaderboards through Quest 5 [i](If you were affected by this bug, please reach out to us ASAP and we will do our best to help restore any lost progress.)[/i]
[*] The "Death" Hero Trial effect is now capable of multikills
[*] Mobile only: Fickle mod now operates on a longtap
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur after reloading a Native stage
[*] Fixed some objects losing their custom colors after popping out of bubbles
[*] Fixed layering depth of objects popped out of bubbles
[*] Fixed artifact requirements on one of the Mythic Emblems
[*] Fixed visual glitch related to Convulsing stage mod
[*] Improved performance of "confine cursor" option
[/list]

[b]Hotfix #1 @ 2:07 PM EST[/b] - Fixed Present crash.
[b]Hotfix #2 @ 2:40 PM EST[/b] - Fixed game client closing at the end of a quest, and Starpond not letting you buy an item that you have just enough Tokens to afford.
[b]Hotfix #3 @ 7:30 PM EST[/b] -
[list]
[*]Fixed Bones showing up twice in the Codex
[*]Fixed Casual Mode lockup
[*]Fixed a visual glitch related to Bubbles
[*]Fixed Powder Keg barrels not exploding after 5 seconds
[/list]
[b]Hotfix #4 @ 2:20 AM EST[/b] -
[list]
[*]Fixed XP skip animation not providing levelup rewards
[*]Fixed missing Barrel arrow from Demolitionist I
[/list]

notes.title: v1.49 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We have just released a small but important stability patch for DemonCrawl. Full patch notes are below.

Thank you!

---

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Ego boss can no longer die
[*]Capped status effect duration to 1 million
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*]Labels of status effect durations exceeding 999 will be shortened to "1K, 2K, 3K, ..."
[*]Clarified memento descriptions to explain that they will help preserve current life, rather than adding more
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list][*]Addressed a number of issues in the leaderboard server code
[*]Fixed an issue that could prevent a boss from spawning on a busy stage
[*]Fixed an issue related to targeting multiple cells with Drill
[*]Fixed a potential crash when using Blueberry outside of a stage
[*]Fixed Magnifying Glass bypassing the Active stage mod
[*]Fixed "Fire" and "Ice" sigil effects
[*]Fixed some mementos running checks against life instead of max life
[*]Fixed an issue with the "open cell" keybind that would cause it to activate objects in the same step as popping them from a bubble
[*]Fixed a potential crash with the Constant Reminder emblem if it selected certain status effects like Justice Juice
[*]Fixed Sentry Gnome not auto-unlocking if you had purchased it when it was called Guardian
[*]Fixed some sound effects bypassing the "mute game in background" setting
[*]Speculative fix for rare Hungry Plant crash
[*]Speculative fix for minor alignment issue on the quest thumbnails
[/list]

[b]Hotfix #1 @ 8:00 PM EST[/b] - Fixed a crash related to objects dying from burning cells.

notes.title: HUGE BALANCE UPDATE! v1.48 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

Great news - [b]we just released a massive balance patch for DemonCrawl![/b] It contains reworked masteries, reworked stage mods, new items, tons of bug fixes, and much more. Did we mention [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1141220/announcements/detail/2504513502251772565]there's even a new boss?[/url] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/be87ff1ba11ebfd1a038cf967487c6a3a3d94f31.gif[/img]

Full patch notes are below.

---

[b]Note[/b] - differences between this release and the beta patch notes are indicated by the following icon: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img]

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list][*]New avatar for Patreon supporters: FLIPPER
[*]New inventory for Patreon supporters: CINDERS
[*]Added keyword: Duplicast - [i]"Activate a copy of one of your charged magic items. Targets chosen randomly."[/i]
[*]Added keyword: Manalock - [i]"For a number of turns, you cannot activate this magic item. It cannot gain nor lose mana."[/i]
[*]New stage mod: Scrappy - [i]"Monsters deal extra damage equal to the number of nearby cells that are not solved."[/i]
[*]New boss: Heckaslug - The Poison Monger
[*]New boss mod: Profane - [i]"Whenever a Dark Heart is collected, randomly distribute 50 turns of manalock across your magic items."[/i]
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] New boss mod: Greasy - [i]"If the boss can't move, it relocates to a random empty cell."[/i]
[*]New daily mission: Combo Hype - [i]"Create a 5-turn chain of value 3 or greater, 10 times."[/i]
[*]New Lv1 sigil impulse: Plunder - [i]"Every [x] chests opened ..."[/i]
[*]New Lv1 sigil reflex: Cast - [i]"... Duplicast a magic item that costs [x] or less mana."[/i]
[*]New legendary item: Archmage Sceptre - [i]"Whenever a heart is collected, duplicast your magic items."[/i]
[*]New passive item: Bust - [i]"Spawners are more common. Whenever an inventory slot would be sealed, you have a 50% chance to negate the effect."[/i]
[*]New consumable item: Blueberry - [i]"Duplicast your magic items, then they become manalocked for 20 turns."[/i]
[*]New consumable item: Quest for Mythos - [i]"After opening 100 cells without making a mistake, spawn 3 legendary items."[/i] (Much more rare than other quests)
[*]New omen: Profane Staff - [i]"Whenever you collect a diamond, manalock a random magic item for a number of turns equal to its mana cost."[/i]
[*]New glint: Astral Glint - [i]"Your quest will contain 3 Starponds"[/i]
[*]New glint: Forward Glint - [i]"Begin the quest with 50 cells opened since your last mistake. Begin the quest with 3 omens destroyed. Begin the quest with 3 chests opened."[/i]
[*]New rare glint: Mega Glint - [i]"Reduce the cost of your quest by half"[/i]
[*]New crafting material: Dust of Chaos - [i]"Upgrade a broken Lv1 sigil to the next level."[/i]
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Every quest now has a sign somewhere that indicates which boss you will find at the end
[*]Added button in the credits screen to view top Patreon supporters
[*]Added option to disable the freezeframe effect when rare loot or bosses spawn
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

[list][*]Guardian item has been renamed to Sentry Gnome in order to differentiate it from the mastery
[*]The Beyond menu now utilizes a scrollbar UI instead of pagination
[*]Added new sign messages for some lesser-known mechanics
[*]The toast notification for Pillow now states how many turns were passed
[*]The "reset options" button now gives you a 5-second window to cancel
[*]If a syntax error is encountered in a translation file, DemonCrawl will mention this in its crash dialog
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Spy III ability can no longer activate before monsters have spawned
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Minor improvements to the appearance of quest thumbnails
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Updated sprite for Dirty stage mod
[*]Beta only: new items are forcibly favored to make sure they show up more often during beta testing - this does not use up your favor slots
[*]Beta only: Heckaslug boss will appear 50% of the time
[*]Windows only: you can right-click on the difficulty slider to move it in the opposite direction
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Starpond medium artifact quantity increased from [10-20] to [10-50]
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Starpond large artifact quantity increased from [50-100] to [100-200]
[*]Lv2 prizebox Token quantity reward increased from [20-40] to [40-70]
[*]Lv3 prizebox Token quantity reward increased from [300-600] to [600-1200]
[*]Exorcist II rework: [i]"Whenever you lose an omen, gain souls and defense equal to the number of omens you've lost this run."[/i]
[*]Exorcist III charges reduced from 6 to 4
[*]Wizard I subtle but important change: [i]"The first Item Shop in the quest only contains magic items."[/i]
[*]Wizard II rework: [i]"Whenever you collect a diamond, duplicast a random magic item."[/i]
[*]Firefly II has been rolled into Firefly I
[*]Firefly II rework: [i]"Whenever you chord a burning cell, shoot a flare in a random direction."[/i]
[*]Guardian II rework: [i]"Whenever you earn the Untouchable award, reduce the power of the next stage by your defense."[/i]
[*]Spy III charges increased from 3 to 4
[*]Adjusted the position of some special stages in Beyond to prevent the possibility of a last-stage Smithy
[*]Opening the same cell twice in a row no longer increases your chain (it doesn't break the chain either)
[*]Iron Will buff: [i]"Gain 3 defense whenever your armor breaks."[/i] (Up from 2 defense)
[*]Deerstalker buff: all cell values will be corrected when the item is equipped
[*]Binoculars and Divine Binoculars buff: Minions will spawn almost twice as often as before
[*]Mage will now choose his random cells a little more intelligently, e.g. he won't target a visible cell if the item states "target hidden cell"
[*]The above targeting logic also applies to duplicasting random items
[*]Familiars can no longer collect Dark Hearts
[*]Genie Lamp can no longer bring you to a Smithy
[*]Elemental Knuckles price reduced from 31 to 26
[*]Clarity price reduced from 12 to 8
[*]Stocking price reduced from 25 to 22
[*]Iron Will price increased from 14 to 17
[*]Primordial Gate price increased from 31 to 40
[*]Super Mana Potion price increased from 25 to 30
[*]Adrenaline price increased from 8 to 9
[*]Mana Lung price increased from 30 to 34
[*]Venomancy buff: [i]"When you target a cell with a magic item, it gains Toxic. When you complete a stage, lose 1 max life for each Toxic cell of value 5 or greater."[/i]
[*]Dreamborne now has 100-turn manalock after use
[*]Ouroboros now has 50-turn manalock after use
[*]Chaos Portal now has a 50-turn manalock after use
[*]Mirror now has 40-turn manalock after use
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Magic Smoke Bomb now has a 20-turn manalock after use
[*]Elemental stage mod aura density reduced from 21% to 15%
[*]Burning stage mod aura density reduced from 15% to 12%
[*]Electric stage mod aura density reduced from 15% to 12%
[*]Frozen stage mod aura density reduced from 8% to 6%
[*]Pagan stage mod now creates souls instead of hearts
[*]Dirty stage mod nerf: [i]"When you leave the stage, take 1 damage for each different type of non-living object."[/i]
[*]Flawless stage mod now triggers on monster damage instead of any damage
[*]Each stage now tracks how many times it has been completed in the same quest
[*]With each subsequent completion, a stage will provide half as much XP/score
[*]After the second completion, the stage will become more difficult, similar to Mystic Statues
[*]Living objects that were spawned into burning cells will burn to death at the start of the following turn
[*]Bosses will die if they stand in burning cells for 3 consecutive turns
[*]Boss burn tolerance increases by their number of boss mods
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Dirty Soap now activates Lumberjack II
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Mementos can no longer drop from library research
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Native stage mod can no longer spawn a monster on the first cell opened
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Fixed ambiguous targeting description on Handbell, Surgical Saw, and Ritual Chalk, which will improve their mage/duplicast targeting
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Blindfold now activates before the Abstract stage mod
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Reverted change to Paragon Rod so that it can drop items with cost 0 again (however, it won't drop Mementos like it used to)
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Book items and Leather Vest now benefit from Electric cells
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Multiple copies of a stage mod that do not increase difficulty (e.g. Nightmare) will no longer provide additional score
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Tangleweed can no longer apply the Double mod to a stage that already has it
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Judging mod now stacks
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Vengeful mod now stacks
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Updated default leaderboard version to 1.48

notes.title: Join the DemonCrawl Beta Program! v1.48 Beta Patch Notes
notes.content:
Today is the grand opening of the [b]DemonCrawl Beta Program[/b]!

Going forward, all major DemonCrawl updates will be subject to a [b]3-7 day beta testing period[/b]. This will give us a chance to catch bugs and respond to critical player feedback before pushing any big changes live. We believe this extra step in our development cycle will have a tremendous effect on the day-1 experience of a new patch.

[b]Gain access to the Beta Program now by pledging your support for DemonCrawl on Patreon:[/b]
[list][*] [url=https://patreon.com/thereforegames]https://patreon.com/thereforegames[/url][/list]

[b]Note[/b] - there are [b]only 100 Beta slots available[/b], so if you're itching to try all the newest features, please consider joining the program before it's too late!

There are a few important distinctions about save profiles created in Beta:
[list][*] They are not compatible with the standard build of DemonCrawl
[*] They start with 1000 Tokens
[*] All masteries unlocked
[*] All gamemodes unlocked
[*] Achievements disabled
[*] Leaderboards disabled
[/list]

We have also dramatically increased the drop rate of new items, bosses, etc, in beta builds.

[b]For more information about our Patreon, please refer to the following blog post:[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1141220/view/2504513502255470056]https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1141220/view/2504513502255470056[/url]


Now, onto the patch notes! [i]The full notes are also available [url=https://demoncrawl.com/v1-48-closed-beta-patch-notes/]on our website[/url]. We expect to deploy v1.48 to the Stable Branch early next week.[/i]

notes.title: Introducing a New Boss: The HECKASLUG!
notes.content:
Hi folks,

[b]DemonCrawl's v1.48 patch is just around the corner![/b] While it mainly serves to address balance issues regarding stage mods and masteries, it will also contain some very exciting new content. In fact, it is our largest update since the Sweeping Heights expansion!

Today, we would like to show you a new boss we have been working on. He's called the [b]Heckaslug[/b], and we must warn you - he's a little bit toxic. (His heart is in the right place though.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/4f7e521039d71c2e3870aa83f754bfaffc13a8a9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/6620de2d896dbc425cecc3a00671807e261b18bc.gif[/img]

[b]HECKASLUG, THE POISON MONGER[/b]
[list][*]Gain Poison whenever a Dark Heart is collected.
[*]Whenever you make a mistake, lose lives equal to your number of Poisons.
[*]Creates a trail of toxic cells.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nlY2880.gif[/img]

For the uninitiated: [url=https://demoncrawl.com/wiki/index.php/Poison]Poison[/url] is an omen that causes you to lose 1 life every 60 turns. [b]This is direct life loss[/b], meaning it can pierce armor and other forms of defense. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/083b283e72e0b8c30733e864a90bc8f06686c944.png[/img]

While omen immunity may help you deal with the effects of Poison, it cannot protect you from Heckaslug's "on mistake" ability. Instead, consider taking advantage of omen or status effect removal. [url=https://demoncrawl.com/wiki/index.php/Leeches]Leeches are a good option![/url]

We hope you enjoyed this first look at the Heckaslug and look forward to facing him in v1.48 very soon.

---

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1141220/DemonCrawl/

notes.title: v1.47 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We are currently working on a large balance patch for next week, but in the meantime we thought our players might appreciate a few simple QoL features, including [b]edge-based panning[/b]. Enjoy!

Full patch notes are below.

---

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[*]Added option for edge-based panning, enabled by default as it is something many new players try

[/list]


[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]

[*]You may now right-click on the favor icon in the codex to reclaim all favor without having to open the tools menu

[/list]


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Fixed a crash related to the "Fatal" boss mod

[*]Fixed a visual bug when applying video settings without changing the display mode
[*]Fixed layering of usable item indicator upon closing the help menu
[*]Pressing alt+enter in the options menu will now update the display mode label
[*]Fixed a glitch related to item transformation and the removal of excess legendary/divine items
[*]Fixed visual glitch on stage select screen if you were killed while trying to abort a stage
[*]Fixed an issue related to status effect visibility
[*]Fixed a visual glitch related to resetting a status effect duration
[*]Fixed doubled text on the Divine Simple Robe
[*]Fixed Nervewrecker expiration not working properly
[*]Fixed a glitch with the Hero Trial description that could cause stats or other quest data to break on reload
[*]Speculative fix for visual glitch related to freezeframe effect while using fullscreen mode
[/list]

[b]EDIT:[/b]
Hotfix @ 9:00 PM EST to correct a new issue with Divine replacements.

Hotfix #2: Fixed a few issues related to Divine Simple Robe, Divine Demon Seed, Protagonist legendary check, and cursor getting stuck on panning sprite.

notes.title: v1.45 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We are releasing a beefy patch for DemonCrawl that offers [b]borderless windowed fullscreen mode[/b]! This was not an easy feature to add in GameMaker, so we hope it proves useful. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/a7b53eb8367908807587d2339b96d0eb9fb4569a.png[/img]


Additionally, this patch includes [b]7 new items[/b], a new [b]Lv3 emblem[/b], several [b]balance adjustments[/b], and more!

We also managed to fix a few longstanding bugs - cloud sync should behave better now!

[b]NOTE:[/b] We had to fundamentally change DemonCrawl's display rendering in order to support the new fullscreen method. Should you encounter any visual issues in this update, please send us an email and we will investigate right away. If necessary, you may adjust your display mode in the settings.ini file located at %localappdata%\demoncrawl. Thank you!

Full patch notes are below. There are some content spoilers.

---

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/c3e339c302a13eb6633b9d0aa0459123f1c7174f.png[/img]

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[list]
[*]New head armor: [b]Deerstalker[/b] - [i]"Cell values are always correct."[/i]
[*]New passive item: [b]Prism of Intellect[/b] - [i]"Your targeted magic items will target an additional random cell."[/i]
[*]New magic item: [b]Trash Bin[/b] - [i]"Lose an item whose position in your inventory equals the value of target visible cell."[/i]
[*]New magic item: [b]Basilisk Eye[/b] - [i]"Solve a number of random cells equal your sealed inventory slots plus 1."[/i]
[*]New omen: [b]Melted Clock[/b] - [i]"Triple the duration of your status effects."[/i]
[*]New omen: [b]Nervewrecker[/b] - [i]"Whenever a monster is revealed, disable your passive items for 20 turns."[/i]
[*]New omen: [b]Dizzy Stars[/b] - [i]"Double the value of a random cell each stage."[/i]
[*]New Lv3 emblem: [b]The Ascent[/b]
[*]Added list UI element type, should come in handy for future game settings
[*]Added borderless windowed fullscreen option
[*]Added language selector (note: official translations are not available yet, but you can load your own external JSONs to change item strings; in other words, fan translations are possible.)
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Hourglass converted to a magic item: [i]"[100 Mana] Double the duration of your status effects."[/i]
[*]Divine Lantern nerf: [i]"[300 Mana] Glean target hidden cell. If it's a 2 or greater, this item retains its mana."[/i]
[*]Divine Simple Robe buff: [i]"[1 Armor] Double the durability whenever you complete a stage that has 2 or more stage mods."[/i]
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed Steam Cloud sync not taking prestige into account when determining whether to overwrite the local save file on a secondary machine
[*]Fixed an issue related to taking damage on a Flawless stage with Cultist boss
[*]Fixed Ouroboros potentially setting the maximum stage power to a value lower than the min power
[*]Fixed missing music from one of the secret stages
[*]Fixed Evil Dealings emblem using incorrect sprite
[*]Fixed a rare crash that could occur when purchasing a Doctor from the Guild
[*]Fixed the "buy" button not working in the new special stages unless you clicked on one of the options first
[*]Fixed weird interaction between familiars and Prism of Light
[*]Fixed layering of "new item" indicator against some UI elements
[*]Fixed a rare issue that could cause obscure item properties to desync (e.g. whether orbs bounce off walls)
[*]Fixed a couple armor effects not updating on removal
[*]Fixed certain effects triggering every time a Smithy was entered
[*]Updated the description of Touchstone to clarify that it can stack (negative diamonds ftw)
[*]Fixed "Blade" sigil reflex not spawning a sawblade
[*]Fixed a crash related to the Amnesia portal mod
[*]Fixed spawn rate of Hidden stage mod
[*]Fixed rare crash related to Infinity Key on Quest 5 Hard
[*]Speculative fix for rare Bag of Tricks crash
[*]Android only: fixed a click detection issue for special selection modes (e.g. crafting)
[/list]

Enjoy!
