notes.content:
Hi folks,

Today, we're releasing a small patch for DemonCrawl that includes a new Emblem, 4 new Glints, and several balance adjustments. Enjoy!

Full patch notes below.

---

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[list]
[*]Added Lv1 emblem: [b]The Descent[/b] - [i]"All stages gain Tunnel mod. Gain Astrolabe. Gain Treasure Amulet."[/i]
[*]Added glint: [b]Scary Glint[/b] - [i]"Remove 10 monsters from each stage"[/i]
[*]Added glint: [b]Sainted Glint[/b] - [i]"The first stage gains a random positive mod"[/i]
[*]Added glint: [b]Weakening Glint[/b] - [i]"Reduce the stage power of all stages by 1"[/i]
[*]Added glint: [b]Friendly Glint[/b]- [i]"Spawn 5 strangers in bubbles at the start of the quest"[/i]
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Educational stage mod sign density reduced from 8% to 6%
[*]Explosive stage mod activation chance reduced from 30% to 25%
[*]Dark Chest curse can no longer add a mod to the current stage
[*]Very slightly reduced the Emblem density multiplier in Beyond
[/list]


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Fixed Harbinger not showing item descriptions in bottom panel
[*]Fixed Familiars not counting as living objects for the purposes of effects (e.g. Spark mastery)
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Timelord boss mod to proc multiple times per minute
[*]Fixed Reclamation emblem not providing Pennypincher item
[*]Fixed a glitch that would permit item crafting on metaprogression materials
[*]Fixed Lumberjack II unintentionally increasing Sawblade durability after each stage
[*]Fixed a crash when using Lumberjack ability while orbs other than Sawblades were present
[*]Fixed "Unstable" Sigil suffix mod icon not showing up in the hud
[*]Fixed Spark mastery being able to activate before monsters have spawned
[*]Fixed a rare crash related to Nightmare mod and Brain in a Vat
[*]Fixed Marksman II activating on all kinds of monster reveals
[*]Fixed UI overlap after dying to a Mimic
[*]Fixed a regression that could cause hidden immutable objects to get destroyed by explosions
[*]Reworked Golem Glove's trigger code so that it no longer interferes with the first click of a stage
[*]Fixed a softlock that could occur when opening the escape menu during a cutscene
[*]Fixed Altar of Blood and Magic Totem bypassing Bruises' power immutability
[*]Fixed a rare bug that could cause auto-discharge items to auto-discharge before they were ready
[*]Possible workaround for crash related to Hero Trial restart
[*]Speculative fix for crash related to "check_immutable" script
[/list]

[b]EDIT:[/b]

Hotfix #1 @ June 6th, 3:50 PM

[list]
[*]Fixed crash related to Boom Bow Mage targeting an empty cell
[*]Fixed crash from popping paint out of a bubble
[*]Fixed Powder Keg Mage not detonating its barrel after 5s
[*]Powerchording now activates before status effect timers, giving you an extra turn with Knuckles items
[*]Fixed Manabank toast stating incorrect amount of mana gained
[*]Fixed potential issue with saving the current mastery after beating Q5H
[*]Fixed paint sound effect not playing
[*]Fixed items like Dumbbell interfering with sources of max life loss
[*]Fixed minor alignment issue with status effect HUD
[*]Speculative fix for Constant Reminder emblem status effect crash
[/list]

notes.title: Sweeping Heights Expansion is Now Live! (v1.41 Patch Notes)
notes.content:
That's right - DemonCrawl's first expansion is [b]FINALLY HERE![/b]


We are celebrating launch week with a [b]15% discount[/b] for the base game. [b]The Sweeping Heights expansion is free for all DemonCrawl players.[/b] (Sale begins at 1 PM EST.)


---

After 3 months of development, we are very excited to bring you a massive number of new features and quality-of-life changes to DemonCrawl.

The endgame has been completely overhauled with a new metaprogression system called [b]Sigils[/b]. Use special crafting materials to optimize your Sigil and maximize your chances of beating the new super-deadly Lv3 Beyond Quests. 

Not to mention:

[list]
[*]     [b]7[/b] new masteries that dramatically alter gameplay
[*]     Over [b]50[/b] new items
[*]     The Endless Multiverse 2.0
[*]     Bosses now have powerful boss mods
[*]     Beyond Quest overhaul - more intricate/refined system for creating Beyond quests
[*]     [b]5[/b] new special stages: the Guild, Academy, Lighthouse, Smithy, and Starpond
[*]     [b]4[/b] new strangers: the Doctor, Gambler, Mage and Guide
[*]     Ability to sell artifacts and other metaprogression materials for Tokens
[*]New music
[*]     Completing the daily Hero Trial now rewards you with a prizebox instead of a flat amount of Tokens
[*]     Tons of quality of life and bug fixes
[/list]

We're including the patch notes below for those who want all the nitty-gritty details. If you don't want any spoilers, feel free to stop reading and start sweeping!

---

[h1]v1.41 Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]Note:[/b] These patch notes are mostly unchanged from last week's preview post. Differences are prefixed with the following icon: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img]


[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list][*][b]Beyond Mode overhaul[/b]
	[list][*]Base Token cost reduced to 1
	[*]There are now 3 different levels of emblems
		[list][*]Quest length, difficulty, and material cost is determined by the emblem level
		[*]Beyond Quests can have up to 6 stages now
			[list][*]Past the 3rd stage, Beyond will utilize hybrid skins similar to Endless Multiverse
			[/list]
		[*]Emblems give you access to new types of prizebox rewards (more below)
		[*]Prizebox droprates have been overhauled to accommodate new reward types
		[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] 16 new emblems
		[*]Emblem sprites have been updated to visually correspond to their level
		[*]Each emblem is more likely to have a certain boss and sigil effect (toggle the information tooltip with right click)
		[*]There are also exceedingly rare [b]Mythic Emblems[/b]
			[list][*]Each Mythic Emblem has specific conditions to trigger a chance at its drop
			[*]There are unique divine items associated with each Mythic Emblem
			[*]Mythic Emblems have specific ingredient costs
			[*]Elemental Triumvirate is now considered a Mythic Emblem
			[/list]
		[/list]
	[*]Worldclay removed from the game - existing Worldclay artifacts have been converted to Tokens
	[*]New optional Beyond ingredient: [b]Glints[/b]
		[list][*]Adds beneficial properties to your Beyond run
		[*]The Treasure Within emblem has been converted to a glint
		[*]There are 12 different kinds of glints
		[/list]
	[/list]
[*]Added new form of metaprogression: [b]Sigils[/b]
	[list][*]Only available in prizeboxes for Beyond runs that have been enhanced with emblems
	[*]The level of sigil you can find corresponds to the emblem level
	[*]Sigil effects are randomized both numerically and in terms of which effects get paired together
	[*]The sigil's LV1 ability is an effect that activates automatically--upon certain conditions--once per stage
	[*]The sigil's LV2 ability is a conditional, ongoing passive buff, e.g. [i]"coins are 34% more common while you are not injured."[/i]
	[*]The sigil's LV3 ability is an effect that improves the sigil itself, e.g. [i]"this sigil has a 20% chance to remain charged after use."[/i]
	[*]All sigils have a minor negative passive effect as well
	[*]Sigils have a set durability and must be repaired using special materials once they break (more below)
	[*]Extremely rare chance to find a shiny sigil that has 10% greater numeric values
	[*]Every sigil has a unique appearance based on its effects
	[/list]
[*]Added sigil crafting material: [b]Oilstone[/b] - [i]"Restore 50 durability to a sigil"[/i]
[*]Added sigil crafting material: [b]Jupiter Needle[/b] - [i]"Reroll the impulses of a sigil."[/i]
[*]Added sigil crafting material: [b]Moon Bottle[/b] - [i]"Reroll the reflexes of a sigil."[/i]
[*]Added sigil crafting material: [b]Saturn Square[/b] - [i]"Reroll the numeric properties of a sigil."[/i]
[*]Added sigil crafting material: [b]Star of Chaos[/b] - [i]"Upgrade a broken sigil to the next level."[/i]
[*]Added Chaote talent that increases the maximum number of sigils you can store at a time

[*][b]Endless Multiverse overhaul[/b]
	[list][*]After the first dimension, Metagate gains Portal Mods
		[list][*]Portal Mods increase the difficulty of the following dimension
[*]There are currently 13 different Portal Mods in the pool
		[/list]
	[*]You will always begin on Dimension 1
	[*]New exclusive landmark: [b]Vault[/b]
		[list][*]You may store a certain item in the Vault
		[*]The next time you encounter a Vault, you can retrieve your item and leave a different item in its place
		[*]Your Vault item will persist between dimensions
		[*]Vaults are fairly common by landmark standards; a bit less common than Signs
		[/list]
	[*]New exclusive stranger: [b]Guide[/b]
		[list][*]Can only spawn in Metagate
		[*]Pay him to preserve some items, stats, etc as you travel through the Dimensional Portal
		[*]You cannot pay a Guide more than once
		[/list]
	[*]New exclusive sub-category of legendary items: [b]Mementos[/b]
		[list][*]Mementos are only available in Endless Multiverse Item Shops for 10-20 coins
		[*]Mementos allow you to retain some of your strength going into the next dimension, but only if you can meet special conditions
		[*]There is a Memento designed around the gameplay mechanics of every mastery
		[/list]
	[*]Added UI element in dimensions 2 and above that explains the properties of your current dimension
	[*]Black Hole removed from the Token Shop
	[/list]
[*]Hero Trial leaderboards will now track cumulative first place scores (Winner Mode)
	[list][*]Leaderboard filters allow you to toggle between regular leaderboards and Winner Mode
	[*]Earn cosmetic rewards for achieving 1, 10, and 100 points in Winner Mode
	[*]We may perform seasonal resets for Winner Mode eventually - TBD
	[/list]
[*]Hero Trial now rewards you with a prizebox instead of Tokens
[*]Expanded Hero Trial effect pool
[*]Bosses can now have Boss Mods
	[list][*]There are currently 22 different Boss Mods in the pool
	[*]In the Endless Multiverse, bosses start accumulating mods with each dimension
	[*]In Beyond mode, bosses get a number of mods equal to your emblem level
	[*]Bosses do not have any mods in Hard mode
	[*]Right click to toggle between boss info and Boss Mod tooltips
	[/list]
[*]New stranger: [b]Doctor[/b]
	[list][*]She will restore a certain amount of lives for a low price, but will collect more coins from you later when you leave the stage
	[*]You can enlist her services multiple times, but her cost will increase sharply each time
	[/list]
[*]New stranger: [b]Gambler[/b]
	[list][*]Pay a certain amount of coins and he will travel to a random hidden cell
	[*]If the cell was empty, he wins the bet and keeps your money
	[*]If the cell had a monster, the Gambler dies and you can pick up your coins along with any other coins he was holding
	[*]Each turn, the Gambler has a chance to lose some of his held coins due to poor investments
	[/list]
[*]New stranger: [b]Mage[/b]
	[list][*]Pay a small amount of coins and the Mage will cast a specific targeted magic item at a random location
	[*]The magic item will still use its normal radius, i.e. Dynamite Mage will target a 3x3 area
	[*]After casting his item, you must collect some mana before you can pay the Mage again
	[*]Big thank you to DemonCrawl player [b]Snorlaxxo[/b] for coming up with this awesome idea for a stranger!
	[/list]
[*]New landmark: [b]Barrel[/b]
	[list][*]Barrels will apply anything that affects their cell to surrounding 5x5 area
	[*]For example, if you burn a Barrel, all cells in a 5x5 area gain Burning
	[*]They can even spread targeted magic items to the surrounding area
	[*]Warning: familiars are dumb enough to detonate Barrels by walking into them
	[/list]
[*][b]5 new special stages[/b]
	[list][*][b]Guild[/b]
		[list][*]Purchase strangers and spawn them in bubbles
		[*]You may buy the same stranger multiple times
		[*]Each Guild has a random selection of strangers
		[/list]
	[*][b]Academy[/b]
		[list][*]Replace your mastery with one of 3 random masteries
		[*]Your new mastery will be tier 3 even if you don't have it unlocked
		[*]It starts fully charged
		[/list]
	[*][b]Lighthouse[/b]
		[list][*] Reduce the difficulty of the following stage by choosing 1 of 3 options at no cost:
		[*](1) Remove monsters, (2) remove a random stage mod, or (3) reduce the stage power
		[*] It can only affect the closest non-special stage, which encourages you to use the Lighthouse as soon as it is unlocked
		[/list]
	[*][b]Smithy[/b]
		[list][*]Purchase random head, body, or leg armor
		[*]You must complete another stage before your armor is ready
		[*]Return to the Smithy later to collect your item
		[/list]
	[*][b]Starpond[/b]
		[list][*]Purchase metaprogression items such as emblems and artifacts for Tokens and coins
		[*]Found in the second half of every quest on Hard mode and above
		[*]Does not replace an existing Item Shop
		[/list]
	[/list]
[*][b]7 new masteries[/b]
	[list][*][b]Spark[/b] - [i]Connect the stage with electricity to solve the board in a unique way (Designed with the help of the community! <3 )[/i]
	[*][b]Marksman[/b] - [i]Create strategic cell chains to kill monsters before they can kill you[/i]
	[*][b]Bubbler[/b] - [i]Manipulate the power of bubbles to duplicate loot and solve cells[/i]
	[*][b]Lumberjack[/b] - [i]Deploy and manage Sawblades to wipe the map clean[/i]
	[*][b]Undertaker[/b] - [i]Generate a consistent supply of Bones by consuming other items[/i]
	[*][b]Protagonist[/b] - [i]Guaranteed legendaries. Enough said[/i]
	[*][b]Knight[/b] - [i]Overhauled into a completely new armor mastery[/i]
[list][*]The old Knight mastery is now known as Guardian[/list]
	[/list]
[*][b]52 new items[/b]
	[list][*]New keyword: [b]Chain[/b] - [i]"Making two or more consecutive turns by clicking on cells with the same value."[/i]
	[*]New keyword: [b]Powerchord[/b] - [i]"When you fully and correctly solve a cell by chording, reveal nearby cells and kill any monsters within."[/i]
	[/list]
[*]6 new divine items
[*]12 new stage mods
[*]10 new avatars created by the talented [url=https://linktr.ee/samcaron]Sam Caron[/url]
[*]HUD now shows stage power at all times
[*]New loadout editor for Masteries and Sigils
[*]Improved the graphics of the 3 secret Endless Multiverse stages
[*]New original music by Levi Tuoremaa for the Beyond Ego boss fight
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Added 12 other boss songs - these only play if the boss has at least 1 mod
[*]Added a new category to the Codex that displays your artifacts and other metaprogression items
[*]You can now sell artifacts for Tokens
[*]The Codex now displays how many times you have acquired each item
[*]Replaced Codex pagination with scrollbar
[*]A few other visual improvements to Codex interface
[*]Added Codex tool that lets you quickly reclaim all favored slots
[*]Added 2 Codex profile slots for a total of 5 slots
[*]You can now click Codex stat icons to quickly search for favored items, blueprints, and divines
[*]New heirloom crafting UI
[*]New look for item targeting
[*]You may now sell rare loot (i.e. artifacts, emblems) for Tokens in the Codex
[*]Added many new terms to monster name generator
[*]Added new rule to monster name generator that will swap certain "prefix" and "suffix" name parts on occasion
[*]Added setting to adjust board panning sensitivity
[*]New hard-mode specific sign messages
[*]Added "orb" as a Library research subject
[*]Added credits button to the options screen
[*]Added button to reset options to defaults
[*]Added a button to open the escape menu through the help screen
[*]Added category to the help screen that allows you to see all of your status effects at any time
[*]Daily Missions are now visible from the help screen
[*]Implemented the foundation of localization support
[list][*]Added translation support for item names and descriptions
[*]Added translation support for mods
[*]Remaining game strings have yet to be mapped to external files - more to come soon
[/list]
[*]Reworked several prestige rewards to accommodate new endgame
[list][*]Prestige 3: "Gain another Daily Mission slot"
	[*]Prestige 6: "Small chance to find a Glint when you level up"
	[*]Prestige 9: "Starponds will have an additional item for sale"
[/list]
[*]Windows only: Added a video setting that lets you simplify the effects in the Customize screen for better performance
[*]Windows only: Added an option that lets you confine your cursor to the game window
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Added achievements for new masteries on Steam
[/list]
	
[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list][*]Tooltips that mention items will now produce item descriptions at the bottom of the screen
[*]Improved design of lists shown in tooltips
[*]"Timelord Chronos" renamed to "Chronos"
[*]"Lost Shaman" renamed to "Spellbinder"
[*]Improved readibility of stage title against Endless Multiverse background
[*]Added dropshadow and rounded corners to stage thumbnails
[*]The Silenced stage mod now disables music
[*]Timeless stage mod now slows down the music, Withering mod speeds it up
[*]Values exceeding 999 will be shortened to "1K" to conserve UI space in many places
[*]Reversed the default direction of board panning controls based on user feedback
[*]If DemonCrawl crashes during quest load, you will be prompted to start a new quest on your next load attempt
[*]Added new animation when activating certain landmarks (e.g. Meteorites, Vaults)
[*]Added new animation for strangers that "go away" (e.g. paying a Harbinger)
[*]Added a "chain warning" system to indicate which cells can complete a chain-related effect
[*]Added animation when an object moves to another cell
[*]Updated question mark button sprite
[*]Updated Wizard and Commander mastery sprites to differentiate them from new masteries
[*]New sprite for Viking Helmet
[*]New sprite for Shinobi Veil
[*]Reloading a stage in Hard Mode will create a help menu entry about the 60-second timer penalty
[*]Improved appearance of directional arrow on strangers (Pyro, Waterboy)
[*]A quantity alert will appear after collecting rare loot from a chest
[*]When you beat a classic stage, automatically reveal all monsters
[*]Adjusted Beyond quest background image for better readability
[*]The Codex no longer hides legendary items that were unlocked on a past prestige
[*]Setting the toast lifespan to 0 will disable alerts entirely
[*]Minor improvements to the following stage graphics: Womb, Arctic, Metropolis, Skies, Wonder
[*]The inbox system now supports holograph and paint reward types
[*]Adjusted bottom HUD spacing to prevent UI overlap
[*]Limited the number of visible status effects in stage view, may improve performance slightly
[*]Empty help menu pages now display "no results found" message
[*]New player profile names are now capped to 50px in width (~12 characters) to prevent UI overlap
[*]Clarified Double XP tooltip to let players know that it only affects Victory Award points
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list][*]Commander I rework to reduce accidental activation: [i]"Unflag a cell to recruit a familiar to a nearby empty cell for 5 coins."[/i]
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Commander II rework: [i]"Whenever a familiar collects loot, perform a unique action based on the type of loot."[/i]
[*]Rare loot now scales with Endless Multiverse dimensions
[*]Rare loot modifiers now affect secondary chest rewards as well (artifacts, sigil materials)
[*]Bosses now have a chance to dodge explosions: 50% + 5% for each boss mod
[*]Bosses now have a chance to burst out of Frozen cells: 5% per turn + 5% for each boss mod
[*]Bosses now have a chance to pop themselves out of bubbles: 5% per turn + 5% for each boss mod
[*]Converted Godly Goblet from passive to magic: [i]"[200 Mana] Lose a legendary item and gain a revive."[/i]
[*]Pheromones rework: [i]"Every 300 cells opened, gain a copy of an item that you have two or more of."[/i]
[*]Chainsaw rework: [i]"Spawn a Sawblade on target empty cell and set its lifespan to the length of your chain."[/i]
[*]Magic Smoke Bomb mana cost increased from 150 to 200
[*]Divine Watering Can mana cost increased from 250 to 400
[*]Shadow Siphon mana cost increased from 90 to 120
[*]Thornseeker mana cost increased from 70 to 90
[*]Nightmare Gut price increased from 24 to 29
[*]Transendence price increased from 40 to 50
[*]Paragon Rod price increased from 50 to 80
[*]Ouroboros price increased from 75 to 90
[*]Evermetal price reduced from 28 to 22
[*]Cullstone price reduced from 14 to 11
[*]Buckshot price reduced from 17 to 14
[*]World Wonder price reduced from 19 to 16
[*]Wyrm Scale price reduced from 20 to 13
[*]Holy Ring price reduced from 27 to 15
[*]Ankh price reduced from 35 to 27
[*]Wizard Boots price reduced from 16 to 13
[*]Witches Brew price reduced from 23 to 17
[*]Bloomberries price reduced from 25 to 23
[*]Second Wind price reduced from 50 to 40
[*]Blind Justice price reduced from 24 to 15
[*]Reduced the base difficulty of Endless Multiverse
[*]Items that increase the drop rate of certain strangers (e.g. Bindle) have been toned down slightly
[*]Items that auto-complete stages (e.g. Dreamborne) no longer work in the Metagate
[*]The "restore life" Hungry Plant now gives souls instead
[*]Shiny monsters are less common
[*]The item trigger script no longer evaluates items that were received during the same trigger sequence
[*]The "Computer Simulation" emblem has a new divine reward; the old reward has been moved to the "Original Sin" emblem
[*]Opening a chest now counts as collecting loot for the purposes of item effects
[*]Adjusted several item crafting recipes
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] The chance for Explosive mod to proc has been reduced from 50% to 30%
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed buggy interaction between Truthsayer Quill and Leftovers
[*]Fixed a bug when blowing up Frozen cells containing objects
[*]Fixed Wizard armor not counting for "Matching Metals" achievement
[*]Abandoning a Classic stage through the escape menu will no longer remove ongoing quest data
[*]Divine Watering Can no longer has a targetable selection
[*]Speculative fix for rare crash involving orbs that were not initialized properly
[*]Capped the number of simultaneous orbs to 1000 to prevent potential softlocks
[*]Fixed Sawblade lifespan not persisting between loads
[*]Codex profiles can no longer be switched during a quest
[*]Fixed a crash that could occur if the alert log was full
[*]Fixed Dark Chests not persisting between loads
[*]Fixed Witch ability incorrectly activating on stage reload
[*]Fixed Pyro and Waterboy direction not saving to disk in some cases
[*]Fixed Hunter ability not saving to disk
[*]You can no longer click on Burning cells behind the help menu
[*]Treasure chests can no longer trigger the Explosive mod during their opening animation
[*]Fixed level indicator not updating on end stage screen after leveling up
[*]Fixed Beyond Mode not utilizing secret alt stages
[*]Fixed a typo on Trust Buster
[*]Fixed a crash related to Supply and Diamond activating when there is no space for loot
[*]Fixed level-based legendaries interfering with the completion of "Infinite Wisdom" achievement
[*]Fixed Shop Key activating "coins lost" script instead of "coins spent" script
[*]Fixed Medusa Head not always unsealing the correct number of inventory slots
[*]Fixed Divine Voucher not working correctly when used on a divine shop item
[*]Fixed a rare issue that could cause Divine Lantern to lose its mana regardless of the gleaned cell value
[*]Fixed a hard lock related to consuming an Extravagance while holding another Extravagance
[*]Fixed Flawless mod not triggering "on mistake" effects when kicking the player out of the stage
[*]Fixed Mirror not activating a few item effects such as Alcohol
[*]Fixed a crash related to collecting a heart when you have Book of Faith without its status effect
[*]Fixed an issue related to projectile positioning while panning and zooming at the same time
[*]Fixed Book item effects not stacking
[*]Fixed a couple bugs in the board autosolver that caused it to miss some solvable scenarios
[*]Fixed tooltip flickering while panning the board
[*]Fixed Sun Bomb not working on Frozen cells
[*]Fixed some status effect messages not showing up after completion
[*]Fixed Golden armor not counting toward "Matching Metals" achievement
[*]Fixed a visual issue that could cause loot to appear above the UI layer
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause buttons to incorrectly appear as hovered
[*]The minimum stage size is now 4x4 to prevent weird stuff from happening
[*]The Timeless mod now prevents the reset of mistake-based status effects
[*]Brotherhood Crest now uses the standardized "loot move" script
[*]Recoded a number of passive items so they may utilize the standard item trigger script
[*]Recoded a number of status effect items for better flexibility with other effects
[*]Updated Blessed Clasp description to clarify that it only triggers on mistakes, not other sources of damage
[*]Improved flexibility of "auto discharge" magic item script
[*]Fixed a glitch that allowed a Hero Trial score to be submitted even if the trial had already changed to a new one
[*]Fixed targeted magic items with status effects becoming re-held if you managed to recharge the item before its status was over
[*]Fixed Tunnel mod size and density persisting after stage completion
[*]Fixed an issue with the help screen that could cause the bottom hud to become slightly misaligned
[*]The main chest item will always appear on the left, before other possible rewards (e.g. Herbs' Potion)
[*]Fixed fake values over 8 not showing up correctly
[*]Fixed Contagion bypassing omen immunity
[*]You can no longer acquire an heirloom with a full inventory
[*]You can no longer activate Nomads that sell items if you have a full inventory
[*]Fixed "destroy all objects" curse from Dark Chest not affecting Strangers or Landmarks
[*]Fixed a bug related to Divine Shadowbind creating blank inventory spaces under very specific circumstances
[*]Fixed a hard lock that occurred when a Bagman was sacrificed by a cursed cell on a stage with Baglord
[*]Speculative fix for crash related to Shade movement on same turn as getting kicked out of stage
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Clarified Steam mastery achievements by specifying that they only unlock on Normal or above
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Fixed Wyrm Scale showing wrong sprite in alerts
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Fixed open keybind bypassing Burn damage
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016626/d5dc46e7a14f81c415dfd82398fcf56ecb93a0c1.png[/img] Fixed Thought Bubble not deleting orbs properly upon exiting game view
[/list]


[h1]What's Next?[/h1]

We will spend the next couple days closely monitoring Discord and the Steam Forums for new bug reports. With an update this large, there's a good chance we will need to release a hotfix or two. We are ready to act quickly if any serious issues are discovered.

Once the dust has settled, we will turn our attention to finalizing the Android build of Sweeping Heights. Our hope is to have it ready by the end of the week. However, if we run into any unforeseen issues, we will be sure to let you know!

Finally, we wish to embark on the following projects very soon:

[list]
[*]Translations (we have already implemented the foundation of localization support by allowing DemonCrawl to read item strings from external files.)
[*]Additional ports (likely Nintendo Switch or iOS for starters)
[/list]

...Both of which will probably require the bulk of our attention for the second half of 2020.

---

Thank you for reading, and we hope you enjoy the expansion!

notes.title: Sweeping Heights Full Patch Notes!
notes.content:
Hi folks!

The Sweeping Heights expansion is nearly upon us! In anticipation of its Tuesday release, [b]we would like to share the full patch notes with you.[/b] Given the size of this update, we felt it was important to give our community a chance to discuss some of these changes before they go live.

We're hanging out on the [url=https://discord.gg/wqkWcc5]DemonCrawl Discord server[/url] today, so feel free to drop by if you have any questions for us!

[b]Note[/b]: there may be minor differences in the patch notes between now and release. Also, please be aware that the notes do contain minor spoilers.

Without further ado, please enjoy the changelog!

---

[h1]v1.41 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list][*][b]Beyond Mode overhaul[/b]
	[list][*]Base Token cost reduced to 1
	[*]There are now 3 different levels of emblems
		[list][*]Quest length, difficulty, and material cost is determined by the emblem level
		[*]Beyond Quests can have up to 6 stages now
			[list][*]Past the 3rd stage, Beyond will utilize hybrid skins similar to Endless Multiverse
			[/list]
		[*]Emblems give you access to new types of prizebox rewards (more below)
		[*]Prizebox droprates have been overhauled to accommodate new reward types
		[*]15 new emblems
		[*]Emblem sprites have been updated to visually correspond to their level
		[*]Each emblem is more likely to have a certain boss and sigil effect (toggle the information tooltip with right click)
		[*]There are also exceedingly rare [b]Mythic Emblems[/b]
			[list][*]Each Mythic Emblem has specific conditions to trigger a chance at its drop
			[*]There are unique divine items associated with each Mythic Emblem
			[*]Mythic Emblems have specific ingredient costs
			[*]Elemental Triumvirate is now considered a Mythic Emblem
			[/list]
		[/list]
	[*]Worldclay removed from the game - existing Worldclay artifacts have been converted to Tokens
	[*]New optional Beyond ingredient: [b]Glints[/b]
		[list][*]Adds beneficial properties to your Beyond run
		[*]The Treasure Within emblem has been converted to a glint
		[*]There are 12 different kinds of glints
		[/list]
	[/list]
[*]Added new form of metaprogression: [b]Sigils[/b]
	[list][*]Only available in prizeboxes for Beyond runs that have been enhanced with emblems
	[*]The level of sigil you can find corresponds to the emblem level
	[*]Sigil effects are randomized both numerically and in terms of which effects get paired together
	[*]The sigil's LV1 ability is an effect that activates automatically--upon certain conditions--once per stage
	[*]The sigil's LV2 ability is a conditional, ongoing passive buff, e.g. [i]"coins are 34% more common while you are not injured."[/i]
	[*]The sigil's LV3 ability is an effect that improves the sigil itself, e.g. [i]"this sigil has a 20% chance to remain charged after use."[/i]
	[*]All sigils have a minor negative passive effect as well
	[*]Sigils have a set durability and must be repaired using special materials once they break (more below)
	[*]Extremely rare chance to find a shiny sigil that has 10% greater numeric values
	[*]Every sigil has a unique appearance based on its effects
	[/list]
[*]Added sigil crafting material: [b]Oilstone[/b] - [i]"Restore 50 durability to a sigil"[/i]
[*]Added sigil crafting material: [b]Jupiter Needle[/b] - [i]"Reroll the impulses of a sigil."[/i]
[*]Added sigil crafting material: [b]Moon Bottle[/b] - [i]"Reroll the reflexes of a sigil."[/i]
[*]Added sigil crafting material: [b]Saturn Square[/b] - [i]"Reroll the numeric properties of a sigil."[/i]
[*]Added sigil crafting material: [b]Star of Chaos[/b] - [i]"Upgrade a broken sigil to the next level."[/i]
[*]Added Chaote talent that increases the maximum number of sigils you can store at a time

[*][b]Endless Multiverse overhaul[/b]
	[list][*]After the first dimension, Metagate gains Portal Mods
		[list][*]Portal Mods increase the difficulty of the following dimension
[*]There are currently 13 different Portal Mods in the pool
		[/list]
	[*]You will always begin on Dimension 1
	[*]New exclusive landmark: [b]Vault[/b]
		[list][*]You may store a certain item in the Vault
		[*]The next time you encounter a Vault, you can retrieve your item and leave a different item in its place
		[*]Your Vault item will persist between dimensions
		[*]Vaults are fairly common by landmark standards; a bit less common than Signs
		[/list]
	[*]New exclusive stranger: [b]Guide[/b]
		[list][*]Can only spawn in Metagate
		[*]Pay him to preserve some items, stats, etc as you travel through the Dimensional Portal
		[*]You cannot pay a Guide more than once
		[/list]
	[*]New exclusive sub-category of legendary items: [b]Mementos[/b]
		[list][*]Mementos are only available in Endless Multiverse Item Shops for 10-20 coins
		[*]Mementos allow you to retain some of your strength going into the next dimension, but only if you can meet special conditions
		[*]There is a Memento designed around the gameplay mechanics of every mastery
		[/list]
	[*]Added UI element in dimensions 2 and above that explains the properties of your current dimension
	[*]Black Hole removed from the Token Shop
	[/list]
[*]Hero Trial leaderboards will now track cumulative first place scores (Winner Mode)
	[list][*]Leaderboard filters allow you to toggle between regular leaderboards and Winner Mode
	[*]Earn cosmetic rewards for achieving 1, 10, and 100 points in Winner Mode
	[*]We may perform seasonal resets for Winner Mode eventually - TBD
	[/list]
[*]Hero Trial now rewards you with a prizebox instead of Tokens
[*]Expanded Hero Trial effect pool
[*]Bosses can now have Boss Mods
	[list][*]There are currently 22 different Boss Mods in the pool
	[*]In the Endless Multiverse, bosses start accumulating mods with each dimension
	[*]In Beyond mode, bosses get a number of mods equal to your emblem level
	[*]Bosses do not have any mods in Hard mode
	[*]Right click to toggle between boss info and Boss Mod tooltips
	[/list]
[*]New stranger: [b]Doctor[/b]
	[list][*]She will restore a certain amount of lives for a low price, but will collect more coins from you later when you leave the stage
	[*]You can enlist her services multiple times, but her cost will increase sharply each time
	[/list]
[*]New stranger: [b]Gambler[/b]
	[list][*]Pay a certain amount of coins and he will travel to a random hidden cell
	[*]If the cell was empty, he wins the bet and keeps your money
	[*]If the cell had a monster, the Gambler dies and you can pick up your coins along with any other coins he was holding
	[*]Each turn, the Gambler has a chance to lose some of his held coins due to poor investments
	[/list]
[*]New stranger: [b]Mage[/b]
	[list][*]Pay a small amount of coins and the Mage will cast a specific targeted magic item at a random location
	[*]The magic item will still use its normal radius, i.e. Dynamite Mage will target a 3x3 area
	[*]After casting his item, you must collect some mana before you can pay the Mage again
	[*]Big thank you to DemonCrawl player [b]Snorlaxxo[/b] for coming up with this awesome idea for a stranger!
	[/list]
[*]New landmark: [b]Barrel[/b]
	[list][*]Barrels will apply anything that affects their cell to surrounding 5x5 area
	[*]For example, if you burn a Barrel, all cells in a 5x5 area gain Burning
	[*]They can even spread targeted magic items to the surrounding area
	[*]Warning: familiars are dumb enough to detonate Barrels by walking into them
	[/list]
[*][b]5 new special stages[/b]
	[list][*][b]Guild[/b]
		[list][*]Purchase strangers and spawn them in bubbles
		[*]You may buy the same stranger multiple times
		[*]Each Guild has a random selection of strangers
		[/list]
	[*][b]Academy[/b]
		[list][*]Replace your mastery with one of 3 random masteries
		[*]Your new mastery will be tier 3 even if you don't have it unlocked
		[*]It starts fully charged
		[/list]
	[*][b]Lighthouse[/b]
		[list][*] Reduce the difficulty of the following stage by choosing 1 of 3 options at no cost:
		[*](1) Remove monsters, (2) remove a random stage mod, or (3) reduce the stage power
		[*] It can only affect the closest non-special stage, which encourages you to use the Lighthouse as soon as it is unlocked
		[/list]
	[*][b]Smithy[/b]
		[list][*]Purchase random head, body, or leg armor
		[*]You must complete another stage before your armor is ready
		[*]Return to the Smithy later to collect your item
		[/list]
	[*][b]Starpond[/b]
		[list][*]Purchase metaprogression items such as emblems and artifacts for Tokens and coins
		[*]Found in the second half of every quest on Hard mode and above
		[*]Does not replace an existing Item Shop
		[/list]
	[/list]
[*][b]7 new masteries[/b]
	[list][*][b]Spark[/b] - [i]Connect the stage with electricity to solve the board in a unique way (Designed with the help of the community! <3 )[/i]
	[*][b]Marksman[/b] - [i]Create strategic cell chains to kill monsters before they can kill you[/i]
	[*][b]Bubbler[/b] - [i]Manipulate the power of bubbles to duplicate loot and solve cells[/i]
	[*][b]Lumberjack[/b] - [i]Deploy and manage Sawblades to wipe the map clean[/i]
	[*][b]Undertaker[/b] - [i]Generate a consistent supply of Bones by consuming other items[/i]
	[*][b]Protagonist[/b] - [i]Guaranteed legendaries. Enough said[/i]
	[*][b]Knight[/b] - [i]Overhauled into a completely new armor mastery[/i]
[list][*]The old Knight mastery is now known as Guardian[/list]
	[/list]
[*][b]52 new items[/b]
	[list][*]New keyword: [b]Chain[/b] - [i]"Making two or more consecutive turns by clicking on cells with the same value."[/i]
	[*]New keyword: [b]Powerchord[/b] - [i]"When you fully and correctly solve a cell by chording, reveal nearby cells and kill any monsters within."[/i]
	[/list]
[*]6 new divine items
[*]12 new stage mods
[*]10 new avatars created by the talented [url=https://linktr.ee/samcaron]Sam Caron[/url]
[*]HUD now shows stage power at all times

notes.title: Sweeping Heights launches June 2nd!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dOBPthu.png[/img]

We are very excited to announce that DemonCrawl's first expansion, Sweeping Heights, will be releasing on Steam [b]June 2nd, 2020[/b]! That's less than a couple weeks away!

Sweeping Heights is a massive content update that completely overhauls the endgame and introduces many new items, mechanics, and cosmetic rewards. After 3 months of non-stop development, we are quite pleased with the fruit of our labor, and we think you will be too.

As a way of thanking you for your tremendous support, [b]we have decided to make Sweeping Heights available for free, forever[/b]. (You just need to own a copy of the base game.)


[img]https://i.imgur.com/iYZKcK5.png[/img]

[h3]Some of the new features you can expect from Sweeping Heights:[/h3]
[list][*] 7 exciting new masteries
[*] Over 50 new items
[*] The Endless Multiverse 2.0
[*] Bosses now have powerful boss mods
[*] New metaprogression system called "Sigils." These new endgame items have randomized properties that can be rerolled using crafting materials
[*] Beyond Quest overhaul - more intricate/refined system for creating Beyond quests
[*] 5 new special stages: the Guild, Academy, Lighthouse, Smithy, and Starpond
[*] 4 new strangers: the Doctor, Gambler, Mage and Guide
[*] Ability to sell artifacts and other metaprogression materials for Tokens
[*] Completing the daily Hero Trial now rewards you with a prizebox instead of a flat amount of Tokens
[*] Tons of quality of life and bug fixes
[/list]

...There's more, but you'll have to wait to find out ;)

Also, if you haven't seen it yet, we invite you to check out our recent trailer for the Endless Multiverse overhaul:

[previewyoutube=zBN_DtOfTy8;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you so much for reading! We will have more to share with you soon.

Stay safe.

notes.title: Introducing the Endless Multiverse 2.0!
notes.content:
We are very excited to unveil the [b]Endless Multiverse 2.0[/b], a complete overhaul for one of DemonCrawl's most ambitious gamemodes! 

Check out our video spotlight below:

[previewyoutube=zBN_DtOfTy8;full][/previewyoutube]

The core loop of the Multiverse has been drastically altered as follows:

[list][*] Dimensional Portals no longer require you to sacrifice items or stats to proceed. Instead, they will automatically reset your inventory and stats to starting values. (A fresh slate.)
[*] The Metagate will acquire a new "Portal Mod" with each dimension. These special mods will impact the difficulty of the following dimension in interesting ways.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/K673g55.png[/img]

Meanwhile, players will gain access to a number of awesome new features, designed to mitigate losses during dimensional travel:

[list][*] [b]New stranger: Guide[/b] - Exclusive to the Metagate. He will help you whitelist certain items or stats when you enter the Dimensional Portal. Unlike most strangers, you may only pay each Guide once.
[*] [b]New legendary items: Memento[/b] - Found only in Endless Multiverse Item Shops, each Memento presents a mini-quests of sorts; if you can meet its conditions, you will receive a buff at the start of the next dimension. There is a Memento based around the mechanics of each Mastery.
[*] [b]New landmark: Vault[/b] - The Vault allows you to deposit a specific item that will persist between dimensions. You can retrieve this item from the next Vault you encounter, however you must leave another item in its place.
[/list]


Endless Multiverse 2.0 will be available with the release of the Sweeping Heights expansion, currently scheduled for late May to early June.

We hope you're looking forward to it as much as we are!

notes.title: v1.40 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We're releasing a second DemonCrawl update this week in order to fix a few bugs and test some experimental stage mod changes!

Full patch notes are available below.

---

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Top Hat changed from passive to armor: "[2 Armor] If you have no magic items when you enter a stage, gain a random uncharged magic item. Whenever you use a magic item, it transforms into a different magic item."
[*]Warning Sign: 35 coins -> 29 coins
[*]Scrap Hopper: 25 coins -> 17 coins
[*]Tabula Rasa: 24 coins -> 16 coins
[*]Duster: 24 coins -> 16 coins
[*]Astrolabe: 12 coins -> 16 coins
[*]Timeless stage mod rework: "Your status effect timers do not update."
[*]New Withering stage mod is taking the place of the old Timeless: "Lose 1 life each minute. You cannot die to Withering."
[*]Tweaked Flawless stage mod: "If you take damage, exit the stage without completing and lose a random item."
[*]Stats, armor, and stage power are now capped at 999,999 to prevent memory overflow issues
[/list]

[b]Developer's Note:[/b] [i]Flawless was capable of enabling a handful of infinite combos, some of which were slightly too easy to achieve. We have decided to take a soft approach in addressing this with the item loss penalty, rather than directly nerfing any of the combo pieces. We hope this will place a reasonable upper limit on the amount of loot/stats that farming Flawless can provide. [/i]

[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
[list][*]Added notification when trying to change favored or divine items in the codex during a quest
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed a crash between Reflector Blade and Vengeful stage mod
[*]Fixed a crash caused by entering a shop without any coins as Wizard
[*]Fixed a crash related to objects popped from bubbles, introduced in v1.39
[*]Fixed Wizard's ultimate ability sometimes failing to charge Divine magic items
[*]Fixed Ankh not activating on direct life loss
[*]Fixed Bones not showing up in Codex even after acquiring the Bones blueprint
[*]Fixed tooltips not showing in the Item Shop while wearing a Bandana
[*]Fixed Thief Bag using Bandana sprite in its alerts
[*]Fixed issue that prevented unlocking multiple Snowflake mastery tiers at once
[*]Fixed a small memory leak in the Codex
[*]Fixed Capitalism effect not writing to disk properly
[*]Speculative fix for crash related to revive animation activating without the HUD present
[/list]

notes.title: v1.39 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We are releasing a new stability patch for DemonCrawl today! This version also includes a few quality of life improvements - in particular, we have added confirmation dialogs for important buttons that could be activated by mistake.

As for Android, we are running into a number of issues with GameMaker's new IAP implementation. Unfortunately, we cannot release any new patches on Android until these issues have been resolved. We spent the better part of last week looking through our code for mistakes but our efforts have turned up short. At this point, we suspect there may be a bug in the GameMaker framework itself. We wish we had better news on this front, but until we hear from GameMaker's support team, we must put mobile development on the backburner.

On the bright side, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1141220/announcements/detail/1696104690159343187]DemonCrawl's free expansion[/url], Sweeping Heights, is coming along really well. We should have some teasers to share with you in the coming weeks. :-)

Full patch notes are below.

---

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list][*]The 60-second timer penalty for reloading a stage no longer applies to Casual or Normal difficulties
[/list]

[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
[list][*]Added confirmation window for abandoning the quest mid-stage
[*]Added confirmation window for restarting the quest
[*]Added confirmation window for using an heirloom
[*]Exiting the Options screen can return you directly to your stage instead of the main menu
[*]Updated Resolute Horn description to clarify that it only triggers on stage completion
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed a crash related to Pagan mod log entry
[*]Fixed a crash related to Bruises dealing damage in a Flawless stage
[*]Fixed Wanted Poster bypassing omen immunity
[*]Fixed visual alignment issue when immmutable objects are hit with bubble projectiles
[*]Fixed interaction between Magical Bean and Divine Lantern
[*]Fixed a few instances of lingering tooltips after clicking on an object
[*]Fixed Heavy Burden not working correctly with chest items
[*]Fixed Fickle stage mod incorrectly triggering through Strangers or Landmarks
[*]Immortal mastery now sets your max life directly instead of incurring life loss
[*]Chests in Cursed cells will no longer guarantee omens if you managed to reduce your omen chance to 0
[*]Speculative fix for unlocked blueprint count exceeding total blueprints
[*]Speculative fix for variable overflow leading to crash with item alert script
[/list]

notes.title: v1.38 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We're releasing a new stability patch for DemonCrawl today! Thank you to everyone for your continued bug reports.

We were planning to deploy this patch a few days ago, but fate had other ideas; our development PC kicked the proverbial bucket during a routine OS update on Tuesday. So, we've had our hands full restoring DemonCrawl's source code from backups and getting our development environment up and running again.

We are still catching up on emails and forum posts, so if you contacted us recently and haven't heard back yet, we hope you'll bear with us. <3

The good news is that this situation gave us an opportunity to update our development runtimes, which might mean better in-game performance.

Oh, we also added a new avatar in cooperation with [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC4Xj6emHTXnKHUq8btUuN6A]Retromation[/url]:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36016626/fe77da755d7dcda2442fcdc813639a386c2bddf2.png[/img]

Visit Retromation's channel here: https://www.twitch.tv/retromation

Full patch notes below.

---

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]New Twitch avatar: Retromation!
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]DemonCrawl is now compiled using the latest version of Visual Studio and GameMaker runtime, which may improve performance
[*]Fixed level-based legendary items failing to unlock under specific circumstances
[*]Fixed an issue with receiving Daily Missions in locked slots
[*]Fixed "A Legend in the Making" achievement not working with new types of Scribes
[*]Mastery achievements will now sync to the cloud on startup (in addition to regular achievements)
[*]Fixed Wishpool value not saving to disk on use
[*]Fixed Gearcheck ground items not saving to disk
[*]Fixed visual bug between Magnifying Glass numbers and heart animation
[*]Fixed visual bug between item indicators and heart animation
[*]Fixed visual bug on "next page" button in the Beyond screen
[*]Speculative fix for inbox crash on startup, possibly due to network settings
[*]Speculative fix for very rare crash related to opening the help menu
[*]Android only: pressing the back button on your phone can now open the stage quit menu
[/list]

[b]Note:[/b] Due to the runtime update, we have to rewrite some code related to in-app purchases on Android. This process may take a few days, so v1.38 probably won't be available on the Playstore until early next week.

notes.title: v1.37 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks!

We're kicking off the week with a small but exciting DemonCrawl update!

As always, the full patch notes are available below.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qZlF5wV.png[/img]

Do you notice anything these two items have in common with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1141220/announcements/detail/1688222120328656080]our recent Welding Mask and Adventurer's Hat reworks?[/url] Answer: they are all headgear that were not originally classified as armor. That's because we designed these four items before DemonCrawl had an armor system! We're looking to fix that.

The reworked Bandana and Nightcap feature all-new mechanics:
[list][*][b]Bandana[/b] gives you a temporary alternative to spending coins, which can be extended through armor fortification effects such as [url=https://demoncrawl.com/wiki/index.php?title=Forge_Hammer]Forge Hammer[/url]. 
[*][b]Nightcap[/b] enables a new "pass turns" build, but must be paired with a synergistic effect like [url=https://demoncrawl.com/wiki/index.php?title=Jumprope]Jumprope[/url].[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/q8WlXxm.png[/img]

Check out their Twitch channels below:
[list][*][b]Admiral Bahroo[/b] - [url=https://www.twitch.tv/admiralbahroo]https://www.twitch.tv/admiralbahroo[/url]
[*][b]Snakebird Priestess[/b] - [url=https://www.twitch.tv/snakebird_priestess]https://www.twitch.tv/snakebird_priestess[/url]
[/list]

We always let streamers decide how they would like to distribute their avatar promo code. In this case, [url=https://www.twitch.tv/admiralbahroo]Admiral Bahroo[/url] insisted that we make his avatar available to all, so it's our pleasure to share the code with you now:

[b]X5NP7ZR3XC[/b] (Enter in the Token Shop.)

Remember to show support for your favorite DemonCrawl streamers by following and subscribing to their channels! Without them, DemonCrawl could not have reached nearly as many people. The Twitch community is what allows indie devs like us to continue doing what we love, and that's making original games on our own dime, not beholden to the motives of a giant corporation. We're really grateful that platforms like Twitch exist.

Onto the patch notes -

---

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list][*]2 new Twitch avatars
[*]Nightcap rework: "[1 Armor] Fortify whenever you pass 1 or more turns."
[*]Thought Bubble is taking the place of the old Nightcap
[*]Bandana rework: "[2 Armor] Instead of spending coins, reduce the durability of this armor by 1."
[*]Thief Bag is taking the place of the old Bandana
[*]New Hero Trial effect: Skippable - "Whenever you pass 1 or more turns..."
[*]Improved the "pass turns" script to make it more flexible as an item mechanic

notes.title: v1.36 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello!

We are releasing a stability patch for DemonCrawl today. This patch also includes a number of diagnostic improvements to help us pinpoint issues with cloud sync. 

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list][*]Achievements will now attempt to sync with Steam/Google Play on launch
[*]Added setting to show system events as in-game alerts
[*]Added button to manually upload all local save files to the cloud
[/list]

[b]Developer Notes:[/b] In rare situations where Steam Cloud data becomes corrupted, the new "manual upload" option can be used to restore Steam Cloud functionality from a backup save. We do not recommend using this feature unless you are experiencing issues with the Cloud.

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Heirlooms are now capped to 10 per slot due to the possibility of infinite Scribe cheese
[*]Can no longer toggle divines nor favored items mid-quest
[/list]

[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
[list][*]Added alert for Nightmare mod
[*]Added tooltip for soul icons in the Altar
[*]"Window Scale" setting is now hidden in fullscreen mode

[*]Added several diagnostic log events related to the cloud sync feature
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed stages from previous Endless Multiverse dimension showing up in new dimensions
[*]Fixed small memory leak when switching dimensions in Endless Multiverse
[*]Fixed memory leak related to monster gib particle effect
[*]Familiars will now keep their strong status when reloading a stage
[*]Fixed odd board jump when familiars kill a monster while board shake is disabled
[*]Fixed buggy interaction between Medusa Head and Enchanting Rune
[*]Fixed buggy interaction between Sleeping Powder and Leftovers
[*]Fixed "open cell" keybind not activating orbs
[*]Fixed broken background graphics after using Drugs multiple times in quick succession
[*]Fixed changes to max life not saving to disk under some circumstances
[*]Fixed the possibility of tunnel staircases becoming inaccessible from Frozen stage mod
[*]Fixed unobtainable Divine Bomb
[*]Fixed Taxes bypassing omen immunity
[*]Fixed "Don't Blink" daily mission not recording to disk properly
[*]Fixed Divine Unstable Compound using effect of regular Unstable Compound
[*]Fixed a rare crash related to Golden Chestplate
[*]Speculative fix for rare bug with Warning Sign that could lead to inaccurate cell values
[*]Speculative fix for crash related to cell notification when cell no longer exists
[*]Speculative fix for crash related to boss collecting loot that no longer exists
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: The Big Balance Patch! v1.35 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello folks!

Today, we are releasing one of DemonCrawl's biggest patches since launch! The theme of this update is [b]balance changes[/b], which happened to rank quite high in our feature poll. [i](Speaking of which, we will be creating a separate post for the poll results later today - so stay tuned for that!)[/i]

In the meantime, let's go over some of the highlights in today's patch. Full patch notes are available below as well.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TpVrr8I.png[/img]

We have extended the Token Shop with a few new legendary items. These items are meant to help out certain builds that lacked powerful, synergistic enablers (specifically Electric, Canker, and Bone builds.)

We have also re-classified Thicker Skin as a passive item. We like Thicker Skin's effect, but it simply doesn't match up against the other legendary items in the pool.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/voVuzYn.png[/img]

[b]7[/b] items have been completely reworked, in additional to [b]several smaller changes[/b] to other items. Over [b]30[/b] items have had their prices adjusted.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1XwdlmX.png[/img]

We are continuing to support our favorite DemonCrawl content producers with exclusive in-game cosmetics! If you would like to unlock these new avatars, check out the following channels on Twitch - each streamer may have his or her own method of distributing their avatar:
[list]
[*][b]Esty8nine - [/b] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/esty8nine]https://www.twitch.tv/esty8nine[/url]
[*][b]Frostprime_ -[/b] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/frostprime_]https://www.twitch.tv/frostprime_[/url]
[*][b]Patty - [/b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/patty]https://www.twitch.tv/patty[/url]
[/list]

For a complete list of changes, please check out the patch notes below!

---

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list][*]Added 3 new avatars in cooperation with some fantastic DemonCrawl Twitch streamers
[*]New Casual Mode setting to enable or disable stage mods
[*]A new tab has been added to the Help menu for stage mods
[*]New Token Shop legendary item: Bone Casket - "Item chests also contain Bones. If you are not injured when you bury Bones, gain souls instead of restoring life."

[*]Adventurer's Hat rework: "[1 Armor] Fortify by 5 whenever you gain a legendary or divine item."

[*]Bullet Time rework: "Projectiles and orbs travel slowly."
[*]Iron Will rework: "Gain 2 defense whenever your armor breaks."
[*]Patron Saint rework, changed from passive to magic: "[20/20 Mana] Spend 5 coins on target stranger and convert it to a familiar."
[*]Arcane Staff rework, changed from magic to passive: "The first diamond you collect each turn will fully charge a random magic item."
[*]Divine Lantern rework: "[300 Mana] Glean target hidden cell. If it's not a 0, this item retains its mana."
[*]Scribe rework, there are now 3 different types of Scribes
[*]New Daily Mission: Down With the System - "Destroy 3 signs."
[*]New Daily Mission: Waive the Flag - "Earn 100 points from Flagless awards."
[*]New Daily Mission: Think of the Children - "Earn 100 points from Charitable awards."
[*]New Daily Mission: Don't Blink - "Earn 100 points from Fast awards."

[*]Astrolabe buff: "At the start of each stage, reveal any cells that have guaranteed objects in a 3x3 area."

notes.title: Straitjacket Rework! v1.31 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello! We have an exciting update for you today.

Let's get the big one out of the way first:

[b]Straitjacket is now a beneficial armor item.[/b] A new omen called [b]Fig Leaf[/b] is taking Straitjacket's old spot, but does not prevent you from picking up loot - Fig Leaf merely stops you from wearing armor.

We originally designed Straitjacket as a "worst case scenario" omen. We liked the idea of having an item in the pool that was universally feared--especially because most other omens can be subverted to your advantage--but players have rightfully argued that Straitjacket's lack of counterplay is bad design. We agree.

Someday, we may introduce a new omen to strike fear in the hearts of all DemonCrawl players, but for now we hope you enjoy the softer side of Straitjacket.

We have also added a new boss to the game. Introducing [b]Baglord[/b]:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZBt5R4C.png[/img]

Yes, it's the lord of bagmen himself!

Baglord will make your life more difficult by spawning cronies throughout the map. If he's in a bad mood, Baglord will slaughter his own men just to intimidate you. This dude's crazy!

[b]BAGLORD, LORD OF BAGMEN:[/b]
[list][*]Spawn a Bagman whenever a Dark Heart is collected.
[*]Whenever a Bagman is killed, take damage equal to its empowerment value.
[*]Bagmen cannot weaken monsters.
[/list]

To top it off, we implemented an experimental new stage mod called [b]"Fake"[/b] that causes three cells to show incorrect values... can you feel the paranoia setting in?

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]

Bug fixes are our highest priority right now - there are still a few important issues we need to address. After that, we would like to run a community poll to determine which features our players are most interested in. We want to make sure we're spending our time on content that people actually care about. 2020 is going to be a great year for DemonCrawl, and it's all thanks to your support!

Full patch notes available below.

---

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list][*]Added video setting to disable board rumble effect
[*]Stage particles setting now applies to cell auras as well
[*]New boss: Baglord
[*]New stage mod: Fake - "Three cells have the wrong values."
[*]New omen: Fig Leaf - "Unequip your armor. You cannot wear armor."[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Straitjacket has been converted to a Body Armor: "[6 Armor] You cannot pick up loot."
[*]The Timeless mod now deals damage instead of direct life loss
[*]Stage mods will now take the stage density into account when calculating loot droprate
[*]Loot scaling is now capped to prevent empty, powerful stages from having Tokens in every cell
[*]Quest completion XP is now based on the difficulty of all stages, not just the last stage
[*]The Thrifty award now requires you to skip at least 3 special stages and gives more XP to compensate
[*]Charitable award XP can no longer exceed Victory award XP
[*]Bagman no longer increases damage taken from sources other than monsters
[*]Updated default leaderboard version to v1.31[/list]

[b]Developer Notes:[/b] [i]We really like the idea of Token-farming builds, but realized it was a little too easy to spawn hundreds of Tokens in a stage if you knew what you were doing. With this balance change, adding mods to stages with very few monsters will have a minimal effect on loot drops. However, adding mods to a dense stage will generate more loot than ever![/i]

[list][*]Fixed a leaderboard crash when too many results were retrieved

notes.title: The Casual Mode Update! v1.27 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sRbaoXG.png[/img]

The wait is finally over!

After several weeks of development, we are excited to release one of DemonCrawl's most hotly-anticipated features: a new difficulty setting called Casual Mode that [b]generates 100% solvable boards[/b] and [b]completely removes omens[/b] from item chests. 

Whether you are new to minesweeper or simply don't enjoy risk management in your puzzle games, Casual Mode will allow you to fine-tune the gameplay to your exact preferences.

Here's a look at all of the options that Casual Mode ships with - these are all turned off by default:

[list]
[*][b]Show Timer[/b] - Toggles the HUD timer.
[*][b]More Monsters[/b] - Increases the monster count to match that of Normal Difficulty.
[*][b]True Random Boards[/b] - Toggles the need to guess while solving boards.
[*][b]Omens in Chests[/b] - Toggles whether omens may appear in item chests.
[/list]

We encourage you to try enabling these options one-by-one as you become more familiar with DemonCrawl's unique mechanics and the different patterns in minesweeper. If you enable all 4 options, Casual Mode is virtually identical to Normal Difficulty.

[h3]Some Other Notes About Casual Mode[/h3]
[list][*]Since Casual Mode is all about customizing your gameplay experience, we will probably use it as a testing ground for experimental changes in the future. Well-received changes may find their way into the other difficulties!
[*]Stage mods and objects can still create situations where you have to guess; our algorithm only tests the board for monster placement, which accounts for the vast majority of 50/50s. We may test other conditions in the future.
[/list]

[h1]Other Features[/h1]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1141220/partnerevents/view/1690470748504707199]As promised in our previous blog post[/url], The Casual Mode Update is not just for new players! Let's take a look at some of the other cool things we've added:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ksihNKr.png[/img]

We have expanded the item pool to address a few weaknesses in certain builds. The full details are available in the patch notes below, although it might be more fun to discover the new tools as you play...

[h3]Two New Awards & Balance Changes[/h3]

There are two new ways to earn XP as you complete stages:

[list][*][b]Flagless[/b]: Gain XP for not using a single flag.
[*][b]Thrifty[/b]: Gain XP for skipping special stages.
[/list]

Since XP is directly tied to your overall score, we are very interested in seeing if these new awards have any impact on the leaderboards. In particular, Thrifty could lead to some cool moments where players have to decide between improving their build with an Item Shop or maximizing their score.

We also buffed a few underperforming items and increased the droprate of items set to Favored.

[h3]Solvable Boards in Classic Mode[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ivlnWma.png[/img]

Classic players deserve a bit of love too.


[h3]A new stage mod[/h3]
We have added a new positive stage mod called [b]Trusty[/b] that guarantees solvability. The mod can show up in ANY difficulty, but it's pretty rare!


[h3]Last but not least, the Christmas Event is officially over.[/h3]
Press F in chat for Christmas.


[h3]What's Next?[/h3]
We're shifting our focus to bug fixes now. Expect a few stability patches this week, and keep sending us those amazing error reports. :)

---

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list][*]Casual Mode has been added to the game
[*]Solvable boards can be enabled or disabled in Classic Mode
[*]New beneficial stage mod: Trusty (stage is solvable without guessing)
[*]New award: Flagless (earn XP for completing a stage without using flags)
[*]New award: Thrifty (earn XP for skipping special stages)
[*]You can now choose to start a quest with no mastery
[*]Christmas is dead... for now
[/list]

[h3]New Items[/h3]
[list][*]Head armor: [b]Frozen Helmet[/b] - [3 Armor] All Frozen cells are gleaned. Fortify whenever a monster becomes frozen.
[*]Body armor: [b]Electric Chestplate[/b] - [5 Armor] Monsters in Electric cells deal normal damage. Fortify whenever you collect loot from an Electric cell.
[*]Leg armor: [b]Burning Boots[/b] - [2 Armor] Burning cells do not hurt you. Fortify whenever an object is destroyed by Burning.
[*]Leg armor: [b]Batwing Boots[/b] - [3 Armor] Every 50 turns, gain a random omen if you just clicked on a 3 or greater.
[*]Consumable item: [b]Fortune Cookie[/b] - The selected stage gains the Trusty mod.
[*]Consumable item: [b]Molotov[/b] - Apply Burning to random hidden cells until it lands on one without a monster.
[*]Passive item: [b]Hero Brooch[/b] - When you enter a stage, reduce the max power by 1. If you have a legendary item, cut the max power in half instead.
[*]Passive item: [b]Dark Amulet[/b] - Guarantees 3 additional Dark Hearts per stage. Collect Dark Hearts to restore 1 life and gain a random omen.
[*]Magic item: [b]Ice Scraper[/b] - [50/50 Mana] If target cell has Frozen, remove the aura, then solve it and all nearby cells.
[*]Magic item: [b]Medusa Head[/b] - [400/400 Mana] Convert all visible strangers into Spawners of the same type, then unseal an inventory slot for each stranger converted this way.
[/list]

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list][*]If you visit an Item Shop with at least 10 coins, it will always have at least one item you can afford
[*]Dirty Soap now blows up orbs in a 3x3 area instead of 1x1
[*]Totem now activates every 30 turns instead of every 20
[*]Pyromancy, Cryomancy, and Electromancy now give souls instead of restoring life
[*]Frozen cells can now be gleaned
[*]Somewhat increased the droprate of Favored items
[*]Odds to find Favored items now automatically scales with the total number of items in the game
[*]Sign messages are less likely to show the stage-specific message
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a crash when using Ancient Coin after reloading a stage
[*]Fixed a crash when using Sundial on an area with no visible cells
[*]Pressing escape while the help screen is open no longer opens the stage quit menu
[*]Can no longer autoflag concealed cells
[*]Fixed Heart Key spawning new familiars instead of converting visible monsters
[*]Increased the opacity of gleaned cells from 0.65 to 0.80
[*]Fixed a potential issue with explosions still being able to destroy hidden immutable objects
[*]Fixed Halo not reducing lives to match max lives
[*]Removed irrelevant options from escape menu in Classic Mode
[*]Nomads that want to buy your items now have a different set of greeting messages
[*]DemonCrawl is now better at remembering your difficulty setting
[/list]

Enjoy, and Happy New Year's!

[b]Hotfix #1 @ 9:00 PM:[/b] Speculative fixes for invisible monsters in Casual Mode and "Done" button not returning to main menu. You may need to restart Steam to get these fixes. If you find yourself still running into either of these errors, please let us know and we will continue to investigate. Thanks!

notes.title: Christmas Event Ending Soon, plus Some Update News!
notes.content:
Hello!

We wanted to let you know that DemonCrawl's Christmas Event will be coming to a close soon, on [b]Tuesday, December 31st at around 4 PM EST[/b].

The Steam Winter Sale ends shortly thereafter, so [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1141220/DemonCrawl/]make sure to pick up your copy of DemonCrawl for 33% off[/url][/b] before January 2nd rolls around. The 50 token Christmas gift will remain available through January 2nd as well.

There are only a couple days left to unlock your special holiday items! If you miss this opportunity, worry not - you will be able to find the same items again next year in the form of Beyond Mode drops.

---

December 31st is also when we plan to release our [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1141220/announcements/detail/1690470748482547586]Casual Mode Update[/url][/b], which is packed with exciting new features. We're not just catering to beginners with this update - we are also adding new items to the game and addressing several balance concerns.

Here's a sneak peak of what's to come:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/topQsPM.png[/img]

What do you think?

This new set of elemental armor seeks to fill a few gaps in the current item pool:
[list]
[*]Frozen Helmet allows you to [i]kinda[/i] negate the downside of Frozen cells without having to rely on aura removal (i.e. Rainbow Lens.)
[*]There are very few items that synergize with Electric cells, so Electric Chestplate opens up the possibility for a new, lightning-themed build.
[*]Burning Boots enables fire builds to amass survivability, which is crucial if you haven't yet come online with infinite flares.
[*]In general, adding armors to the item pool increases the frequency at which you'll find armor during your runs.
[*]Even if you don't encounter any elemental auras, these items are worth the asking price for their durability alone!
[/list]

That's all for now! We hope you enjoyed the sneak peak, and as always, thank you so much for your support. :)

More to come soon.

notes.title: Developer Journal: Our Plans for DemonCrawl
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Hope your holiday festivities are going well. :)

We can't believe that it's already been nearly two months since we released DemonCrawl on Steam - what a wild ride!

We've been eager to write this blog post for a while now, but we needed a good opportunity to catch our breath and organize some of our thoughts. We finally got the chance.

---

[h1]History[/h1]

Let's kick this off by providing some background about DemonCrawl's development:

We had the idea for DemonCrawl about 5 years ago when we were watching [url=https://www.twitch.tv/nl_kripp]Path of Exile streamer Kripparrian[/url] discuss his love of minesweeper. It suddenly occurred to us that the mechanics of minesweeper would translate very well to the progression-based framework of an ARPG.

As time went on, we refined our ideas, but had trouble adapting some ARPG mechanics to DemonCrawl. Eventually we got addicted to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/242680/Nuclear_Throne/]indie darling Nuclear Throne[/url] and realized that the roguelite genre was a much better fit for our project.

The thing to know about minesweeper is that it has a component of risk management that sets it apart from many other puzzle games. We like that. The fact that it is statistically impossible to win every round is not a mark of bad design. In a game of chance, the goal is to maximize your average winrate over time through pattern recognition and a solid grasp of probabilities - Poker is another good example of this sort of game.

In our opinion, the luck factor is the main reason why minesweeper lends itself so well to the roguelite genre.

The element of chance is what gives items their meaning. When a board is 100% solvable, the optimal method of play is to ignore all items, coins, health pickups, etc, because they only slow you down; solvable boards demote loot to an unnecessary crutch, only retaining their value to those who don't yet understand how to approach the various patterns in minesweeper.


[h1]On the other hand...[/h1]

Since its launch, DemonCrawl has been showcased by many awesome YouTubers and variety streamers, the reception to which has been incredibly positive and enthusiastic, beyond our wildest expectations.

We cannot express how grateful we are for all your support - just know that we strive to return the favor by continuing to develop our game in a direction that excites most players. Not with crap microtransactions, but with quality content and engine improvements.

We were certain that DemonCrawl was going to be received as a niche product, but it turns out that many people who had no prior interest in minesweeper ARE interested in our game. And for some of those players, the element of chance is a big source of frustration - we can understand why.

After giving it some thought, we believe we have come up with a solution that will alleviate the frustration without infringing on our core design principles...


[h1]Casual Mode[/h1]

We are planning to introduce a new Casual difficulty that fundamentally alters the DemonCrawl formula. While this mode will be aimed at beginners, we expect that players of all skill levels may find it enjoyable from time to time.

Here is our current vision for Casual Mode:

[list][*]All boards 100% solvable without guessing.
[*]No omens from chests. [i](We recognize that this chance-based feature is another dealbreaker for some players.)[/i]
[*]Ongoing, experimental changes (such as a stage mod blacklist) that seek to eliminate any aspect of gameplay perceived as stressful.
[/list]

In short, Casual Mode will provide a new, relaxing way to enjoy DemonCrawl while retaining some sense of progression as you venture through the 5 quests.

We don't have a timetable for this feature yet, but it is definitely a high priority.

The interesting thing about solvable minesweeper boards is that, as far as we understand, you can't generate them programmatically. You have to generate a regular board at random, then use an algorithm after-the-fact to determine if the board is solvable. If not, throw it out and try again.


[h1]What about Tokens?[/h1]

Another common criticism we've seen is that of Token acquisition. We have a somewhat mixed view on Tokens. If you disagree with any of the points we're about to outline below, feel free to comment with your thoughts - we are absolutely open to constructive criticism.

Presently, our view is that 1) [b]earning Tokens is too slow in the early game,[/b] and that 2) [b]many cosmetics are a bit too expensive.[/b]

However, we feel that the prices of gameplay-related unlocks are actually quite reasonable. We can't help but notice that most of the critical feedback we've received in regard to Tokens has not accounted for numerous methods of acquisition, such as:

[list][*]Daily Missions unlocked at level 25.
[*]10x Tokens every 10 levels.
[*]Around 15,000 XP worth of achievements.
[*]Prestige bonuses that increase level-up rewards from [1-3] to [4-6] Tokens.
[*]Daily Hero Trial worth 10 Tokens after Hard Mode.
[*]Rare chance to find Mega Tokens worth 10-30 Tokens.
[/list]

It's also important to mention that Masteries are one of the only Token purchases that have any impact on gameplay. Each Mastery costs 60 Tokens, but they are split into 3 Tiers, meaning you don't need to acquire or spend all of the Tokens at once.

Cosmetics, on the other hand, are probably in need of a price reduction. Holographs and Inventories are 100 Tokens a pop, and while we do like to think of them as "luxury items," there are many to collect, and we plan to introduce many more. A better pricing model is in order here.

Also, we definitely recognize that earning Tokens in the earlygame can be a bit difficult sometimes. Leveling up relies on completing stages, which is a tough task if you don't have a Mastery or much experience with minesweeper.

We think Casual Mode will help with this to some extent, but we're brainstorming other ways of aiding new players with their Token funds. One idea we're toying with right now is providing ~30 Tokens for completing the Tutorial.

Speaking of which...


[h1]Better learning tools[/h1]

Since we were convinced that DemonCrawl would only appeal to minesweeper veterans, we spent as little time as possible constructing the tutorial.

Players have been quick to point out that there are all kinds of wild mechanics in DemonCrawl--as well as minesweeper fundamentals like chording--that aren't mentioned in the tutorial. We're going to fix that, probably by splitting it up into multiple missions.

We are also looking to improve the various tooltips shown in the Help interface. If you come across any language that seems unclear or vague, please let us know and we'll work to refine it.

[h1]Bonus FAQ[/h1]

Before we go, we want to quickly address a few more questions we see popping up a lot in the forums and on Twitch streams:

[b]Will DemonCrawl be ported to other platforms?[/b]
[i]We are aiming to port DemonCrawl to Switch, Mac, Linux, iOS, and PS4 in due course, but nothing's official yet. We're hoping that we can make 1 or 2 of those ports happen in 2020.[/i]

[b]Can I download the OST somewhere?[/b]
[i]A lot of the music in DemonCrawl is royalty-free material and as such we're not 100% confident if we can distribute a standalone soundtrack. However, all of the audio files are accessible through localappdata after you install the game.[/i]

[b]Are you going to add microtransactions to the game?[/b]
[i]No.[/i]

---


Much love,
Eric at Therefore Games
