notes.title: v1.24 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello,

We are releasing an update to address frequent crashes on Blueprint completion. Also, we added a quick restart button! Full patch notes are below.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list][*]Added quick restart button to the game over screen
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Increased the stage size cap from 30x30 (900 cells) to 45x45 (2025 cells) 
[/list]

[b]Developer notes:[/b] [i]Previously, we had capped the stage size to 900 cells in effort to address a memory overflow. We have since fixed the overflow by updating our cell evaluation script, so now we want to see if DemonCrawl can handle bigger stages again.[/i]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Adjusted status effect code to prevent Blueprint crash
[*]Leftovers will no longer re-trigger Blueprints
[*]Fixed XP Boosts tooltip on stage finish
[*]Fixed Divine Forge Hammer
[*]Fixed Divine Horseshoe
[*]Fixed items in bubbles losing their identity between loads
[*]Fixed cell loot not saving properly when altered by a number of items (e.g. Paragon Rod)
[*]Fixed Dark mod not following the cursor when custom cursor was disabled
[*]Fixed custom cursor showing up again after freezeframe even if the custom cursor setting was turned off
[*]Workaround for rare softlock that involves reloading into a quest with 0 lives
[/list]

[b]Developer notes:[/b] [i]We are still running a number of tests on status effect items to ensure that they are compatible with the recent status effect overhaul. If you run into an unexpected result when an item timer runs out, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1141220/discussions/0/1639801448913103205/?ctp=29]please submit a bug report here.[/url] Thank you![/i]

Enjoy!

[b]Hotfix #1 @ 5:35 PM:[/b] Attempting to resolve a few more status item-related crashes, specifically the "Quest for X" items.

[b]Hotfix #2 @ 8:20 PM:[/b] Speculative fix for the rare freeze that occurred during the XP animation.

notes.title: v1.23 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello,

We are releasing another patch today to resolve an issue with some players' ongoing quests. We tossed in couple QoL improvements, too.

---
[b]NOTE:[/b] This update will manually reset active status effects in attempt to fix a bug caused by v1.21. You may not want to update your client if you are in the middle of a run that relies on its status effects. In the future, we will be able to apply fixes like this more gracefully with the help of a feature described below. Thanks!
---

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list][*]You can now skip the XP animation
[*]Client version number is now written to the disk whenever you start a new quest, which should help us avoid corrupting quest data while applying updates
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Significantly reduced the requirements for most Daily Missions
[*]Selling items with Merchant Ring now operates on right click
[*]Reduced cost of the Black Hole item to 1 Token
[/list]

[b]Developer notes:[/b] [i]We plan to remove Black Hole in a future update and allow players to reset their Endless Multiverse for free. The 1-Token cost is a stopgap measure.[/i]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Removed status effects in active quests to resolve an incompatibility between old status effect code and new
[*]Standardized the codex update script to ensure it checks for the "Infinite Wisdom" achievement in all scenarios
[*]"Quakes" Hero Trial effect no longer crashes if it can't find objects to destroy
[*]Fixed some concealed cells not persisting between loads
[*]Non-persistent status effects are now properly removed when a stage is aborted (e.g. Ritual Chalk)
[*]Can no longer accidentally open menu items when skipping the intro animation
[*]Fixed certain stage properties not saving when a stage mod is removed
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Holiday Event! v1.20 Patch Notes
notes.content:
The Holidays are upon us!

Join us for DemonCrawl's first-ever Special Event to earn a set of exclusive, winter-themed rewards - available now through the end of December.

Let's take a look at what you can unlock this year:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nXmqq6o.png[/img]

... And to top it off, we are gifting everyone [b]50 Tokens[/b] for good measure. No promo code necessary - simply launch DemonCrawl and check your inbox for a new message.

Oh, we forgot to mention that we added an ultra-rare holograph drop to Beyond mode. It's called [b]Falling Snow[/b]. Best of luck finding it!

---

Full patch notes for v1.20 are below.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list][*]Added holiday cheer!
[*]Added 4 limited-time avatars
[*]Added limited-time inventory: Candy Cane
[*]Added limited-time stage: Christmas
[*]Added limited-time ultra rare holograph
[*]Added option to disable no-flag support
[*]DemonCrawl now tracks number of monsters killed during a quest - may be utilized by future mechanics
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed Golem Glove not spawning monsters
[*]Fixed cells turning invisible along the border of the screen when zoomed in
[*]Fixed leaderboard version slider's default position
[*]Fixed Timepiece effect not saving to file
[*]Fixed Sleeping Powder having a weird effect on the timer when reloading stage
[*]Fixed softlock on Metagate caused by World Wonder
[*]Fixed coin animation speed in Metagate
[*]Fixed heirloom crafting regression on Android
[/list]

Now that we have a system in place for Special Events, we're very excited to add tons of seasonal content to DemonCrawl in the months and years to come. :)

Enjoy!

notes.title: v1.18 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TwTMZ1Q.gif[/img]

We're releasing a new patch with a couple requested features, some mastery buffs, and a bunch of bug fixes. Enjoy!

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list][*]Rewrote "check win" script to allow for stage completion without flagging
[*]Elders will now state your mastery's ultimate ability in their tooltip
[/list]

[b]Developer notes:[/b] [i]Many of you have been requesting no-flag support from day one. :) However, due to all of the crazy mechanics in DemonCrawl, it was not as simple to remove flags from the win state check as it would have been in a normal minesweeper client. Therefore, we are going to closely monitor this change to ensure it hasn't reduced overall game performance or created any weird bugs. If you run into any softlocks with the board state, please let us know and we'll take a look ASAP.[/i]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list][*][b]Commander I:[/b] "Spawn a familiar in the first cell you open each stage." → "Right-click to recruit a familiar to an empty cell for 5 coins."
[*][b]Commander II:[/b]  "Whenever you collect a coin, if you have fewer than 3 familiars, spawn a familiar in its place." → "Whenever you collect loot, upgrade all nearby familiars to strong familiars."
[*][b]Survivor III:[/b]  "[0/3] Gain 1 max life." → "[0/3] Solve a number of cells equal to your missing life."
[*]Survivor II and the Celestial Stage mod will no longer convert dark hearts to souls; Transcendence still does[/list]

[b]Developer notes:[/b] [i]We have overhauled Survivor III in order to help it synergize with the recently-reworked Survivor II. We're also giving Commander a sizable buff by allowing you to choose exactly where your familiars will spawn.[/i]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed a crash that could occur when the freezeframe banner tried to draw a sprite that no longer existed
[*]Fixed Spy II not working after reloading a stage
[*]Fixed a crash when using Infinity Key to finish a quest
[*]Spawners in Bubbles will now maintain their gray, statue-y appearance
[*]Fixed softlock between Nightmare mod and frozen cells
[*]Fixed a crash from using Pendulum on a value greater than your number of orbs
[*]Added safety check to see if a cell is occupied before forcing a loot drop (e.g. Vampiric Blade)
[*]Added safety check to kill_object script to prevent rare crash
[/list]

notes.title: v1.15 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello!

We hope you all had a wonderful Thanksgiving holiday!

Now that the turkey's been dealt with, we are releasing a new DemonCrawl patch that adds a hotly-requested feature: an in-game glossary. Check it out below!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/k9HlBas.gif[/img]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list][*]A new button has been added to the HUD that allows you to view past alerts as well as a glossary of all in-game terms
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list][*]In light of the recent Spy II nerf, we have decided to revert the functionality of Spy I to "glean 10 cells at the start of each stage."
[/list]

[b]Developer notes:[/b] [i]Although we are still evaluating the balance of Spy II, we recognize that the mastery's early game was quite weak since 4s rarely appear in the first few stages. Now that we've given Spy I its teeth back, we're hoping that Spies will have an easier time getting their builds off the ground. At the moment, we believe Spy II is still good in the mid-to-late game, and we like that activating it requires more of a conscious effort than it used to (chording 3s would often happen "automatically" whereas a 4 often calls for an intentional change in how you approach the board.)[/i]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed a bug with Cauldron that could cause it to destroy itself
[*]Fixed Lantern and Spybug not working toward Spy mastery unlock requirements
[*]Fixed "Newbie's" Hero Trial effect not doing anything
[*]Fixed a rare crash that could occur when Sawblades collided with occupied frozen cells
[*]Fixed aura definitions not showing up when hovering stage mods due to case sensitivity
[*]Fixed clear button not properly resetting the keyboard string in search fields
[*]Fixed a crash that would occur when a familiar tried to move after you reload a quest and pop him from a bubble
[*]Fixed certain items not activating from spending coins on a stranger, e.g. Guild Bond
[*]Using Beggar's Cup with a Nomad who's trying to buy an item will no longer cause you to lose the item he's looking for
[*]Android only: Fixed an issue where purchasing the Full Game would not award 50 Tokens in some cases (missing tokens will be retroactively awarded)
[*]Android only: Scrollbars are now easier to click on
[/list]

notes.title: v1.14 Patch Notes
notes.content:
A DemonCrawl update this late on a Sunday night? You bet!

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list][*]Added a slider in the leaderboards that allows you to filter scores by client version
[*]Added "Invert Cell Controls" setting to reverse left and right click
[*]Android only: the above setting will allow you to open cells with a short tap and flag with a long tap
[*]Added a setting that lets you disable the autoflag feature
[*]Improved appearance of Immortal mastery icon
[/list]

[b]Developer Notes:[/b] [i]Due to the frequent balance updates, we have decided to filter out scores achieved in older versions of DemonCrawl. Starting from today, the leaderboards will hide scores earned in v1.13 and before, but you can always show them again by adjusting your leaderboard filter.[/i]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Nomad price now increases by 1 after each use
[*]Final Boss Ego got sick of trapping himself in Frozen cells and figured out how to bust through
[*]Spy II chord requirement increased from 3 to 4
[*]The screen no longer shakes when a familiar kills or gets killed by a monster
[*]Tablet of Drocer: Redeem at the end of the quest for [200 points -> 50 points]
[*]Primordial Gate: 24 coins -> 31 coins
[*]Sapling: 9 coins - > 15 coins
[*]Cullstone: 20 coins -> 14 coins
[*]Mortar: 19 coins -> 30 coins
[*]Mud: 12 coins -> 9 coins, now lasts 100 turns instead of 50
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed a softlock that could occur when Genie Lamp activated on a stage with the Double mod
[*]Fixed buggy interaction between autoflagging and Frozen cells
[*]Fixed autoflagging not taking visible monsters into account
[*]Muscle now creates a location balloon
[*]Fixed pluralization on Mystic Statue rewards
[*]Speculative fix for Truthsayer Quill crash
[/list]

[b]Developer Notes:[/b] [i]We have received multiple crash reports about status effect items with rewards (e.g. Truthsayer Quill, Justice Juice.) We aren't 100% sure if we tracked down the true cause of this problem, so if you encounter such a crash in v1.14, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1141220/discussions/0/1639801448913103205/]please submit a comment here[/url] with as much detail as you can. Thank you![/i]

Enjoy!

notes.title: v1.12 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello!

We are releasing a small patch today to address a number of bugs and unintended item effects. We have also made a few adjustments to stranger prices based on player feedback. Enjoy!


[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list][*]Added keybind support for board panning [i](DVORAK users rejoice)[/i]
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Hungry Plant feeding requirement changed from [4-10] to [3-8] items
[*]Mercenary price changed from [2-6] to [1-5] coins
[*]Waterboy price changed from [1-4] to [1-3] coins
[*]Blacksmith price changed from [10-20] to [10-25] coins
[*]Elder price changed from [7-15] to [7-18] coins
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed buggy interaction when an orb blew up before monsters spawned into a stage
[*]Fixed bug that allowed Thornseeker to work on revealed cells
[*]Fixed a crash that occurred in the Bazaar if you tried to trade an item you no longer had
[*]Fixed a crash that occurred when game tried to distribute Banked XP outside of a quest, e.g. Crafting achievement
[*]Fixed an issue with certain Hero Trial effects evaluating cells too early, which led to inaccurate cell values in rare circumstances
[*]Pressing backspace on a popup will no longer softlock the game
[*]"Pre-enter-stage" items will no longer trigger when reloading a stage
[*]Speculative fix for a crash that occurred when retrieving invalid data from Steam Cloud[/list]


We are still investigating two major issues:

[list][*]There have been a few reports of Steam Cloud and Google Play Services not syncing profile data correctly. If you have recently used the cloud save feature on either platform, please let us know whether it worked for you. This is our top priority right now.
[*]DemonCrawl crashes without error on large stages and/or stages with very few monsters. We have investigated this and determined that it's caused by [url=https://forum.yoyogames.com/index.php?threads/recursion-depth-limit.35212/]GameMaker's relatively poor handling of recursive functions.[/url] The interesting thing is that such stages can be played when building DemonCrawl with GameMaker's VM interpreter, but not with YYC. This is a little surprising to us because YYC allows the game to run better in nearly every other way. We'll see what we can do to get around this problem.
[/list]

We went 3 entire days without a patch. Let's fix that. :)

In particular, we want Knight to remain a good option for new players who aren't familiar with all of the other crazy mechanics in DemonCrawl.

[*] Speculative fix for inbox crash related to high network delay
[/list]

There are a few other outstanding bugs we are working to address. So if you don't see your reported issue in today's patch notes, worry not - we'll get to it as soon as we can.

Enjoy!

notes.title: v1.06 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Today's patch is the biggest one we've introduced since launch! There is a lot to unpack here, so we're happy to answer any questions you might have in the comments section below.

[b]TL;DR We are awarding every player with Tokens to compensate them for the new level-up feature described below.  If you find yourself with a bunch of extra Tokens and you don't know where they came from... well, now you do![/b]

Let's dive in:

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list][*]Every 10th level up, you will be awarded 10 Tokens instead of the normal 1-3
[*]Added keybind support for inventory panel (defaults to "I" key)
[*]Added in-game option to disable Steam cloud sync
[*]Expanded the Hero Trial pool with 2 new effects
[*]Cell contents are now preserved between freezing/unfreezing cells
[/list]

[b]Developer notes:[/b] [i]We have retroactively awarded existing profiles with the tokens they would have earned under this new system.[/i]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Increased the base Token drop rate by about 12%
[*]Daily Missions are now unlocked at level 25 instead of 50
[*]Armor damage calculations now happen before defense
[*]Survivor II rework: "Heart drops have a 5% chance to become souls." -> "Find souls instead of hearts if you are injured."
[*]Hunter II buff: "Every 70 cells you open without making a mistake, gain a Minion." -> "Every 60 cells you open without making a mistake, gain a Minion."
[*]Pendulum: 300 Mana -> 150 Mana
[*]Barbecue: 150 Mana -> 80 Mana
[*]Punchbag: "Whenever you leave a special stage ... " -> "Whenever you leave an item shop ..."
[*]Timelord Chronos now deals damage instead of direct life loss & during this boss you can collect loot to reset the timer to 0
[*]Nerfed the music volume of Elysium a bit
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Monsters trapped within Frozen cells will now decrement the monster counter, meaning you can rely on the counter to hit 0 when the stage is complete
[*]Fixed a crash when using Blowpipe on a shiny monster
[*]Fixed a crash that occurred when misflagging a cell on a stage that had both Judging and Flawless mods
[*]Fixed a few ways that immutable objects could get destroyed
[*]Fixed objects losing their immutable property between game loads
[*]You can now reclaim Favor points from legendary items that became locked due to prestiging
[*]Blowing up a hidden monster will now trigger "on monster kill" effects
[*]Fixed xray effect preservation when you reload a quest (i.e. Magnifying Glass)
[*]Fixed Endless Multiverse loop not saving properly between loads
[*]Speculative fix for a crash related to stage destruction before particle automanager cleanup
[*]Fixed a database issue that prevented players with IPv6 addresses from submitting scores to the leaderboards
[/list]

[b]Developer notes:[/b] [i]We will continue to monitor your feedback about Frozen cells to determine if they can still lead to a softlock under the new logic.[/i]

[i]If you're unsure whether your board is actually stuck, please submit a bug report along with a screenshot and we will take a look. Thanks![/i]

We hope you enjoy the new patch!

---

[b]Stealth hotfix #1 @ 12:30 EST:[/b] Fixed a crash in the gameplay settings due to an inventory keybind variable we forgot to instantiate.

[b]Stealth hotfix #2 @ 2:30 EST:[/b] Fixed Dry stage mod not respecting forced loot drops, which could have resulted in crashes with certain items.

notes.title: v1.03 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list][*]Introduced a new keyword called "[i]solve[/i]." An item that solves a cell will correctly flag OR unflag it.[/list]

[b]Developer notes:[/b] previously, there were items that would "reveal a hidden cell." Some players were wondering why this effect could hit cells you've already flagged. The reason is this: if such items avoided flagged cells, it would incentivize players to flag every cell except for the few they wished to target. We believe the wording of the "solve" mechanic circumvents this problem.

Items affected by this change include: Compass, Parasol, Boomerang, Minion.

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Reduced the overall monster density in Quest 1 from 0.155 to 0.148
[*]Reduced the overall monster density in Quest 2 from 0.160 to 0.158
[*]Greedy Pig rework: "Lose a random amount of coins at the end of each stage." -> "Lose up to half your coins at the end of each stage."
[*]Broken Rib rework: "Instead, your defense is added to damage." -> "Your defense is capped to the minimum stage power."
[*]Pagan stage mod rework: "At the start of the stage, lose a random number of items." -> "At the start of the stage, lose up to 10 random items."
[*]Aching, Bleeding, and Toxic stage mods can now be found in Normal difficulty
[*]Melting and Liberated stage mods are now restricted to Hard difficulty
[*]The first two chests opened will never contain an omen (up from 1)
[*]After clicking on a toxic cell, the toxic aura is removed[/list]


[b]Developer notes:[/b] we received a number of reports from players who were struggling with the first quest, so we have decided to make it (and the second quest) a bit easier. When making such changes, we want to be careful not to overshoot our goal; if Quest 1 was too easy, veteran players would not find it engaging. This is important because there are actually reasons for veterans to return to Quest 1 later in the game. For now, we will continue to monitor player feedback and make small adjustments as necessary.

We also hear you loud and clear with regard to omen design: there are some omens that offer little-to-no counterplay. Greedy Pig and Broken Rib were two such omens that would often punish you for playing correctly. We have altered their designs so that they don't completely cripple gold and defense builds. Let us know what you think.

You may have noticed that Straitjacket is unchanged. Hear us out on this: we believe it is important to have one omen in the item pool that is significantly more dangerous than the rest. It helps maintain suspense when opening chests, whereas most other (arguably better designed) omens can be subverted to a build's advantage. Straitjacket is unique in that it's pretty much always bad. It's the ultimate low roll.

It's also worth mentioning that, as we expand the item pool, Straitjacket will become increasingly rare; omen drop rates are not weighted in any way. And we would like to start adding more items to the pool relatively soon. :)


[h1]Resolved Bugs[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed a crash that occurred when a cell-based status effect activated on the same turn as Smog
[*]Fixed a crash that occurred when Dreamcatcher had no space to spawn loot
[*]Fixed certain items not activating through Gluttony
[*]Fixed a crash related to Duster
[*]Fixed a crash that occurred when picking up rare loot that was previously contained in a bubble
[*]Fixed a bug where KNIGHT II wouldn't give you defense if you were wearing a helmet (don't ask)[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]

notes.title: v1.01 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Today we are releasing a hotfix to address a number of bugs we've received from player reports. 

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list][*]Added support for Steam screenshots (F12 by default)
[*]Increased the max window scale from 9 to 16 to support 4k screens and beyond
[/list]

[h1]Resolved Bugs[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue with legendary items not unlocking properly
[*]Fixed Magnifying Glass effect persisting even after the item was lost
[*]Fixed a crash that occurred when deleting your only remaining save file
[*]Fixed a softlock that occurred when misclicking a monster that the tutorial expected you to flag
[*]Fixed a crash in the tutorial that occurred when you tried to right-click a coin
[*]Fixed a crash related to using Occultic Pendant when strangers couldn't spawn
[*]Fixed a crash when using Ouroboros
[*]Fixed an issue with Cattle Prod that created incorrect cell values
[*]Speculative fix for Dowsing Rod crash
[*]Fixed KNIGHT II unlock requirements
[*]Corrected a few typos in the achievements
[*]You can no longer be on drugs in the credits sequence
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
We are still investigating the following bug reports:

[list]
[*]Resuming a quest mid-stage may crash the game under specific circumstances
[*]Frozen cells can sometimes lead to negative monster counts, however the stage should still be completable (this is not a softlock as far as we know)
[*]Sometimes resuming a quest after a crash will set you back 1 stage
[/list]

If you have encountered any such issues, please [url=https://demoncrawl.com/contact/]file a bug report[/url] that includes your error message as well as a brief description of what you were doing at the time of crash. (Using an item, leaving a stage, etc.)

[h1]What's next?[/h1]

Once the client is more or less crash-free, we will be turning our attention to a few hotly requested features, including UI improvements (e.g. a button for leaving mid stage) and configurable keybinds. 

We're glad you're enjoying DemonCrawl and hope you will continue to provide such excellent feedback for us! :)
